title: No handle and not great base.
text: This speaker stands 6” tall and the base is 3.25” across. It has a weight of 1#, 7.5oz. There is a silicone ring on the bottom to keep it from sliding around. There’s a silicone ring around the top as well. This indeed has 360º sound. I was thinking it might just be four speakers, one on each side, but it’s not. Very easy to connect and operate. Micro cord included for charging. AC adapter not included. You can attach it to a tripod on the bottom. There are a couple of things I’m “underwhelmed” by. First is the base. It’s not that great. Not that deep. Second. . . there’s no handle. Bose offers what looks like the same speaker, with a handle, but you have to pay a hundred bucks more for it. I’m assuming there are other things that make it cost more, but exactly what. . . I don’t know. So. . . Without the handle. . . .This Bluetooth speaker is a lot less portable than others. My favorite speaker, in the same sort of category, is the Bang & Olufsen Beoplay A2. It’s about fifty bucks more, but the sound quality (especially base) is much better. . . and. . . it comes with a handle! ;-) Instead of being round, it’s flat, but there are speakers on both side, so you still have. . . more-or-less. . . 360º sound.

title: Worked great till it didn't (maybe I got a defective one)
text: It worked for all of 6 days. I got it, charged it, and it worked GREAT. I've been using it roughly 15-20 minutes each day in the shower to listen to podcasts. On the 7th day, the bugger wouldn't turn on. I thought the battery couldn't have died yet; when I last checked the percentage on my phone, it was at 80%, but since it wouldn't turn on, I charged it. When the red light went off, I attempted to turn on the speaker, but it still wouldn't turn on. I then plugged it back into the charger and lo' and behold, it turned on. Per the Amazon video, I disabled the bluetooth connection from my phone and then reconnected to the speaker. My phone showed it at 100%. Great. I turned the speaker off, unplugged it from the charger, and tried to turn it back on again. Nothing. I plug it back in and it turns on. This time, I leave the speaker on, but unplug it from the charger. I start listening to my podcast and in the blink of an eye, it went from 100% to 90%. I thought that was a strangely quick decrease in charge, but think maybe it's my phone listing an incorrect percentage. About 2-3 minutes later, I check the percentage again and now it's down to 20%. Wow! I leave the speaker running to see if it'll still play. After about 2 or 3 more minutes, it turns off. Definitely defective. I'm returning the product and getting a replacement, which I hope will fare better. I'm extremely disappointed because I actually like this little speaker.

title: For the Amazon Prime Day Price it's really good.
text: So lets be realistic here, this isn't a big end speaker. It isn't made of the most durable ABS plastic, it doesn't have class leading sound or battery life, I personally think the LEDs are tacky. So you're probably thinking why 4 stars? Well on Prime say I snagged one for about $30 so that's the basis of my review. For $30 this thing is awesome. The sound is pretty freaking loud, cranked up you can hear it blasting out of the gym at my school (I'm a teacher). The bass is what I would call balanced to enhanced a little, it isn't going to replace the dual 12" subs in your trunk, it's. 4" sub. Clarity is ok, they aren't audiophile (nor do I expect it at $30). It distorts a LITTLE at max volume but at that point you aren't really going to care. I can't even sit within 6 feet of it at max volume for more than a few minutes before I can't handle it. Battery is kinda all over. If you play it at normal levels you get 10 hours, if you want it blasting max it'll last maybe 4 hours. This is to be expected. So the reason for 4 stars and not 5, the FM radio. I would say it's maybe a 5 out of 10? I live in a fairly big city (600k) and I get the local stations, a few are fuzzy. But I can see why people say it doesn't work, if you live in BFE assume it doesn't have FM radio. To be perfectly honest I bought it for the bluetooth and the ONLY reason I wanted FM was for when my wife and I go to a drive in movie, and it does that spectacularly. I could care less if it doesn't anything else FM, but like I said 5/10. I would say it's worth 40, maybe 50 before it's just an ok deal. But if you can snag it at leas the $40 totally worth.

title: Just OK. Not Quite What I Had Hoped For
text: I ordered this item in August and have now used it enough to provide a solid review about my experience. I was excited about the purchase, but once I recieved it, I'm sorry to say that I was underwhelmed and a bit disappointed. It was my first JBL purchase; and I purchased based on the stregnth of what I have seen in display models in stores. It does not come with any cords - which was is going to be problematic for anyone who do not own devices that require the use of a Type C cord. I mean seriously, even if they didn't want to include a base, they could have included a cord. Once you have a cord and power/battery life, it was pretty easy to set-up - which is good because it does not come with any instructions and/or tips on how to best utilize the unit. From the unit itself you can only control, volume and complete the basic blue tooth set up. The sound is synced with your music device. So, unlike other devices that allow you to set one volume on your speaker and another on the music device/source and maximize the sound experience, this product does not allow for that. As such, the capacity of my iPad is pretty much it - which is disappointing. Expect to keep your device close because if you want to replay a song you'll need to do it from the device. I suppose if there is a different option, I'll have to look up instructions online. The box doesn't even provide that information either. The sound quality is just OK. It's not horrible, but it also did not excite me to the point of encouraging my family and friends to check it out. I thought by getting the Charge 4 instead of Charge 3, I would be getting something good. I'm actually feeling a little cheated and experiencing a little bit of buyer's remorse. I considered returning it, but decided to keep it and look for something better next time around. Overall, it's not horrible, but as I look to get another one, I'll probably think long and hard about JBL as I compare to the competitors. On a positive note, it's portable and feels extrmely sturdy. As such I'm hopeful it won't fall apart on me.

title: Lifesaver for Tinnitus
text: This has been a lifesaver. I have been suffering from tinnitus (hearing an unexplained high-pitched noise- an incurable condition) since third grade, about 30 years. Recently after an illness, the noise increased. Sleeping was difficult, especially on my side, and I was very distressed. Fortunately I found this product. I hooked it up to an inexpensive MP3 player, on which my husband had downloaded a good quality "brown noise" track. (Other options could be "white noise," nature/water sounds, or music- just search your favorite music store site). This allows me to sleep on my side without hearing my tinnitus. (To keep the other ear happy, I run a fan or air purifier in the bedroom for white noise). It's improved my quality of sleep highly. I use one down-alternative pillow (not a foam one). I put the MP3 on "repeat" and have it running all night every night. I use the amplifier option, not even turned up halfway (without it, I wouldn't be able to hear the sound through my pillow). It is not too hard on batteries, either, even with the amplifier on all night every night. It tends to slide around while I sleep, so I may use some Tacky Glue to stick some shelf backing onto it. I have only owned this product a short time so I cannot speak about the durability. But so far, I greatly appreciate it. I ordered a second one to have on hand as an emergency backup.

title: Great sound, but don't use the 3.5mm plug!
text: I purchased this unit about 4 months ago. I've loved using it streaming from my Mac or iPhone -- great quality sound, easy connection, flawless. Then I made the mistake of plugging it into a device without Bluetooth via the 3.5mm cable. DON'T DO IT! There is a well-known problem (search the Jawbone support forums) with these Jambox units. The 3.5mm connection takes priority over Bluetooth connections. Unfortunately, the device detects a 3.5mm connection through a set of pins inside the port that can, after a single use (like mine), not fully close again when you've removed the plug. This means the device is hopelessly stuck thinking you have a 3.5mm cable plugged in. I've contacted Jawbone, but they want me to pay to ship the unit back to them. That's completely unacceptable for a product I spent over a hundred dollars on. This is a known defect and Jawbone should be ashamed that they are still selling devices with that issue. I regret purchasing this instead of a competitor device. The audio quality is great, but the build quality is terrible!

It has connected consistenly with my son's phone and his Chromebook and he says the speakerphone works pretty good. My son will defiantly be testing its durability over the next several months!

title: Great Speaker
text: I bought this for my husband and it's a terrific little speaker with a great sound. The size is perfect for using with any bluetooth audio system. He sets it up next to his iMac and it's really nice to not have all those wires.

title: Good sound quality but with a delay when using to watch movies
text: I got this as a gift for my boyfriend and he loves it for listening to music. Since his laptop speakers are worn out, I was hoping that he would be able to use it as speakers for when he watches movies on his laptop, but alas, there is a sound delay even when it is plugged into the computer. The action on the screen never quite lines up with the sound coming from these speakers. Still a high quality, portable little speaker.

title: Great product
text: Great sound, small, and easy to use. Replacement for a boombox with better sound. Connects to phone easily and keeps charge well

title: Beware!
text: Jawbone products start out great but eventually you will find that you are unable to pair them with your devices. Whether you have the Mini or Big, you will have the same problem. Jawbone will tell you that the problem lies within your Mac and that you must purchase an adaptor (from them). Bullpoop! It is a flaw in their product. Trust me as I have wasted close to $400 with their products. I have three other bluetooth speakers/headphones and they have no difficulty pairing with my MacBook Pro. Check online and you will find that this is a common problem. Great at first, then, total failure. I'm about to replace both Jawbone products since they are now useless. Really disappointing.

title: Jawbone JAMBOX... busted after a few months of use
text: We purchased this for our daughter, and in a few months time, it would not turn on. We tried every trick offered on the Jawbone forums, and we have not gotten it to work. Right now, it is a pricy, red paper weight. I emailed Jawbone tonight to see what they say.

title: Great sound quality!
text: Easy to set up and use. Long battery life. The sound quality is excellent and projects across a room for me to enjoy. Very happy with this Jambox.

title: Works great.
text: This puts out a lot of volume. It works well with the iphone and ipad. That is all I have used it with so far. The charge on it lasts for hours!

title: JUST A HEADACHE!!!
text: After 6 month of normal home use, it started to work BAD. Pairing noises and static noises is the only thing I can hear from it 90% of the times I try to use it. Some times it works for a few minutes but then the bluetooth connection starts to do connection noises. And if I use it plugged in, I don't know why it starts to try to pair with the computer. Just a headache!!! And if yours work well, anyway, is not a good product. It wakes you up in the middle of the night with low battery noises and things like that. There are a lot of better products for the around the same price.

title: Great Sound!
text: The JAMBOX has a great sound! It is easy to set up. However, it is not easy to connect more than one bluetooth source, so I just connect it to my iPhone and it starts up immediately. Nice size, easy to carry, and good for traveling.

title: SWEET speaker!!
text: Absolutely love this speaker! What great sound from such a small package. For those online shopping: it's shorter but heavier than your average TV remote. Pair's super easy with all bluetooth devices: I use it with my Sony Tablet S, my Droid X, and my wife's iPhone. Software updates, multiple speak-back voice options. Most of all and worth repeating: super portable, solid feeling piece, with terrific sound (solid bass too). Get yourself one!

title: Descent sound. Lasts long on single battery charge.
text: Do not expect to throw a party using this speaker, but its definitely a great companion for your smart phone or tablet. Great for carrying around and using it in the park or around the pool. Hardware wise its solid and looks GREAT!!! i highly recommend this product.

title: Disappointed
text: I loved the size and look of this little bluetooth speaker. Wanted to use it in my bedroom, paired with my iphone to listen to music. The packaging was great, very much like Apple, but my positive experience ended there. So here's what I didn't like about it: 1) The sound. Its just not loud enough, even in my bedroom. For $160 it should be louder than this. Maybe I needed the bigger jambox, but that one is nearly $250. For a wireless speaker?? Come on. 2) The sound quality. I was getting this "warbly" sound connected to my iphone. 3) The connection sounds. At certain times, the jambox makes announcements about the battery, connections, etc; No matter what volume the jambox is at, that voice is at its own volume. (Annoyingly loud.) 4) The power cable connects awkwardly at the side. Annoying if you're using this for anything other than recharging. 5) The price. I suspected this was the case, but I've since read numerous reviews that there are better sounding speakers for less money. I found that hard to believe, but now I know its true. I'm returning this speaker and spending about $80 less for a Logitech, JBL or Creative option. It seems to me that you're paying for kind of a cool package, bit of a well known name. I'm not cheap and I was okay with paying the premium price, but I expected a lot more for the money than this. Very disappointed.

title: My New Favorite Thing!
text: I bought the JamBox on a recommendation from a friend. I wasn't sure that it's be useful to me though. I had considered it a bit of a pricey purchase. It's a wonder device. So far I've mostly used it just w/my iPad and my MacBook Pro. The sound quality coming from the JamBox is rich; it's like having a subwoofer in your hand. I just have to remember to turn it off when say, a playlist stops playing. I've yet to use the device for a Skype chat which I'm anxious to try. So far it's a thumbs up.

title: Like listening to music through a tin can with decent tweeters
text: I really can't get my head around why there are so many favorable reviews for the JamBox. I mean, it's bad. Terrible to be exact. It distorts quite easily and doesn't have any kind of full sound. It reminds me of listening to music from a tin can. I purchased it tonight, opened it, played it, and am returning it tomorrow morning. Now, my background is in studio engineering and so perhaps I expect more. It's too bad KRK doesn't make a bluetooth Stereo speaker device. Now THAT would be great! For me its about value, and the JamBox should be $39 or $49. That's the correct price point. Now I'm off to look at larger speaker systems such as Bose, and I typically HATE Bose, but if they did it right, I'm buying it.

title: Too Small
text: It needs to be small to be portable. It needs to be bigger to give the music a bit of punch. Therefore, small, but no punch. It works as advertised and syncs with my iPad via bluetooth. It took a few tries, but it does work. It is a great and small travel companion, but can't do much once it arrives. I wanted to like this product.

title: Difficult to setup
text: I bought this for my wife about 1 year ago. My single biggest complaint is that my wife has trouble connecting to her IPAD. I then need to go and fiddle with it for 3 minutes and voila it works. Usually I need to turn the blue tooth ON/OFF a few times on the IPAD and do the same on the Jambox. Also it is crazy the design of the ON/OFF switch. It is difficult to switch and prone to break your finger nail. A good idea but poor execution in the design. I bought a simple audio bluetooth receiver for our stereo and it always connects so I know it is possible to make a reliable bluetooth connection

title: Great little speaker
text: I've tried several Bluetooth speakers and you get what you pay for. I leave this on my desk at work and the clarity is great. I can feel a bit of bass through the desk which is a big plus over other speakers I have tried. Hooked up to the garage TV and the sound was much better than off the TV. Looking forward to bringing on camping trips. I assume I will use this rather than the integrated speakers in the RV. Highly recommend.

title: Never thought I would use this gift...
text: This was given to me as a birthday gift last october to go alongside my iphone 5. At first I thought it was neat but also thought "when am I ever gonna use this??" Boy was I wrong! I use this little thing every single day, be it at work, grilling with friends, on the golf course, or in the bathroom preparing for my day...the list is endless. For such a small package it sure puts out awesome sound, but don't leave it unattended on a high counter or it will vibrate right off. Even if it gets dropped or tossed into a backpack this thing is solid. Mine has been jossled in a golf cart and dropped a few times and it still works and sounds just as good as the day I opened it. Great item, and I highly recommend spending the money on this quality speaker.

title: Love the jawbone
text: Love the jawbone! Although I bought this one as gift for my brother in law, we have one take ours everywhere! Great sound from such a small box!

title: Problem Charging
text: I purchassed the Jawbone Jambox last month before heading off to a family reunion so that we could have tunes remotely - on the boat, at a picnic, etc. While I thought the sound quality was fairly good (good amplification, but weak Bass - which is exected with this type of unit), I had trouble getting the unit to charge propertly. The connection to the unit was not secure, causing charging to fail. So, I couldn't recharge. Not sure if it was that specific unit or a global issue. Did not want to give it another try with a replacement. Amazon return was easy and painless though. :-)

title: You get what you pay for!!!!
text: Wanted some decent sound for my new baby Ipad 2 and had tried something from amazon for half this price (Iluv system around $90-total piece of junk) and am sending it back....the beauty of this little device is that you get FANTASTIC SOUND and it takes up little space and you can carry it with you! I wasn't crazy about spending 2 bills for it...but if you dont have to connect anything like the ILuv one which was a pain in the butt to do and just was a waste of time and money so it went back to amazon--no, you can't charge with this but let me tell you-all these positive reviews are SPOT ON...the one stars here or there, I wonder if they just like to complain lol cause I can't imagine giving this wonderful device anything less than 5--the greatest little invention since...well, the IPad Itself!! (oh and its sooooooo easy to 'set up' even if you aren't into that kind of techno stuff-will take you 5 min. Turn It on....if you have an ipad...you just go into settings-general and turn your bluetooth setting on and BAM it finds it and you're good to go...and directions are easy for any other hookup you may want to use it for.) ENJOY this..worth the money in the long run.

title: What a huge disappointment..
text: What a huge disappointment... I thought I was buying the LARGE Jawbone Jambox Bluetooth speaker for its price... This speaker at its maximum level output is not all that that it is written to be... I am very dissatisfied with this product.

title: GET IT!
text: This speaker is kick (butt). I use it everywhere in the house, and it is light and easy to carry. It also grips to whatever you place it on which is a nice touch so that the bass doesn't push it over off of a table or off of a desk. The color is really nice and the sound is great for such a small speaker. I have an old school Ipod with no bluetooth so I just plug it into the speaker but I have used the speaker with an Ipad and the sound was great and it was nice to be able to link it up to something in a different room. Love this thing!

title: Portable tunes!
text: This is my first bluetooth audio device. I am able to get high quality from my iPhone from well over 20 ft with walls in between. The volume is loud enough without distortion. I have not tried to use it as a speakerphone. Charging is easy, but battery life is not the best. I've noticed that it will give you a <25% audio warning for the battery, but then will die within a couple minutes. I bought this during Black Friday which made it a steal.

title: It has good sound for a room but not much more than ...
text: It has good sound for a room but not much more than that. Battery life is good. Love using it in my bathroom while Im in the shower. When you have multiple devices, it has a hard time playing. Thats a pain.

title: Great Sound and Easy to Use
text: Instant gratification, 5 minutes out of the box the software was downloaded and music flowed. The quality is amazing for such a small speaker. I was impressed from the moment I opened the shipping box and pulled out the Jambox in its package. Every part of the packaging was designed for both performance and visual appeal. The flat folding case is a little work of art. The two major objectives - sound quality and flexibility of use were home runs. Sound quality is great across a wide range of volume settings. A great relief from builtin speakers and headset. Great combination of crispness and fullness. Will take a little longer to get all of the features working but am looking forward to the versatility of the speaker . Yes it is a lot more than many comparable speakers but is a great value

title: Ok, but not for me.
text: I ordered this speaker mainly because of all the positive reviews. Then I saw some reviews saying that the volume was too low on this unit. That worried me, so I ordered the JBL Flip just so I could compare the two once I received them. The Jawbone actually was plenty loud for my needs although LiveAudio mode does lower the volume considerably, so it is kind of useless on this speaker, but probably works well on the Big Jambox. After comparing the two, I decided to return the Jambox. That is only my personal preference. The speaker worked fine, but I just preferred the tone of the JBL. Even after messing with the EQ settings on my ipod, I still had issues with the sound quality. It's good, but for the price point of this speaker, I expected better, so I am returning.

title: it's not like you can set it on the deck and walk ...
text: I would give it more 3.5 stars if there was an option. It isn't very loud, it's not like you can set it on the deck and walk to the other side of the yard and hear it clearly. The speaker outside has to be within 10-15' of where you are to listen to it without straining. Inside with it echoing off your walls and such it would work much better, I'll eventually go demo the full version for outside work and use this one when I'm running on my treadmill or just lounging around listening to music

title: Love it.....
text: One of the best add ons I've purchased for my IOS devices. The sound is great. Jawbone is always sending out updates for the unit too. Several friends have bought on my recommendations.

title: Awesome sound, small package, spendy!
text: The sound that the Jawbone Jambox is perhaps the best of the Bluetooth speakers, but you get what you pay for. Big, powerful sound! The charge time is good, and it's recommended, if you can look past the $150 price tag.

title: excellent sound and portability
text: This speaker can put out a lot more sound than I was expecting in the normal mode. The range for bluetooth is pretty good but not amazing. The audio quality is pretty good but not amazing as well. There is a special audio mode on these speakers with DSP and it enhances the audio quality a lot but it also makes the speakers much quieter.

title: Great Speaker
text: I just received this speaker as a gift and I could not be more pleased. I charged the unit for a few hours and have been listening to music for a few days straight. I have paired the system to two iPhones and one iPad and had no issues at all. I did update the software on the system and it has added a few nice touches and I hope that these updates continue. The only strange thing about the device is that every time you turn it on, a very loud voice announces that the device is indeed on. It would be nice to lower the volume of the speaker's announcements, especially when it is in the office. I know that there is a silent turn on mode, but you do have to complete the process every time its turned on. Overall, I love the speaker and if they were not so expensive, I would buy a few more.

title: didn't work
text: We ordered this speaker to use with our cell phones or laptops to play music while we enjoyed sitting in the back yard. The speaker would not stay connected to any of out devices and it was very distorted. I will say I contacted the seller and got my money back promptly.

title: This is a Jambox Mini. Not a regular sized one.
text: I like the product. The speaker quality is alright. Good enough for what I need it for. If you need a larger sound I would recommend getting a larger jambox. I am also pretty upset that this did not say this was a Jambox Mini....I was expecting a larger one to be shipped and then the mini one came. It's a little misleading.

title: Mixed experience
text: I was really impressed with this little box until the left driver stopped working few days into my first international trip and instead started making crackling sound. Customer support was easy to deal with and they promptly issued a RMA. I also ended up paying for return shipping. I had to call them again to check status and they told me that black color (the one I had) was back-ordered. Rather than waiting for black color, I chose the silver one. Overall, its a decent combination of sound quality, size and battery but its definitely not something I would call good value for money. + Decent sound in small package Small size makes it perfect for travelling Resonable battery life Ability to pair with 2 devices at any time - First one was a lemon Little pricey

title: Great... If Portable Is A Priority
text: The Jawbone Jambox is SMALL. But that's one of the reasons I bought it. It is well designed and seems well built. It's light on the bass and distorts at it's maximum volume, but still pretty ok. The bass response is such that, due to its light weight, it will shake itself and move around which I'm not crazy about. I look forward to experiencing the Big Jambox at some point for comparison. But I'd recommend the regular Jambox.

title: Great sound and ease of use - Battery life after 2 years is short
text: Easy to set-up, great look and sound. We didn't use the JAMBOX more than 75 times before the battery life began to shorten even after charging overnight. Unfortunately there is no replacement battery.

title: Overhyped. This is a great bluetooth speakerphone that happens to play music in stereo.
text: If sound quality is important to you, get the bigger brother version - FAR better sound quality. Or go Bose. You don't see tiny tiny stuff this small from Bose for a reason. Unless you need something this small (and it's tiny - about four decks of cards glued together) then save your money and get something that can produce enjoyable fidelity. That being said, considering how small this thing is, it does well. But it still is not that great. You'll be thinking "that sounds pretty good considering it's so small". It's like the tallest, strongest midget. Impressive, but still a midget. If sound quality matters, you'll want something that sounds great for this kind of cash. If ultra small size is the overriding factor (eg, you're hiking and have limited space in your pack) then this is a great option. Short of that, get the big jambox and be 3x happier with the sound quality. You can't make bass without size. Bose has been the leader at squeezing mountains of bass out of tiny enclosures, but there are limits to the laws of physics. Jawbone is trying, perhaps a little too hard, to turn a Mini Cooper into a Corvette in a drag race. The build quality and engineering effort that went into this is impressive. Nice controls, feels well built, and good looking. I use this primarily as a bluetooth speakerphone (blows other speakerphones away for less money) and occasionally as a "background elevator music" backfill in my office. For real jams, go with something just a little bigger and enjoy the music instead. I should also mention I got this at Costco for $140. EDIT: I have owned this for a month now and it has an annoying "feature": After battery drains down, it will shout at you "Recharge Battery Now!" every few minutes. When I push the left button to check battery level, it says "Jambox battery is about half full". First - why are you yelling at me if the battery is still half full? Second - why are you shouting at me every 3 minutes! I get it!

title: Returned it in two hours
text: I must say the sound is impressive for its size, but the Jambox just wasn't enough to keep me hooked. It has very limited bass (don't let them fool you), and although it's weighted rubber base is a nice addition, it jumps and rattles when there is any significant bass to speak of. Anyway, it's a nice device, don't get me wrong. It just doesn't have the full-bodied sound I was looking for. And it's not worth $180 (Amazon's price), much less $200 (retail price). And if you're wondering, I went ahead and spent the extra coin on the [[ASIN:B005KFONIU Bose SoundLink Wireless Mobile Speaker - Nylon]]. So far I've VERY impressed.

title: awesome little box
text: These little boxes and fill up a small room with clear sound and fairly decent bass. They are very tough, mine survived several falls including one from about 8 ft onto concrete. It bent the corner and the wire mesh cover popped off the side but popped right back in and kept playing right through the fall. This thing works great on vacations as a sound machine, plays some Jimmy Buffet at the beach or by the pool and the battery lasts forever.

title: Nice sound, works good, easy to connect
text: So we bought a Belkin F8Z492TTP Bluetooth Music Receiver to connect iPad to stereo. I had looked at several portable Bluetooth speakers and was going to buy this one, but thought the music receiver might work better. I was wrong. The music receiver had horrible reception and LOTS of static. I returned the Belkin and ended up buying this JAMBOX. It works GREAT. The sound is great, the connection was very easy, works and sounds great with wired connection and through Bluetooth. The only negative I can say is the price (little expensive), hence 4 stars instead of 5. I ended up buying from large box store (rhymes with Boxco) and will utilize its lifetime warranty if it ever breaks or does not work. This is a very nice speaker for portable sound for a portable device.

title: Fantastic speaker
text: What else did you expect from Jawbone. This speaker not only sounds great but it works with solid bluetooth link up as far as 50 feet away. A great addition for anyone looking to boost their Ipad or Iphone speaker to fill a room with quality sound. If you are looking for bigger sound that will thump a room then you need to consider this guys bigger brother. You cant go wrong with either purchase.

title: So far So Good
text: This speaker is a bit pricey and although stylish the "Blue Wave" color definitely appears a bit darker in person than the picture portrays. The sound quality isn't as rich and detailed as the high end beats headphones I use, but the four sided design seems to allow for great acoustics. I can listen to music in the shower very easily without strain or distortion, and it really does seem to fill the room naturally. It has a nice rubberized finish on the top and bottom, and syncing is very easy. All around a great product.

title: Jawbone JAMBOX
text: The Jawbone JAMBOX has a number of nice features, including its sound quality, portability, ease of use and long-lasting battery. I do have two knocks against it. 1) It will occasionally drop the connection with my iPhone for no apparent reason. 2) I wish it produced a bit more volume. That's not an especially reasonable wish considering its size, however I swear that when I first heard the JAMBOX on display at a store inside the Minneapolis-St. Paul airport that unit produced considerably more volume than mine.

title: It Was a Gift
text: This was for my mother. She has it now and she loves it. I was just out at her house yesterday and it's so loud for such a small speaker.

title: Very nice portable bluetooth speaker
text: I have used this for about two years now to play music from iPhones and iPads and am still very pleased with it. It has a small form factor, great looks, decent battery life, puts out good sound and gets plenty loud enough for listening throughout 1-2 rooms of the house or for small gatherings. It sounds best in "Live Audio" mode which I believe is supposed to be 3D sound but it limits the max volume greatly. It gets quite a bit louder in "normal" mode but the sound becomes a bit muddier and isn't as crisp. My only issue with the Jambox is that with bassier music, it tends to "dance" around on smooth, flat surfaces and can fall if placed on a table or countertop. I have remedied this by placing on a towel or other vibration-absorbing item and then it won't move from its resting place. Overall this was a great investment and Jawbone seems to provide outstanding customer support and plenty of firmware updates. BTW- If you need something that can be cranked to 11, you might want to look at the Big Jambox.

title: Eyeopening, ot should i say, ear-opening! How ...
text: Eyeopening, ot should i say, ear-opening! How extremely helpful this is for anyone who can't quite hear the volume on the Ipad.

title: One glaring issue
text: It works great, it sounds great, it hooks up to my phone instantly, and it lasts a long time on one charge. But I only gave it 3 stars because of one glaring issue: the system noises (eg, the noise it makes when you adjust the volume, or the startup sound it makes when you turn it on) are incredibly loud (basically full volume) and there is no way to adjust them. You can hold down the "minus" button on top when turning on the speaker and that will mute the startup sound entirely, but there's no functionality for making it quieter. Very annoying.

title: Five Stars
text: Perfect for teenager to take places with friends. Great quality, price, and sound.

title: Jambox vs. Monster iClarityHD
text: The Jambox is built solid. It is heavy and with the rubber armor, it is perfect for any outdoor or other active work environment where it may be subjected to the elements or dust, etc. It sounds pretty good as well, it connects easily via Bluetooth and the speakerphone works well and sounds clear. With that being said, it does have some drawbacks when compared to the Monster iClarityHD. First off, the Monster sounds better. The Jambox sounds a bit muffled compared to the Monster and the highs on the Monster are much clearer. Secondly, the Monster also remotely controls your device, allowing you to fast forward, pause and skip songs if you are paired with an MP3 player. I use either my HTC Incredible phone or Motorola Xoom tablet with both and the ability to easily pause or skip is important if I am in mixed company such as at work, where some of today's songs can be a bit "adult" in their lyrics. And thirdly is the price. $66.00 vs $166.00 is a big difference. The Monster is not delicate but it does not have the rubberized protection the Jambox does so the Jambox will be relegated to outdoor activity or when I am working in my garage. The Monster will be for my desk at work or home. One significant drawback on the Monster is the shape and button layout. Front to back, the shape is almost a trapezoid rather than square or rectangular (it is also smaller than the Jambox).The speakers are in the front. This makes it more difficult to pick up since the tendency is to span your fingers across the two sides to pick it up since the sides are flat and you don't want to damage the speakers (you won't but psychologically it crosses your mind). Unfortunately, this is where the controls are and invariably, you will wind up squeezing them. Normally you will never move the Monster but I find myself moving from room to room during the day and I like to take it with me. They both are great but given the differences, I recommend the Monster.[[ASIN:B004E10KI8 Jawbone JAMBOX (Black Diamond)]][[ASIN:B003TFEHMU Monster ClarityHD Precision Micro Portable Bluetooth Speaker (MBL CLY SPKR BT)]]

title: max volume is a joke
text: i really wanted this to be the one. but its not. pairing with a mac is not 100% reliable...and the max volume is nonexistent. its like a whisper. could never imagine having this play at a party and people could hear the sound coming out. pretty awful. save your money towards another bluetooth speaker. this device severely lacks an appropriate VOLUME. its a joke. even with max volume up, i still need to hold it to my ear to hear FULL sound.

title: Phenomenal sound quality and easy to set up
text: I ordered this speaker after using one at a friend's house. The sound is very clear--I've played different genres of music as well as podcasts, etc and it's been great for all of them. It charged in about 2 hours and bluetooth setup was a snap. I've used it for an hour or two each day since it arrived about a week ago and I haven't had to recharge it yet. There's a battery icon that shows its charge next to the bluetooth symbol on my iphone, which is still around 2/3 full. I'm not sure if it does that on other smartphones, but it really appreciate that feature. The one thing I don't like is that even if I set my phone on silent when I go to bed (while listening to music via the speaker) my ringtone plays at full volume when someone calls. I've started putting my phone on airplane mode at bedtime but I wish there were a way to disable that function.

title: Charger cable stopped working, sometimes just won't turn on
text: I love the size and the shape and the sound...when it works. The charger cable that came with it stopped working within a few days. I bought a new (standard USB to micro USB) and charged it. It would say "nearly full" for several days and then suddenly be dead even tho I hadn't used it. Seems to be better now although still a bit random on perforcmance. Annoying since it's expensive and I thought it would be a higher quality product.

title: Surprisingly decent sound
text: We didn't have the money to spend on a big jambox, but this smaller one fits the bill just great. We use it daily to connect to an iPhone, Samsung Galaxy S III, and Nexus 7, and it works like a champ.

title: Customer Service Great!
text: I had purchased a red jam box for my daughter for Christmas and had some issues with it and expressed my disappointment with the product. Right away a representative (Jessica) from Amazon/Bluetekusa asked to take care of it which they are in the process of doing. Like I've said before. I have never had any issues with purchases from Amazon before. The follow up and willingness to take care of their clients tells me a lot about Amazons Excellent Customer Service.

title: Big sound in a little box
text: I had been looking at these for awhile. I wondered how the sound would be from something so small. An instructor at the college I go to has one in her office and I was impressed. The sound is big and full, turning up the volume does not rattle the box or distort the sound. I have used it while I was working outside and it still sounded great. I have used it in the house next to the bed for music to sleep to and it can be turned down low enough to sleep. Well worth the money if you are looking for a small portable speaker.

title: Great sound from such a little box
text: Love this little guy. Took it on a road trip so we could watch a movie and all listen to it. Would definately buy again.

title: Love it!!!
text: I just got my jambox today...1st off I ordered it at 7pm wednesday and had it thursday afternoon (free shipping). Back to the box I kinda bought it on impulse after a few cocktails and for a change I made a great decision. I had been wanting a bluetooth speaker for awhile but just hadn't been able to pull trigger on it. It sounds great, it came with more accessories than I had anticipated. I had it working right out the box. Only dislike...the packaging. It looks cool but getting into it was the most complicated part with the set up. And all that plastic seems wasteful. So top things I like about it are ease of use, sound, and size.

title: music on the go
text: This speaker's battery lasts forever it seems. Great bass and ease of use too! I love the size of the speaker.

title: San Diegan
text: Love this speaker--it's great in every way.... Bluetooth it to your smartphone, turn on Pandora, and enjoy... or, connect your old iPod to it via auxillary cord (cord included). If a call comes into your phone, it functions as a speaker phone. Awesome sound quality and great size/design ... I love it!!!

title: Great little speaker for camping, backyard, kids playroom
text: This is a great little speaker that fits easily in a cargo pant pocket. Good sound and good connectivity. I wouldn't necessarily replace your main sound system with it, but it is great for camping/backyard or dragging around the house when you want some music.

title: Not enough boom for my buck
text: I went on vacation with someone that had the BIG jambox and it was very convenient and sounded great. I love the idea that any bluetooth compatible device can play their music on it. I bought the smaller version thinking maybe it would weight up to my ihome auxilary speakers. I'm not impressed for the size. The bluetooth would lose connection and it would be annoying to have to walk in the room to reconnect it and the sound wasn't as loud as my little ihome speakers with the aux component. I returned it and am going to look into the logitech version I saw a few people discuss in some of the other reviews.

title: Stellar Sound
text: Keep in mind that this little brick of a speaker is SMALL. Nonetheless it pumps out an amazing amount of undistorted sound. I'm very pleased with this purchase. It syncs easily and stays sync'd, the sound is great, the build quality is excellent. It comes with a protective case. At full retail I found it pricey, but at a decent sale price - appx. 25% off, it was well worth the $$. I plan on buying another ... the first was for my wife.

title: Fun
text: Great quality and it really makes the sound on my computer so much louder! I can actually hear movies now and I love plugging my iPod into it and jamming out while I suntan outside! No more tanlines from my headphones! The battery life is really long as well.

title: So cute!
text: This is such a pretty color. The size is nice and compact. I got it for my daughter as a gift, so I can't comment on the sound quality, but I am sure she will get a lot of use our of it in her dorm room.

title: Think twice
text: This is the second one I have purchased. The charging port on the first one malfunctioned and could no longer be charged. This was after 6 months of use. Now the second one does not hold a charge. I would not recommend this product

title: Great sound, not so great quality... You don't get what you paid for!
text: When I first thought about paying $150 for a speaker, let alone one this small I was a bit skeptical! When I got it home and out of the box I was impressed with how easy it was to connect and start using (with my iPhone 4s) and the sound from such a small device honestly blew me away! I was pleased for quite some time; I'd say about 6 months. AND THEN; The USB port literally fell out of position inside of the unit making it completely un-chargeable and now a $150 paperweight! I could see if I had paid $20-$30 for the thing then whatever, I would have chucked it aside and moved on. But for the price I paid for this unit, it should not be made so cheaply jawbone!!! I looked online for some help or support, and a quick google search later and you will find out that this is a *VERY* common problem that happen to just about 80% of these units! I've also seen a lot of comments about the batteries frying up as well. I wrote in to customer service and they were no help at all, telling me if I don’t have a receipt for the unit they won’t fix or replace it. I’m currently deployed in the desert and I’m not going to have a 6 month old receipt readily available if I even saved it at all, I would have to check and see if I placed it in the box. ALL IN ALL: For the price you pay there should be MUCH, MUCH better quality assurance for these products and these issues should NOT happen! Not as much as they do! A small part of my duty in the military is QA'ing, not with products but is services... but still, it ticks me off when I see QA issues like this! I would never buy another jawbone jam box and I encourage others to look elsewhere for a better product then this rip off! JBL makes good quality units, so does bose. Get yourself something worth your money! Thanks for stealing my money jawbone! :)

title: Awesome little speaker
text: I had a chance to test this out and was not prepared to be so impressed with it! While it's not going to beat the Bose / Beats systems for volume & sound quality at higher volumes they are considerably larger & don't have the conf call feature. The bass & overall clarity at lower / normal volumes is very impressive. I used it for a week in several different environments and found that because of it's size I just threw it in my bag and ended up using it more often as a result. My other systems are great but you have to "plan" to take them with you & you know you have them! It worked right out of the box & was a breeze to set-up & use. The sound quality in my office / hotel / deck & car was awesome - again, not going to provide music for a party but as a tiny, ultra portable speaker it was excellent. Most of the time it was at a level that wouldn't annoy the people in the office / hotel room next door but it carried well & didn't sound small or tinny. The speakerphone function worked very well too. I travel a lot for work & found that because of it's size I didn't mind (or notice) carrying it and I enjoyed listening to music more often on the road. Sitting in my hotel listening to music and making calls, etc was great. Battery life was great, I charged it at the start of the test & a week later when I had to return the system it still had about 33% remaining. All in all I didn't want to give it back after the test & I'm keeping my eye out for Black Friday deals so I can buy one of my very own soon!

title: Nice
text: Pleased with it. Bluetooth works well, easy to connect to my android tablet. Sound quility is very good for it size. Live audio is useless, way to low to use on this unit to enjoy. Over all nice unit, with the lower price for new and specially for a used one.

title: Great product!
text: I love these! My boyfriend and I each have one (in different colors). They work great and are easy to use.

title: It's great
text: I love the Jambox, I use it in my office at work and love the sound quality that I have. wonderful..

title: These are great speakers! They are easy to use and travel ...
text: These are great speakers! They are easy to use and travel well!

title: Fantastic sound for the size
text: I was nervous about spending 200 bucks for something this small but I really needed something compact, I was reluctant to use bluetooth because I always seem to have problems getting and keeping connection but I am sick of speaker plugs and wires going bad. I decided to chance it based on the good reviews and am glad I did. This thing is incredible, I listen to classical and this fills the room as loud, louder in fact, than you would ever want with undistorted quality sound across the full range. The bluetooth connection also has worked flawlessly. Best small speakers I have ever heard, in fact unless you need to drown out loud noise in a party room or a loud work environment or want to feel the room vibrate I don't know why you would ever need any other speakers.

title: Made the son-in-law very happy.
text: Awesome sound, compact looks good. This made my son-in-law very happy as he opened it up Christmas day. It was like watching a little kid. What a great buy.

title: Basic Aux Port Messed Up Design
text: The auxiliary port somehow is messed up on all Jamboxes. I don't know how they messed up a technology that is several decades old but they managed it over at Jawbone. I personally will not buy another one of these nor will I recommend anyone else to buy one of these at it lasted a few months before it just died completely and won't work. Warranty covers it but it'll just die in a couple months again. Jambox should recall all of these because the aux port seems to disable the bluetooth and it would come to mind to put out a firmware update that overrides the aux port but they don't and they leave us to deal with this problem. Please do not buy this. Look at the issues online. Google "Jambox Bluetooth Static" and see jsut how many people experience this and how little Jawbone helps with the issue

title: Big sound, good battery

title: Does what I want but bluetooth volume not great
text: Puts out a lot of sound for a little device. I use it with my iphone in the kitchen, the bathroom, in the garage, or really anywhere I want some music. I bought a refurbished one, so the price was great (about half of the normal price). I am not an audiophile, didn't do any side-by-side comparisons with other similar products. But for decent sound quality and volume, in a portable and convenient package, I am reasonably happy. It also looks cool. My only complaint is that when I connect my iphone via bluetooth, it doesn't get very loud. So I don't use bluetooth anymore and instead use the cable and the volume goes much higher. I took off 2 stars for this because having to use and keep track of the cable connection does affect the convenience.

title: Not worth the money

I tried using different settings imported from the computer app interface, but they are all too gimmicky. Any positive reviews of this device are a scam. Do not buy this product, you will be a total sucker if you do and you will be wasting money. I'm not joking, do not buy this product, it is a complete waste of money, yes you too

title: Just doesn't cut it.
text: I purchased a JAMBOX from a local store so that I could compare with other speakers and return easily if needed. Well, I only kept the JAMBOX one day. That's how long it took to find out that it's sound just didn't cut it. It may be cool looking, very small and light weight, function well; but, if you're like me, you want good sound. It sounds almost muted. Not a well projected, clear sound at all. When I compare to the Sharkk BoomBox (which costs less than 1/2 the price) the Sharkk blows it away. The Sharkk is very clear, a nice amount of highs and bass, and at least 50% louder. I really like the JAMBOX at very low volume, but that's it. There's simply no comparison to the Sharkk for "overall" sound. Again, I really like the Sharkk. I also like the JBL Charge and Flip 2 much better than the JAMBOX. Really, about everything I've heard in this price range sounds better than the JAMBOX. There are much better choices than the JAMBOX. Don't waste your time on it.

title: Great little gadget
text: I am so glad I got this and I use it all the time. I do wish it would go a wee bit louder, but I still love it.

title: Great little wireless speaker.
text: The JAMBOX is a wonderful wireless speaker which transmits music from your iphone, ipad, or computer from a distance so you can hear your music in the next room. There are two sizes. You'd need the larger size for outdoors, but the smaller one works well for me indoors.

title: This speaker is excellent. Big
text: This speaker is excellent. Big, deep sound, battery lasts a long time and there have been now problems syncing devices.

title: Great Products + THE GREATEST Customer Service
text: I purchased this speaker for a Xmas gift to myself, and I am very happy about it. (I did not buy it via Amazon, but another retailer matched the price so I could enjoy the great price.) The sound is very clear, it was very easy to pair with my gadgets (I have an Android smartphone, an Android tablet, iPad, Win8.1 Laptop -- all work beautifully with this little speaker.) It's a small speaker, but powerful enough to fill my bedroom with vivid audio. At first, I had some connection problem with my Win 8.1 laptop, so I wrote a question to Jawbone's customer service via e-mail. Oh my gosh, what a thorough response and follow-up, I was impressed!! I wish all the American corporations could keep up with the quality of Jawbone's customer service!! I also own Jawbone's ERA headset, another great product I cannot live without. text: I really have loved using this. I travel a lot and am always looking for things that are small and pack a punch. This speaker does. I was surprised when I got it, because it was so sturdy. I find I am using it at home. I link it to my blue tooth at home, and set in on a shelf outside my shower so I can listen to my music clearly without blasting out my neighbors. I didn't buy it for the speaker phone, but have used it that why when the phone rang while I was listening to music from my phone. I was surprised at the clarity of the sound on calls. title: So much fun!
text: This is a great little speaker! My only complaint is that my Mac won't connect to it, and that might be because I have an older version OS. Just loud enough for regular usage, I'd say it might be too quiet if you wanted to use it outside or in a crowd.

title: It was worth my $150 and its grown on me.
text: I am rewriting my review. Originally I stated that I would not purchase again. Well, after using the Jambox for many months, it has grown on me and it was worth my $150 (Holiday Sale) Below is my updated review: Pros: Attractive design Has amazing Small-Space-filling-sound (not room filling) using LiveAudio for small spaces with the speaker in the proper position (tends to vary based on the dynamics of your space). A good example of this small space is your office/cubicle (but then why not use headphones?) and the bathroom while doing your hair/makeup/shaving, craft area. Battery life is great. I estimate that I can get at least 6 hours of play. Lets just say I am surprised at how little I have to charge it. Cons: Not exactly the sound it is hyped up to have. Speaker phone? Don't plan on having a conversation unless you pick up the speaker and hold it in front of your mouth. Do not purchase this item with the expectation of speakerphone. --YOU MUST SETUP YOUR JAMBOX-- Make sure you upgrade the software. It comes with an option to toggle the Live Audio setting by pressing + and - at the same time. This is useful because if you are chillin in a small space and do not want to blast music, Live Audio sounds pretty good. If you are in a larger room , you can turn Live Audio off to get more volume. --A NOTE ON JAMBOX SERVICE-- One day I went to plugin my Jambox and the USB plug was removed from the circuit board. I read several blogs bashing Jambox for this. Well, I contacted them and the promptly responded and agreed to do a return. The return DID take about 3 weeks but they did honor the return with no hassle. I am not sure if they are sending me a new one or a refurb. I have dearly missed my Jambox. One of my favorite usages for the Jambox is to place it across my living room but directly in front of me while I work on my laptop. I use the Live Audio setting. The sound is amazing (in that spot). If only I could bluetooth my TV audio feed to the Jambox. Perfecto.

title: Huge sound from a little box!
text: Great highs and lows and enough sound to fill an ordinary size room. The battery lasts a long time, plenty to get throug a whole work shift.

title: 6 long years of awesome service. My review says it all.
text: I felt it was finally time to write a review on this speaker as it finally gave out on me. I have used this speaker every day at work for 6 years now, and it finally gave out on me 3 days ago. I believe it might be an issue with the amplifier, as the speakers will still play music, but even with the volume all the way up, you can hardly hear anything. I’m not at all upset though. I can’t beleive it lasted so long and stood up through everything. Due to a few job changes over the last 6 years, as well as life in general, this thing has seen it’s fair share of environments and climates and then some. This includes surviving in the intense heat, vibration, an innumerable amount of drops, and metal particles from a metal shop. It’s seen countless coffee spills and desk height drops in office jobs. It survived sitting pool side and getting splashed (even though it wasn’t intended to be water proof). It’s survived the heat of the summers, and the freezing weather and rain of the winters and everything in between. It’s survived hikes, camping trips, I mean you name it and this poor speaker has been through it. And never once did it give me even a hint of trouble until 3 days ago. Not sure why it finally gave out, but this thing is so beyond worth every single penny. I’m sad that it’s been discontinued, but hopefully the jambox “big” and “mini” hold up like this one did. I’ve never had this kind of reliability out of any speaker I’ve ever owned or bought for someone else. Through thick and thin this thing was ready to deliver crystal clear music. I would highly recommend to anyone at any time. You won’t regret it. This thing was built like a tank even though it wasn’t intended to be a “rugged” speaker. It’s also worth noting that the battery life is still just as good as it was on day 1.

title: Did I buy a prototype?
text: Bought this with very high expectations. Nothing was easy about it, including the charge port breaking on the third charge. First, it is heavy. Portable if you are putting it in your car. The volume and on-off controls mysteriously hard to use. The sound doesn't live up to the hype, tinny, no base, like a sick canary. So I got two rounds of the battery on it over two months and that was it. I notice the price is down 40% since I bought it. Not sure it is worth any price.

title: great little box

title: Mediocre sound not even worth the $125 I paid at amazon
text: Very suprised..A few years back a coworker of mine had one of these and the sound was amazing. Finally decided to drop a couple of dollars on this devise and was very dissapointed by the sound quality. I suspect the specifications of the original version are not being adhered too hence the mediocre sound. Don't get me wrong the sound is good but definitelly not worth $200 not even $150 I will not recommend paying more than a $100 for ths speaker. If you want roomfilling sound go with bose....

title: Nice design - good value - just plain slick
text: It is a very good remote Bluetooth speaker with solid features. Good quality for a small box and plays well in a personal space ... even the bass is strong. The sound will fill a very large living room or conference room. Easily pairs with iPhone and iPad as well as Blackberry. Playing music through Pandora or iTunes is an effortless setup and the sound is amazingly very good for a unit this small. If a phone call comes in, it interrupts the music and turns into a remote mic/speaker for multi-person conference calls ... good call quality. It also carries "personalities" that are downloadable through the MYtalk online site ... just for fun. I can fit it into my PC bag and it travels well. Good battery life. The top and bottom are cushioned protecting it against falls and bumps. The grill looks professional for a polished look. I can take this to an executive meeting and "wow" clients while the JAMBOX blasts out audio from a presentation. I can also take this to my girl's birthday party and play their favorite music from my iPhone. It will go to the beach when the weather gets warmer. I can hook it up to a non-Bluetooth iPod with a cable so it's very versatile. I also have the JAWBONE Icon so the JAMBOX completes my mobile toolkit along with the iPhone. It has what I look for - good design, high quality, and solid performance. No complaints ... its a rock star with a cool attitude. Great innovation in a small package. [[ASIN:B004E10KI8 Jawbone JAMBOX (Black Diamond)]]

title: Great Sound from a small speaker
text: I was looking at several different bluetooth speakers and decided on Jawbone. I was not disappointed! I really like that you can get it in different colors and I like that you can pair with different devices. I have this at my desk and I can listen to music without bothering others around me or I can blast it when I am alone. Even at a high volumne the sound quality is great! So far I have found that I can use for several days without having to charge it but when it gets low on battery charge it tells you so it just doesn't turn off without warning. Love it!

title: Great sound but a few cautions
text: Although I didn't buy this from Amazon I thought I would write a few notes. The sound is really great for the size as most others noted. No complaints there. The only down side is the battery doesn't hold a charge very long. And here's a surprise. This little guy is built like a tank! How do I know? Twice now while listening to Pandora through my ipod the thing vibrated off of my work bench and fell on the floor. No problems. Just be careful with the heavy base type music. Once was with a reggae station. I now position it no matter where I'm listening so it can't crash. A 4 star for the battery life.

title: Regret the purchase since day one.
text: I bought this a while ago, and I never was happy with it. The volume isn't much louder than my iPhone and it is a huge pain to setup when you are not using iOS devices or more than one device. I typically use it for a couple things, I use it on my desktop via bluetooth usb dongle when I play games with my son as I normally use headphones and do not have speakers. It typically takes a few tries to get it to sync and I usually have to remove the current pairing to get it to work again. Sometimes it just reconnects but many times I have to futz with it for a few minutes. On iOS, I have similar problems but not as bad but still a good 50% chance it will need to be removed and re-paired. In a short time the speakers started getting heavy static when turning it on and playing. Got to turn the volume down a bit to eliminate. Even at lower volumes it has static issues when first turning on and getting paired. Many times the volume stops responding and it is very low volume and can't turn it up. The only solution I have found is to press the volume button for a long time until it goes to mute, then it starts working again. But this doesn't always do it. Sometimes I just can't get it responding to volume controls.

title: I love it!
text: I am upgrading from a 3 CD/Radio/Connects to any Device Wall Unit to this fabulous mini stylish sound system. In a 1 BR apartment, the sound is AMAZING. Easy to use too!

title: Great Sound but poor battery life
text: I was thinking about buying this for awhile then on Black Friday it was $50 off so I went for it. For my first bluetooth speaker I made a good choice. PRO: It was so easy to set up and use and the sound coming out of it was great. I went to the mfg website and did perform the free update and personalized how it talks to me which I think is a pretty cool and fun feature. There not much more that I can say on the Pro side that has not been written before. CON: Does not hoid a charge. I charged my Jawbox up and did not use it for a few days. When I did it lost half of the charge already. If I did not use it for a week I had to charge it before I could use it. When you do use it the play time seems to vary some days I get more hours out of play than other. Second- The more bluetooth devices you paired with it the more it affects the battery life. You can only pair one at a time which is fine with me but as the mfg states for each device Jawbone was paired with it remembers and that takes away from the battery life. I have only one device paired wth it. I did read and have not tried yet paring it with my phone and using it as a speakerphone it sound like this cold be a nice feature

title: Living In The Outdated Past
text: Soundmatters was the pioneer that developed the technology of a micro speaker and had the FoxL speakers (also very pricey) and Jawbone was licensed to make this overpriced Jambox. The technology was a flexing rubber on an airtight box driven by the two built in speakers and it was cutting edge in 2010. Bluetooth speakers has evolved and these guys refuse to get over it. When that vibrating rubber ripped from my Jambox I could not believe the price of fixing it. Don’t get sucked in by this device. A lot of better speakers out there to choose from.

title: The product is fine and with customer service like this
text: I was going to only rate 4 stars as the a/c adapter was left out of the box. However, with one phone call, this was rectified and an adapter was shipped to me at no charge. The product is fine and with customer service like this, deserves 5 stars.

title: not good

title: Loved my Jambox, until it broke
text: I loved my Jambox, until it broke. I had it for a year and it performed well. Great sound, great volume, portable and held a charge well. It was so strong in the bass that it would wriggle off my table unless I put a cloth or something underneath it. One day when I went to plug in the power cord, the cord would just fall out - it wasn't connecting to anything inside the unit. It hadn't fallen recently or anything, just suddenly the cord would not fit. I contacted the Jawbone people and then saw the reviews and tons of comments on their forums about the exact same thing. The mini USB port inside the speaker is just glued in and easily breaks off inside the unit. Jawbone never responded to me of course, which was disappointing. If someone could start a repair business they would clean up because I would love to have mine working again. I found a YouTube video on how to make the repair and a friend of mine (her Jambox broke the same way a week before mine) are going to buy a soldering kit and give it a shot. It's a real shame because I loved my little speaker.

title: Excellent little portable speaker - working years later
text: Excellent little speaker. Don't expect supper load sound or deep base but for the size this little this is amazing. Very portable and durable. Been using our for years now regularly and still rock'n

title: Never worked

title: Two Stars

title: Great little speaker!
text: Bought this as a gift for someone 2 years ago - still going great, he loves it and uses it everyday!

title: Jambox should have recalled this unit
text: I bought this as a gift for my wife. It has a problem playing unless you put a headphone jack in the receptacle, just exactly right. Seems to me, you shouldn't need to do that, and I see a number of other people have complained about it as well. Now I have to go digging around to see if there's some kind of fix for this, or failing that, figure out how to return it. When it works, I like it. Update 2/7/13 - Since Jambox contacted me based on my review, I started preparing information about the unit to send back to Jambox. After we had put it away for about a month (just put it back in the box and let it sit that way for about a month), surprise, it works. I have no idea what is making it work now, as opposed to the last time we tried it. If I don't have any problems with it for a few months, I'll probably edit this again to raise it to 4 stars (I'll probably never give it 5, because my out of box experience was poor). Does sound good though. Update 8/30/13 - After a short period of working as it is supposed to, this device went back to refusing to output anything other than static when connected to bluetooth on any of the iDevices we use it with. We now use it primarily as a wired speaker. Can't recommend this. Update 1/21/14 - The problem has apparently been identified on the Jambox user forum. One of the users posted a fix which involves partially disassembling the unit to adjust the line out contacts so that they don't (or do) close when the headphone jack is removed. Personally, I don't think it should be necessary to disassemble a product to get it to work and Jambox should have recalled the unit with this many complaints lodged so soon after purchasing it. I have no idea if this is fixed in current units, but I'm sure not buying anything else from them.

title: I love these! I've bought 3 of them
text: I love these! I've bought 3 of them. One for me and two as gifts. The sound quality is pretty nice and the design is sleek enough.

title: Great speaker, but once it's broke it's broke
text: All the positive reviews are right, these little speakers sound wonderful and are pretty easy to use. But consider the following before buying: 1) The Jambox tends to vibrate and move around while playing music. Mine has fallen off a table top several times 2) If it falls while the charging cord is plugged in, it can cause the USB port to break off inside the Jambox. This happened to me, and an internet search indicates that it's a common issue. 3) Jawbone does not offer repairs, and "accidental damages" are not covered under warranty, so if you break it, it's a goner. It's pretty frustrating that one little piece broken renders the entire thing useless. Local electronics shops have offered to fix it for $60-150, but at that price I'd probably just buy another brand.

title: Incredible sound in a small box
text: I was skeptical of how well this might work because you can't separate the speakers for stereo sound, so I got [[ASIN:B004I8WH9W iHome Rechargeable Portable Stereo Bluetooth Speakers with Speakerphone]]. The BlueTooth interface crashed my MacBook Pro repeatedly, so I returned them and bought this. I couldn't be happier. One key to good bass is in how much displacement a speaker can undergo. These little guys can displace a lot, so they can produce a pretty heavy sound. I found that if you put them inside a shelf, open drawer, or other wood or heavy box they sound even bigger because the whole box becomes part of the system. I like the intuitive interface that relies in part on recorded voices to indicate important status changes like when it is waiting to pair with a device. Simple [+] and [-] buttons for volume control (separate from the ones on your source device) are rubberized to help reduce the likelihood of water damage. It comes with a collapsible hard/felt case to help protect it from dust and damage and protect whatever is around it. I use this with my Android phone and MacBook Pro. For the phone I just turn it on and enable BlueTooth on the phone and it switches over. For the MacBook I just turn the device on and a popup appears on my screen asking if I want to use the device. Very fast and easy. I keep this and an [[ASIN:B0039XRJ5Y Optoma PK301 Pico Pocket Projector]] in my backpack as a sort of portable theater. I've used this for about a month and am very happy with my JAMBOX so far. I haven't tried the speakerphone feature yet, so I have no feedback on this at present.

title: Suprisingly full sound for a little speaker

I compared it to my wife's HMDX Jam(Blackberry), and I have to be honest, while the Jawbone has a fuller cleaner sound, the HMDX Jam has more volume and better highs, and is a fraction of the cost. We're talking about a $120 price difference!!! I am very lucky I didn't have to buy this speaker. I won mine through a contest that Rockstar Energy Drinks did with Codemasters' Grid 2 racing game for PC. Honestly, the price they are asking for this thing on Amazon amazes me, even though they are cheaper than just about anyone else on the net or in retail, it's still just a speaker, and priced way to high for what you get. Pro's: Nice full sound, "Live Audio" option makes music sound 3D, or more like you're at a concert(this a a great feature, but has a major drawback, see con's), long battery life, ability to update software, tones and messages, hands free calling. Con's: Expensive! When "Live Audio" option is enabled, max volume seems to be cut in half, updates and setting changes must be done through Jawbone's website, and can only be done after registering, this is rather annoying, no iPhone app to configure Jambox, moderate to high volumes tends to make the unit vibrate to the point that it moves around. I had it on a glass top table and the base of the Jambox is rubberized, and it still moves around, design defect?

Because of this I will probably not buy another Jambox or recommend to others their products due to poor design of the plug. I cannot imagine that they could not see this as a very weak spot. But then again, maybe they want this to happen. Sells more products. I was told that they have resigned the Jambox to deal with this issue. title: Disappointing, and I have really, really tried
text: I've had this for a couple of years and it's wasted a lot of my time since then. The quality seems high - good heft with nice case and buttons, and the concept is great - bluetooth connection supplying portable and fine audio. When it works, the sound is pretty good, not great and not that loud. And I have found it be a very finicky item. Frequent connection issues, sound distortion and buzzing (Jawbone replaced the unit once), bluetooth distance far shorter than the "at least 33 feet" claimed (and my dog walking in the path disrupts the signal), and battery life closer to 3 hours than the 10 claimed. And if you ever go to Win 8.1, be prepared for a whole new onslaught of pain. Because of the $150 I originally paid, I have been unwilling to throw in the towel. It still looks like new, and when it works, it's nice. But if I had it to do over again, I would never have bought it - w-a-a-y too much trouble. I'm considering moving to the Bose mini, and would not buy Jawbone again, in spite of their good ratings (which I always read before a purchase). I almost considered the mini Jambox on a daily deal, but thought that would put me in the "Fool me once......." category. And while I realize that user forums are pretty much all people with problems, when I go to the Jambox forum, I find myself saying "me, too" to virtually all of the posts. Doesn't this seem like these faults should have been addressed?

title: Impressive sound from a box the size of an late 80s, early 90scellphone!
text: What's in the box? USB Cable AC adapter Case Headset cable Design Graphite body with plastic cover and base. The back is comprised of the base while the front is made of the midrange and tweeter. Three buttons on the top for power and volume. A switch on the side is for Bluetooth pairing. An internal rechargeable battery is integrated into this unit. Use Syncing the iPad was seamless. Sound quality is amazing from these speakers despite the diminutive size. I cranked it up to maximum volume without distortion. The speakers are very responsive to the changes of the iPad equalizer and the differences in sound are discernible. Whether it is pop, dance, country, jazz, classical or reggae, the sound is vibrant. I have found that sound to my ears have improved when turning the unit to the size with an equal coverage of the front and back. Another way to set it up is putting the treble/mid range facing a flat surface with the bass towards you, changing the sound dynamics. The true advantage of this comes to the portability and size. It's size and shape is reminiscent of an old 1980s or 1990s phone. It can almost fit in the pocket. Great for travel, poolside or in the office. The battery life is quite good. The trade off of the sound and smaller size size compared to my Soundfreaq is well worth the switch for me. There is a slightly better sound with respect to range of the larger set of speakers in a side by side comparison. Bear in mind, though, the Jambox is nearly one fourth the volume/scale of the Soundfreak. A major advantage is that the loudness does not decrease when the Jambox is unplugged. Conclusion Awesome set of micro-portable speakers for the price point. Highly recommend!

title: I absolutely love it, use it constantly, everywhere, anywhere...
text: After a friend recommended the UE Boom, I started doing some research. I wanted water-proof (which this is) or at least water resistant. I wanted to be able to hear some bass (doesn't come though in the Boom very well). I wanted durability, remote control, long battery life, and it needed to be loud enough to fill my back yard (75'x85') with decent sound, without needing a whole sound system. I'll admit, I bought this at Best Buy for the same price as Amazon. (Why wait two days when you can have it in 20 minutes?). While there, I got to compare it side-by-side to three or four similar products. The UE Megaboom was, without any question or debate, by far the best of anything they had to offer. The first day, I set it next to my pool, where it got splash on, rained on, handled with wet hands, all while my iPhone streamed Pandora from the safety of our house, 20 feet away. It ran for 4 hours at fairly high volume, and at the end still had an amazing 70% battery life remaining. It will pair to two Bluetooth devices, so both my wife and I have our iPhones paired to it, and it works beautifully. We use the apps on our phones to turn it on remotely, which is a great feature, making it easily for the speaker to know which device to pair to. Volume is controlled by either the phone or the buttons on the speaker. The only things I find myself wishing for are a track forward button and an output for charging my phone. Other than that, this is PERFECT product. It goes to the pool, to the beach, and hangs out in the shower, or wherever else you go. The Megaboom is still small enough it will fit into larger-sized cup holders, while the Boom is about the size of a soda can.
