Cons: These are much bigger than I thought they'd be and I have small ears, so it took some playing with to find a combination of cups and wings that would work for me. They still lean some and I have to adjust them every now and then, but they do stay in now. I would *not* use these while jogging.

title: Very nice for the price.
text: This was my first experience with wireless earbuds and I am very pleased. The sound quality is very good and they are pretty comfortable.

title: Awesome ear buds
text: Awesome ear buds, they fit nice, battery last a long time great noise canceling

title: Overall good purchase with some minor issues
text: These headphones have been pretty good. I haven't gotten used to the fact that there is no "off" button-- so sometimes even when they are in their case, but still connected to my phone via bluetooth, I'll get a call and I won't be able to hear the caller because they are connected and the voice is coming through them. The left one also doesn't always seem to charge like the right one does which is kind of a bummer. But overall they have worked for what I need them to do.

title: Good but one flaw
text: Sound and battery are pretty good on these but the upper rubber sleeve will not stay in place and is constantly falling off when I go to take them off or put them in , very annoying... also strange controls

title: Not the best Anker product
text: The audio quality is not the best, microphone gain sucks. My callers have a hard time hearing me.

title: Great sound bad ear holder
text: It's too bad these rubber ear holders won't stay on the earbud!! I wear these at night and would be great if they would stay there.

title: Decent, but they fall out often
text: Pros: They are decently priced compared to other bluetooth earbuds on the market, and fulfill the purpose I bought them for (working out at the gym). The sound quality is decent for music and audiobooks. The bass is great and volume capacity goes beyond what I can tolerate (for folks who like it REAL LOUD). The battery life is EXCEPTIONAL; both the ear buds and the case hold a great charge, and they re-charge quickly! It comes with several sizing options to cover a range of different ear sizes. Cons: The biggest source of frustration for me is that they need constant adjusting and fall out often. This is both during workouts, and while casually walking around the house. The buttons on the ear buds are hard to press while they are in the ear, and sometimes press too deep into the ear causing a bit of discomfort (this may be just a personal fit issue). With phone calls there is a constant grainy sound in the background...its not a deal breaker, but it is noticeable. The ear buds have spontaneously powered off while in use 2x over the course of the last 3 weeks with approximately 3-4 hours of use 4 days a week. I had to reset them by placing them back in the charging case and taking them back out again for them to turn back on. I have read that these earbuds are water/sweat resistant, but have not attempted to find out if this is true. Will update my review if/when I do. Overall, these are decent, and get the job done...I just have to be willing to constanely re-adjust them while in use.

title: Use them every day.
text: Fit well, have never worried that they would fall out. Phone runs out of battery before they have.

title: Not for phone bluetooth
text: I wanted these to be worn for phone calls. it said in the description that wearing only one I would be able to hear the caller & yet still hear what's going on around me, that really wasn't true. My biggest complaint would be the caller had a hard time hearing & understanding me.

title: Excellent sound quality, and customer Service!
text: For the price, I am impressed. The battery life feels endless. I use them almost every day while commuting, and I charge them every week and 1/2. I use my ear buds for music, YouTube, and Podcasts, and they sound great. The bass is incredible, voices sound rich and clear, and I can hear every instrument like I'm in the studio myself. They have non active noise canceling just by wearing them with a good fit. With music at really loud volumes, you can't hear outside noises. My only complaint is that after 6 Months, the left ear bud unexpectedly stopped working at full volume, but I reached out to anker and they sent my replacement buds at no cost. Additionally, the blue tooth connectivity can but painfully slow at times. They take a while to connect after you take them out the case, even after they're paired with your phone. Overall, at less than $100 you're getting the same sound quality, and battery life, if not better, as premium earbuds.

title: Great sound, terrible fit.
text: The silicone sleeves that come with these are always falling off or shifting making them very uncomfortable to wear. The sound is great for the price.

title: Almost but not quite
text: These things are amazing. The sound is nice, full and rich and most importantly, they don't slip out of my ears while running! The only downside is you can't replay a song or skip to the next one from them, which is really an odd omission on the part of the manufacturer. Clearly then, someone on the design team was asleep at the wheel. Rats.

title: Best headphones, last 9hr, no water/sweat issues
text: I bought these for long bike rides and workouts and now also use them over my AirPods for work calls. I’ve used them everyday for close to six months now, usually for multiple hours per day. Case last surprisingly long and recharges the ear buds quick. Wore them during a 9hr mtb race and they never died, have done multiple 5-6 hr rides with music the whole time. Seem to hold up well to sweat as no issues yet. Big fan of these! Update, after a year and I’d guess 1,000+ hours of usage they still work great. Recently tried the larger wings and helps block outside noise.

title: They Won't Stay in Your Ear
text: I was in love with these but I knew I should use them a bit before writing a review. I use these for exercising so I like how they were water (sweat) proof, the fit at first was very snug in my ear, and the sound quality was pretty good. The mic was hit or miss and I would put it in the middle of the road, some are better and some are worse but the thing that killed it for me was after about 2-3 weeks of using them the "custom" ear pieces (I never changed mine) kept slipping off! This means while I was doing my running the buds were constantly coming loose and falling out. It made me so sad and for $50 I was hoping it would have lasted a LOT longer. But with all its nice little features (I like the charging box!) it does me no good if it won't stay in my ear. Great idea, poor execution. I'm so bummed.

title: Everything is great except for the wings
text: I love everything about these earbuds except for the rubber wings. The earbuds sound and look great, they are comfortable, they stay in my ears, they don't irritate my piercings, and I haven't had any problem with pairing. The only problem, which is a huge problem, is that the rubber wings do not stay on. They slip out of place making the earbuds either fall out or twist around. I can't figure out a way to make them stay attached short of super glue. It's a real shame because these are otherwise wonderful earbuds.

title: Good sound, but the earmolds won't stay put
text: I have a pair of Samsung Galaxy Buds that I really like, but I needed a second pair of exercise-compatible buds for travel. I decided to give these Ankers a try. These sounds as good as the Galaxies, and are just as comfortable, and have some functionality that the Samsungs don't (volume control, equalizer). I love that I can also invoke Siri with the push of a button. What drives me batty is that the ear molds (not the part that goes into the ear canal, but the part that locks the buds into the ear) simply will not stay put. They pop off when putting the earbuds in, or taking them out. There's a tiny tab intended to hold them in place, but it doesn't do the job. I'm going to have to find something to glue these things on, hopefully in a way that won't do any damage, cause irritation, etc. Sad, but this reduces my rating from 5 stars to 3.

title: They are good for the price, but have frustrations.
text: I'm overall glad that I purchased these I guess. They give good sound quality, more than I had imagined I was going to get. And their battery life has been perfect for me. However I'm left with a few pain points that are probably going to have me searching for a different kind next time I need buds. * When you put them back in the case, they don't turn off. My phone keeps connected to them and I have to hold down their buttons for ten seconds to turn them off. * They lack a 'go back' or 'restart' a track feature.

title: Didn't Last a Month...
text: Left earbud stopped working after a few weeks. I returned these and got Sony earbuds. I know they will work. Don't buy the cheap ones! They wont last.

title: Great Wireless Headphones
text: Sound quality is great and comfortable. Easy pairing with my iPhone. I recommend

title: Love the sound, not the mic
text: Pros: Battery life, single bud option, charging case, connects automatically within seconds Cons: mic... No one can hear me on calls :/

title: Excellent, with a flaw
text: Excellent sound and even better comfort. For the price, these are pretty amazing. UPDATE- after using these almost every day for a few weeks, I gotta knock it down a bit. First the pros, they sound great. Hold a decent charge. Not too uncomfortable if you're keeping them in less than about 4 hours or so. Now the cons, and I have to say it's those little silicone wings to help keep them in your ear. After any activity where you might be sweating, they'll start to slip, and if you have to take them out of your ear, they'll fall off, then you have to put them back on, and they'll slip again. Pretty annoying more than anything.

title: Good product, good seller
text: I like the fit of these and they stay in my ears (unlike the others I have tried in the past). I had a problem with the right earbud as it kept telling me the battery was low and it would shut off. I reset the earbuds per the instructions and they work great!

title: These are great, but...
text: To turn them off, you have to hold the button for 8 seconds. That's a little long, but tolerable. The issue is that 3 seconds, it brings up voice activation, which is extremely annoying. If a 3 second hold turned these off, they would be 5 stars

title: Big sound for little price.
text: I followed the quick start guide and adjusted nothing. The default ear pieces fit perfectly. I hobby roast coffee beans and have a sizable coffee roaster and it can be loud. I put these in, they block the coffee roaster noises some but I can still hear the crack of the beans or an opened or closed door noise near me. I can have the sound on 25% and hear the music perfectly. Great bass and mid-range for all types of music. The wireless charging is a plus as well. The ear pieces magnetically click into case, so you know they are secure and ready to charge. I have never owned another set of wireless earbuds to compare these to, but I see no need to buy any other set at this time. I am very happy with them. Ease of use, and high quality sound.

title: Anker quality
text: These are great earbuds. Anker products are always great quality. And they actually work with my phone. 10/10 stars

title: Ok finally a good pair of ear buds
text: A pretty good alternative to the usual name brands. First the likes of this item. Battery Life is amazing. On one charge tbey can last up to 10 hours depending on volume. The fit is to the point so it stays secure in your ear and eliminates outside noise. These buds feel pretty sturdy too. What I dont like is the EQ. You literally dont know which eq setting you are using. Secondly the battery notification when you firt put the ear buds on doesnt specify the actual amount of batter life, it just says battery level High, the thing is this will repeat after 3 hours of use, so u dont know if its 80 percent left or 70 percent left. Now the so so part. The sound is ok. Nothing that puts other buds to shame. The bass is eh, you don really hear the boom in the speakers like some other brands. And the EQ really doesnt show a difference between sounds which can be annoying because you may want an eq setting for a song type. The ear cushion that is suppose to secure it in places comes out alot, requiring you to re add every time you take the buds out. In all. Its pretty good. If Bass and eq settings arent a big issue for you then this is the best bet. Battery life is amazing. Quality of the bud is top notch. Id recommend if you just want a good set of ear buds.

title: Excellent TWS earbuds for its price range - great for travel/commute and strenuous workouts
text: Pros: - Comfortable and secure fit - Sound quality is better than its competitors - Very good sound isolation for non-ANC earbuds - Good battery life Cons - Included earwings may not fit all ears - Physical buttons may exert force onto the ear when pressed Conclusion: Excellent TWS earbuds for the price. Excels where other competitors don't. Good for travel/commute as well as for use during workouts.

title: These are very nice!
text: I have not used these a lot, but from what I have seen / heard so far they are some of the best I have used. The EQ is nice since you can customize them to your listening pleasure...plenty of bass and volume.

title: Simply bettter
text: Simple things are important, for many earbuds you tap these click and its amazing little feature.

title: Excellent!!
text: These are great headsets!! Can use just one if needed or wanted, pairs well with Apple watch. Long battery life. Case can charge headphone a little if not near a charger too. Sound is excellent with great base with no distortion while listening to Hip-Hop music. Great noise cancellation if your into that sort of thing.

title: Great quality and sound for the price
text: I've had the Samsung buds+ and these are very xlose to them definitely a must purchase, they stay in ear and have great sound.

title: Great buds! *Updated review
text: Great with a big BUT: The fit is very adjustable and comfy. Each earbud weighs 6 grams. The sound is great as well as the noise canceling. I haven’t tried to work out with it yet, just listened to audible books. Here comes the BUT: every 15-20 min or so, the buds mute for about 30sec and then continue to play. Very annoying bug, which is why I consider returning these. The seller contacted and I got a replacement for the earbuds. The new pair work consistently with all the benefits I mentioned above. Perfect buds!

title: A tad bigger than I hoped
text: It works well over all but there are some features like using the buttons that bother me, typically it doesn't always work and sometimes I have to disconnect the Bluetooth off my phone just so it'd stop draining power and or turn off. Otherwise the sound quality is good and it can dampen some noise.

title: Not up to Anker standards
text: I really like Anker products however these earbuds are not very good. 1. As long as you push on the buds the base is good, however if you don't push on the buds there is no base and i am not the type who likes heavy base. 2. There is no way to know what mode the buds are in. I have a pair of Earfun buds and there is a voice that let's you know what mode you are in. Battery life seems good however this is the only good thing about these buds.

title: Just as good as Apple
text: My siblings all have Apple Airpods. I refused to pay that much, especially because I didn't want big white blobs in my ears. I tried a few brands, but ended up loving this one. I just use it in one ear, and it is a total winner! SIX MONTHS AFTER PURCHASE: I love these things! They work just as well as all of my friends' and family's Apple Airpods. I DO NOT WANT white blob "status symbols" in my ears during Zoom meetings. These are barely noticeable, and their sound quality is just as good as Apple's. Excellent find.

title: Excellent ear buds
text: Given as a gift and they've been as good as other positive reviews. Not the best sound ever but great value for the money and excellent base. Another plus...after being dropped in water (momentarily), they still work fine. Glad I chose this brand.

title: Terrible Product
text: Who is giving this so many good reviews? These are terrible in every way. 1.) Way too many different controls for the two buttons. They list 10 different controls you have to memorize to do different functions. 2.) Very difficult to see which is left and right. The "R" and "L" are microscopic 3.) Battery time left is indicated by it saying "Battery High", "Battery Medium" or "Battery Low"... umm what does that mean, how about telling me a percentage that is left on the battery. 4.) The noise cancelation is annoying I can hear myself breath

title: Doesn't work for Me
text: I got these as an upgrade for my Anker Soundbuds Curve but it didn't work out so good. The sound quality of the Anker Life A 1 were better than Curve but they kept slowly getting loose and falling out of my ears. I tried all the different combinations of ear fittings that that Life A 1s come with but they all kept working loose and falling out of my ears. I shoot at firearms ranges so even though aren't approved as ear protection, I am familiar how ear buds should properly fit but these kept working loose and needed constant readjustment which was irritating.

title: Uncomfortable
text: I tried every combination of sizing provided. They are one of the most uncomfortable earbuds I've ever worn, and they also fall out of my ears..

title: Sound quality & blocking out unwanted noise
text: These earbuds were exactly what I was looking for. Sure there are better ones out there, but not for the price. I use them when I go to the gym. I now do not have to listen to the conversation next to me when I work out.

title: Sound quality good.
text: This product works as advertised. Haven't had them that long. But they seem to be working just fine. Hard to connect to the Bluetooth when changing devices but works great once connected. Shipment arrived on time, packaging was good.

title: Average Rating
text: The item is okay for regular use when I am on a treadmill, but it is not like Apple's earbuds.

title: Case is bad?
text: The earbuds are great. Fit perfectly right out of the box. However, the case holds very little power and can't charge the buds even once. I took the earbuds out last night to test it, gave the case a full charge, and it was dead in 24 hours with nothing in it to drain the battery. I'm trying to find a replacement. Supposedly there's a larger case with a bigger battery that may charge wirelessly.

title: Have not aged well.
text: Originally I gave these buds a 5, but after 6 months the sound is fading, the earwigs keep slipping off and sometimes the Bluetooth just disconnects. I don't mind paying $40 for the time I used them, but I am buying Samsung to use with my S22.

title: Excellent headphones for the price
text: This headphones has impressed me alot with its quality all around . The sound is very good and its comfortable to wear.

title: Earbud life
text: I ordered my pair on June 2021. Battery life is still excellent. I’m writing a review now because the single left earbud went into the washer with the bedsheets. After being washed the earbud still charges and works! It definitely has noise cancellation. I only wear one at the park for saft because with both earbuds I can’t hear outdoor noises. I guess I have small ears and small ear canal because I use the smallest silicone attachments that come in the box. Had this pair been larger by millimeters I would not find it comfortable or able to use. I read several reviews of people with small ears recommending these before buying. I rarely need to charge the case. I’ve never had it fall out my ear due to activity or sweat. No pairing issues.

title: I have mixed feelings.
text: This earbuds has no problem to hear the sound and I think that it can hear a very good sound for the price. I think the sound quality is not my taste but a mechanical sound. However, my family complains to me that the voice on the phone is not clear. Is this because the earbuds I have are bad? Or is it because it is not suitable for this model of phone? I was expecting it, but I am very disappointed. I regret that I should have offered a replacement as soon as possible

title: These SoundCore earbuds are outstanding!
text: These soundcore earbuds are outstanding! The noise canceling is unreal and the sound quality is amazing. Thank you SoundCore

title: Save money buy these
text: I've lost so many pairs of these types of in the ear headphones so I finally decided to go with these even though there are less expensive to what I paid before they're just as good as any other you won't regret buying it

title: Great for music, TERRIBLE for calls.
text: DO NOT GRT THESE if you plan on use for calls. 100% of calls used with these buds, resultresult we DD in turning the ER m off and using the phone so the other caller could hear me.

title: Better than expected
text: I LOVE these. I have tried 8 sets of earbuds in the past year that are in the same price range. 4 setshave been defective, lasting less than a month before one side or another quits working or shocked me. Others have been to heavy or won't fit in my small ears so they fell out constantly and were all returned. When I opened these earbuds I was sure they were too big and wouldn't work for me. I was wrong. The buds are a bit large but they are lightweight and fit me well. Sound quality is great and I like that I can customize the sound. Fingers crossed on battery life and IPX rating. I prefer IPX 8 so I can use them in the hot tub and therapy pool but the 7 says they can handle 3 meters for 30 minutes.

title: Excellent product for the price
text: I am very pleased with the sound quality battery life is great I would recommend these

title: Kicka$$
text: These things are awesome. The sound quality and battery life are second to none. I’ve owned these bad boys for 8 months now, 0 regrets. I’m not surprised, every Anker product I own way exceeds the description and expectations!

title: Didn’t fit
text: The bugs look nice and the sound seems good. I couldn’t get them to stay in my ear. Never had problem with Apple buds. I tried every combination of and piece and holder I could but they kept falling out.

title: This is the one you want. Stop searching, buy these.
text: Just got these and put on charger for 20 min. They paired quickly, I changed the wings for a better fit, and went for a 1.5 hr run. They stayed secure the whole time, I can shake my head and they stay in place. These are very comfortable and light weight. I am very happy, Anker does it again.

title: LOVE them. Ultra sweatproof, secure, long lasting battery, and above all sound amazing.
text: I got the SoundCore XL boombox awhile back and love the quality and sound so after much hemming and hawing between more expensive in ear buds and cheaper ones, I finally decided on this pair. I could not be happier - they secure nicely and have i believe 35 hours of charge with the case. CRAZY! I am a musician and from an audiophile perspective the sound is really good, as I expected. Clear bass, clear highs, everything feels well mixed. They feel like $200 headphones and have totally changed my workout game. If you've been wanting great sounding earbuds but don't want to spend that kind of cash, seriously just get these.

title: GREAT! for a while.
text: definitely took a chance on these. I had never heard of the brand before and had zero idea of what the sound quality was like and based the purchase on the reviews stating outstanding overall build and sound quality. My first impression was positive, I love the charging case that can be wirelessly charged and the options for both the ear retaining grommets and the plugs (whatever they're called) I spent a good little bit making sure I found a combination that both fit and was comfortable as I would be wearing these most of the day at my job. I was absolutely blown away by the sound quality! I used to have a $500 pair of Sony brand calibrated studio monitor headphones and I'm not kidding, these ear buds sound better. However. like a few others had mentioned, after about 1 to 1.5 months the ear retainers stretched out kept falling off, over, and over, and over. I switched to a different size and in less time those were useless too. the little T shaped thing that latches onto them is still there but the act of wearing the ear buds and taking them off to recharge just stretched them out to the point that after about 3 months I simply cannot wear them any more. Don't get me wrong, they sound fantastic! but they seriously need to think about a stronger silicone for the ear retainers. Thankfully these don't have an outlandish price so I'm not out that much, but I am out a pair of ear buds.

title: So far so good
text: I have only had these for about a week. They seem to be living up to their description. I use them mostly in just one ear for podcasts. Battery life seems very good. Bluetooth works perfectly, take them out of the case and they pair automatically, put them back in the case and they disconnect. For my purpose they are priced right.

title: #1 the best products
text: Soundcore never disappoint's for this price point you can't beat it. All my speakers are Soundcore and battery packs. My next investment liberty 3 pro's

title: Not bad, not great
text: The sound isn't bad, and people seem to be able to hear me on phone calls no problem. The battery life is excellent. Biggest issue is definitely the controls, just not intuitive. Sound has a crackling sound from time to time but can't reproduce it, very random.

title: Great Wireless!
text: Our daughter liked these so much more than the wired ones she has had that she even bought a second pair so she could give 1 pair to a needy friend.

title: Comfy, Clear Sound
text: I use these to listen to audiobooks and podcasts while walking and the audio quality is great. The earbuds are comfortable and the batteries will long outlast my endurance at this point.

title: A little loose in one ear. Plastic comes off the earbud. Not good for walking outside.
text: These are OK for sitting at home. I wouldn't use them walking around. I haven't tried the bigger plugs yet. They are loose in one ear. Sound is fine. Battery life good. Over time they don't charge well. What I mean is I'll put them in the case and they don't start charging. So I take them out, put them back in then the magnets connect and they charge.

title: Comfortable but don’t work.
text: UPDATE: Earbud did not stay on standby so I exchanged them. Second set has lousy sound & when on phone callers say sound is muffled. I’m returning it too. ANKER - WHAT’S HAPPENED TO YOUR QUALITY?!!

title: Save your money. Limited volume.
text: After watching YouTube reviews about these earbuds, I decided to chance it, and ordered a pair. Words can't express the disappointment in these buds. Maximum volume, when used with my Android phone, is practically inaudible. Absolutely terrible. And the EQ settings....WHAT EQ??? So, so bad that I'm thinking that the units reviewed online may have been "special" demo versions. The only good thing is the battery charge life....for the tunes that you can't hear! Save your $$$$. Really.

title: Very happy with these earbuds!
text: I like the rich quality of voices and the quality of music with these. The battery life is amazing. I still had lots of charge left after using them for an hour. The buds fit nicely and stay put.

title: Good product
text: Great earbuds and customer service when I had issues. Justin at the 800# helped me a lot with them

title: Well worth the extra cost over budget bluetooth earbuds.
text: After really bad experiences with sub-$30 earbuds (don't trust those 5-stars reviews the reviewers are being paid) I decided to spend a bit more on these earbuds hoping they would perform better. They do! First, the charging case has strong magnets inside so the earbuds stay put and charge properly. The sound quality is perfectly acceptable for this price but I suppose audiophiles might complain. They pair to my phone easily and consistently. They are comfortable and fairly small. Most important I run and sweat but these stay in my ears. When running I can make adjustments to the earbuds but nothing registers as an accidental button press, you need to make an effort to register a button press which I like. I can't comment on how long the battery lasts but I have used them for almost 90 minutes with no problems. I assume they would run longer. In conclusion my 5 star rating is based on a price to value assessment and these are definitely worth the price.

title: Love It
text: Airpods and other brands won't stay in my ears, these fit perfectly. Great sound, battery and nice design.

title: Very happy with these!
text: I've been an Anker fan for a few years, using their batteries and earbuds. This is the first time I've gotten their fully wireless earbuds and I'm glad I made the change. Most recently I was using their Soundcore Arc buds (mostly wireless) and these are pretty comparable. Great sound quality for music, shows, or games. Better range than most Bluetooth earbuds. Okay battery life. One small feature I really like is the selection of rubber pieces that you can switch out to adjust the size of the buds for your ears. I have an old scar on one ear, and the earbud rubbed it against it at first, but I switched that side to the small version and now it fits perfectly and is comfortable to wear. Nice touch!

title: Love these series
text: They always offer good sound/comfort/tech for a good price. Good battery life and case with extra tips and accessories; sturdy build and the button clicks with this one; non-finger touch sensitive.

title: Great sound for price
text: Battery life and sound quality are great! Did not like the ear bud pieces, the rubber is very thin so every time I take them out the invert. Also not a fan of the controls- all other earbuds have the pause set at one click. This is the only pair I ever bought that needs 2 clicks to pause. Other comments said you change them on the app but the app does NOT apply to this generation.

title: Upgrade to the Life A2 NC for a significantly better sound.
text: Not too bad for the price, but for almost the same price you can get the Soundcore Life A2 NC for a significantly better sound and better build quality.

title: Poor design
text: I returned this item due to the design of the "earwings". Seems like it would improve the fit for some people, but the tradeoff is that now everyone has to deal with them coming loose. I didn't like that the earwings would usually get unseated whenever I took the earbuds off. They also have a notch that they're supposed to sit on to align them, but it's a pain to tell whether it's actually seated on that notch properly. The sound was okay. The controls were passable.

title: Won’t charge
text: Won’t charge. Only light up as “charging” for about 5 seconds. Have to unplug and re-plug to get it to charge.

title: Surprisingly good value
text: Lost a pair of expensive earbuds, bought these because I couldn't bring myself to spend the $$ again. These fit great, securely (there are a variety of tips/shields to adjust the fit, but the default fits my ear like a glove). Sound is excellent. I find myself using them in situations where I wouldn't have bothered with earbuds before, because the sound is that much better.

title: Solid buy.
text: The headphones have a solid fit and finish (at $250 they should). The case is quite nice and the headphone stay in place via magnets. Pros ​Easy setup with the Bose App. Headphones fit snugly for long periods of time without causing ear fatigue. Deep bass (almost too much when in quiet spaces). Long battery life. Take calls (right ear bud only) Cons ​Expensive Headphones stick out of your ears quite a bit. No noise cancelling. If you have $250 to spare and are in the market for very good Bluetooth ear buds these should be top of your list.

title: You pay for quality.
text: So far these earphones are Superior in sound. Comfortable to wear. Have a apple Airpod and cost less but sound was nothing like these. Airpod lasted exactly one year, and the sound volume is problematic.

title: battery life is horrible, does not hold a charge
text: It was working great for the first few months...then I started noticing the battery would be dead the next day after a full recharge. Definitely not worth the $$$$, my cheap $20 earbuds were much more reliable.

title: Too Large-NO Independent usage
text: The Bose SoundSports have a nice, clear sound, but they are VERY large! I purchased the Samsung Earbuds after these, and all I ever use are the Samsung's. The Bose SS HAVE to be used with at LEAST the Right bud everytime. Cannot be used independently. The Samsung's can. And I LOVE THAT. Samsung earbuds are tiny and fit so well in my ears. I wanted these Bose SS's for over 3 years, and FINALLY got them on sale, but was disappointed. Sound quality is good, but still overall chose the Samsung's for size and independent usage. Battery life is better in Samsung's too.

title: Excellent gift for my daughter
text: My daughter really enjoys them. I’m glad I got them for her

title: Wait for the next version. An unexpected and serious disappointment.
text: I found Bose's latest wireless headphones to be a fairly serious disappointment, which was surprising and frustrating after having bought 5 or 6 pairs of headphones over the years, along with speakers and a Wave Radio. I *like* Bose products. Let me start with the positive, to be fair. 1. They sound great. 2. They stay in my ears. (A feature Apple did not think to include with their glorious AirPods.) 3. The Bose connect app on the iPhone is slick and useful. The negatives. 1. They are very big and jut from my ears in a way that looks comical. I've seen other people compare them to the bolts on Frankenstein's neck, but for the ears. Actually, though, it's worse than that, because their weight makes them droop. So I'd describe the look as more Frankenstein Eeyore. If you have hair that covers your ears, you will probably be ok. But I am close to bald, so I can't really wear them in public. Since I bought them to wear during my workouts at LA Fitness and while coding at work, the fact that they make me look silly is a show stopper. 2. Given the look issues, I'd love to wear them when I listen to music on my computer at home, but they don't pair properly with Windows 10. They have a voice profile and a music profile. No matter how I fiddle with my PC, based on advice from the various threads on Bose's support forums, I cannot get the music profile to activate. The reason this is a problem is that the voice profile only plays music in one ear, and at far reduced quality. Like it's-being-piped-to-your-ear-through-Satan's-toilet quality. Bose's suppport forums have various threads about this, and it's clear that some part of Bose's software group either doesn't get it or is trying to avoid publicly stating that they can't fix the problem. They claim it is Windows or software differences on various PCs, but my Apple AirPods work fine as do Bose's SoundSport Wireless headphones (though they lack a mic, so the scenario is somewhat different). 3. I wish there was a way to hear audio in both ears while making calls. You can do this with the AirPods.

title: Great sound...when they work
text: I have had these since October. The sound quality is GREAT! Cancels noise around me when they are in my ears. Battery is OK but not even close to what they say. Maybe 4 hours with the charge in between. Mine decided to rename themselves and then sometimes decide not to connect. Kind embarrassing when I start the music and it's blaring from my phone and everyone around can hear but I can't and realize they didn't connect again. Update have had these over a year and seriously the best headphones ever. After upgrades and set up again on my iPhone I have not had any troubles with sound or connection. Battery lasts a long time and headphones never disconnect.

title: Poor quality

title: Must buy!

title: You’re buying disappointment!
text: I have extreme buyers remorse. As a loyal customer of Bose, I am disappointed. I prefer using quietcomfort and wished i had never gotten rid of my old wired Soundsports. I have had so many issues with these headphones. 1 - when you use the phone for calls, sound only comes through one ear. It’s extremely annoying. 2 - The volume does not adjust with my phone. title: Bose Wireless SoundSport
text: My husband got these for me for Christmas. I have small ears and the small ear gel attachment fits perfectly. The Bose sound quality while listening to music is great and the phone call quality is good. Enjoying them very much.

title: The best

title: ANOTHER GREAT BOSE PRODUCT

title: Battery life completely diminished to 20 minutes!!
text: I’ve only had this for. 1 1/2 years and now battery suddenly last only 20 minutes!! I’ve tried everything from new cords, new plug, new socke, to new update. I am so upset that I wasted $$ on this! I love Bose products. I have so many from soy rocks, home entertainment systems, to Bluetooth speakers, but this is the biggest disappointment!!! I guess I will veer towards the Apple AirPods. Waste of $199.

title: Over a year later. . .
text: Still to this day do these sound incredible and are very comfortable. I never really know they are there and that's impressive considering their size. I've used these almost everyday for over a year now and I've only had to replace the eartips just recently. The battery seems to lose charge just a bit faster now, but can't complain, as I still get several hours use out of them. The primary things that drew me to these buds were Bose's usually great craftsmanship and sound signature, the awesome blue carbon/yellowish-green color, they are FULLY wireless, and the charging case. They connect to my Android automatically upon pairing and I NEVER have any connectivity issues. I also tried them with an iPhone and they did just as good of a job. The sound may drop out of one bud every now and then but it's so rare and so short that it doesn't bother me whenever I encounter it. They also pair well with the Bose Connect app and I LOVE the Find my headphones feature. I really think all wireless buds should have this! The charging case is good but there's room for improvement here. It is definitely noticable in a pocket and was nearly impossible to open for the first few months until the button release loosened up a bit. The buttons on the buds themselves had the same issue. Extremely firm and insanely hard to press, but got easier over time with use. I just recently purchased a new pair of earphones, but will still continue to use these for how ever long they'll hold up. They are dependable, sturdy, and sound fantastic like most other Bose products I've heard. They are still going strong, so I wouldn't doubt them lasting another year, it's the aging of the batteries that will determine that. Overall, these have been and are fantastic and wouldn't hesitate for a minute to recommend these (and I have). They are a bit expensive, but you get what you pay for here.

title: Bose delivers
text: Right out of the box it works perfectly. I typically use the smaller inserts on other earphones like beats, but the medium size fits great. There is no movement or feeling like they’re going to fall out. The earbuds also feel super comfy in my ears. The Bose sound that I’ve experienced with other Bose products shines with these earphones. It’s fantastic to have true wireless earphones. With my old beats 3 the wire still stuck to the back of my neck and was uncomfortable after a while. I also love the fact that these are charged by the carrying case and give you additional charges. I thought they would look huge like the old school Bluetooth headsets but for what they deliver in sound and charge, not that big at all. The blue and yellow look slick too. I thought the yellow would be dull compared to the photos but it is actually vibrant. Bottom line, great feel, sound and look. I will be recommending these to anyone looking for a quality pair of wireless earphones for running and working out.

title: Incredible Sound
text: Incredible sound, as good as advertised. I bought them primarily for working out, and they haven’t disappointed. As other reviewers have noted, the range can vary depending on your environment - especially true at the gym with all of the concrete and steel. If I left the phone on the floor next to my workout station for example, they would begin to cut out at roughly 10 ft. However, when I kept my phone in an arm band or fanny pack - problem solved. Last thing, if you need true noise canceling, go with an over ear design. These are definitely more for comfortable, great sound.

title: Awesome - But Check!
text: I love these babies! It's been about 2 years since I first saw them advertised (they may have been available before that) and I've wanted them ever since. But it's a very hefty pricetag for me, so I needed time to save up and justify the purchase. When it was a Amazon Prime Day Deal, I knew I needed to pounce right away. And I'm so glad I did!! I do a lot of work at my parents' farm involving cutting branches, hauling rocks, working with animals, etc, where wires can get so easily tangled. So the wireless aspect is what I really wanted. But most ear buds don't actually stay in my ears unless I'm holding perfectly still. Bose are the exception. I can wear these for hours without them slipping or getting uncomfortable, even when the sweat is pouring down in 89% humidity. The sound quality is outstanding (no surprise, since they are a Bose product). The controls are easy to use and let you play/pause, adjust the volume, and disconnect/connect to bluetooth. The charging case is a great way to keep them safe while they're charging (I have a Great Dane who loves chomping on things, but they aren't enticing to her while in the case). The charge works for a long time. The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars is because the first set I got didn't work. The left ear bud never connected. Since it was through Amazon the return process was very easy. My new set has connected every time I've used them (30+ times). However the left ear has dropped connection twice for about 3 seconds. Not bad and easy to overlook, but a product has to be absolutely perfect to earn a 5 star from me. So check it out when you get it and make sure it is working so you can a replacement if you need one. Otherwise, buy away! I don't regret this purchase one bit!

title: Great Sound
text: I have had MANY bluetooth headsets over the years. I have two now that are my go to sets, but one is the neck band type and the other has the connecting wire. I wanted to go completely wireless and did quite a bit of research. I had it narrowed down to these Bose and the Jabra Elite Active 65t. Reviewers seemed to give the sound edge to the Bose, so I went that way. And, I'll agree that sound is impressive. It's the best sound of any BT headset I've ever tried. It has great sounding bass with good mids and highs. In fact I had to set my EQ to all nominal to take some bass out. The buds are quite large and do stick out of your ears much more than others, but they're very comfortable. I have a large tip in my right ear and a medium in my left. I'd suggest using the largest tip that's comfortable for you to increase sound quality, isolation and secure fitness. Battery life appears to be as advertised and I like the magnetic charging case, some cases (even at higher price points) don't secure the buds with magnets. One last thing is video. Several reviewers have noted a lag in sound to video, I noticed no lag at all. As good as they are, there are some things I'd like to see changed. As mentioned they are quite large, I'd like to see Bose work on reducing this. They also need to add features to the app, it's very anemic. The buttons are also incredibly hard to press, this needs to be addressed. Adding touch controls to those massive sides would be great. BT distance seems to be a bit less than other sets I have, range is about 25 feet. Several reviewers have noted that occasionally the left bud disconnects from the right one. I saw this happen when I'm too close to the microwave, but haven't seen it anywhere else. I'm happy with the buds and would recommend them to anyone looking for great sounding earbuds.

title: Great sounding and comfortable earbuds
text: These are by far the most comfortable earbuds I’ve used. I can wear these for hours without any discomfort. I’ve used both over ear headphones and other earbuds from other makes and these are by far the most comfortable. I maybe an anomaly as other earbuds and headphones I’ve complained about don’t seem to hurt other people except for me. My ears are a bit on the smaller side and these earbuds come with different silicone ear pieces to fit various sizes. On sound, these earbuds are pretty good. If you are buying these for sitting in your cubicle and listening in a relatively quiet area, you’ll find they have a bit too much bass. Some of that can sort of be adjusted by using the different size ear pieces as some won’t fit in as tightly into your ear which causes the bass to be deemphasized since it’s not making a tight air seal against your ear. It’s more like a hack if you don’t like thumpy bass. However, if you use these as they were intended, outside, in the gym, etc the bass seems about right. And that’s perhaps what Bose was thinking. Although, if the Bose app had some some bass/treble or EQ controls to adjust for different environments I’d give these earbuds 5 stars. So how about it Bose? Give us an app upgrade with sound controls for the different environments, please. Other than that, I’d recommend these earbuds. In my opinion they look and sound great. While I’m usually not a big fan of Bose speakers in the snobby hi fi world, I give credit where credit is due. Comfort and sound are very important and these deliver.

Time will tell if these earphones hold up and I will wait another week before disposing of my boxes (I've had them 3 weeks) but I am very optimistic. Did I mention the sound quality is incredible!!

I can get maybe 2 hours of listening at work before I get the low battery warning. This is coming from a 100% charge. And of course there is no recourse for getting this fixed. What a joke.

title: Bose Is Not Fixing The Issues
text: These headphones have a rather annoying issue with the iphone in which you cannot answer a call. When a call is incoming, the headphone rings and once you answer it, it shifts back to the phone. You then have to manually select to change the call from the cellphone, to the bluetooth headphones. I tried contacting support and I was extremely disappointed in the response as this is a common complaint online. If it weren't for this issues I would give these headphone a borderline 4/5, but because of this stupid issue I will be returning and giving a 1 until they come up with a solution. These headphones have been on the market at least 3 years and are extremely overpriced, they should at least be able to handle answering calls and transitioning the calls to the headset.

title: They have Bose sound, well one or the other does....
text: Everything you would expect from the sound smiths at Bose.... BUT I had this annoying issue with audio delay on videos and they would unpair from eachother. These work as a master and slave and the slave would disconnect often. Returned them and went with a competitor.

title: Bose reigns Supreme!!
text: Omgoodness I am not sure how I survived without these!!! They are the best earbuds ever...like E-V-E-R. I purchased the pro beats 3 months before and was soooooo disappointed with them. My MPOW were far superior. But these Bose were perfect. I got these on special for 130+ and that made purchase even better. The range is excellent, sound quality is excellent and they remain in my ears throughout my workout regardless of how strenuous it may be. Best buy ever!

title: Too expensive to not work this soon
text: When I received the earbuds they were great. Sound was good and loud too. It was 7 months into using them when one ear bud occasionally stop communicating with the other. Less than a year in and it has lost total communication. If I'm paying $200 for earbuds I expect both of them to work for at least a year. Come on Bose, you're better than that. Sadly doesn't look like I can get any help replacing.

title: Bose Sound, Bose Quality
text: I should preface this, there seemed to be some problems when these first came out. You can read some early reviews. The first thing I did with my first pair was download the firmware update. This seems to have fixed things. I've had no problems. My new pair already had the firmware update. There was a sale, $50 off, I really like my first pair, so now I have two, or four. For me, the earbuds fit firmly in my ears. The controls are easy to use--Bose has always put reasonable controls on their Bluetooth Phone/Buds. The paring is usually easy, although they don't seem to like my Surface Pro. The microphone/headset/telephone part works very well. Oh, and the sound? I have no particular expertise, but I like Bose. So I bought another pair. And my excuse for two? I can sometimes misplace them, so for me, finding Bright Orange is easier than finding black. Well done, Bose! Highly recommended.

title: Rich BOSE sound!
text: Very good comfortable product as BOSE expected! Only left-ear unit seems to disconnect with some interferences areas in the gym... other then that they work with beautiful rich sound!

title: Pure Bose sound quality, on par with over-ear cans
text: OMG, The sound!. So, this was an impulse buy. They got very good reviews on electronics site, and I was tempted, but I think they were up to $299 at one point. So I forgot my (cheap) workout headphones for a business trip and I saw these at the airport kiosk. A quick check show that the kiosk price was right, CC comes out and I got them. So, without charging them for a whole lot, I couldnt wait, just paired them to my phone and turned them on, Again, I could hear things on my music I never had! And to those that say that wire headphones are better, I have not experienced that. One most remember that when connecting to a phone output jack, you are using the phone's DAC converter; and I don't think that most phone manufacturers spend a ton of money on their DAC. When listening through bluetooth, your phone are getting the raw data stream and converting it to sound. I venture a guess that Bose pays a lot of attention to their DACs. I also own a pair of Senheisser over-ear headphones and I have had the same experience. Yet, these little wonders are amazing, I am willing to say that if you are in a quiet room, the sound is on par with my Sens.

title: Could fit much better
text: The sound is great if they would actually stay in my ears. The small pieces seem to fit my ear except they easily get loose when just walking (which makes the sound degrade if the buds don’t have a proper seal in the ear). Don’t think of running with them. Fall out at the twitch of the leg. Tried the medium ear cups and they make these stick out my ear like a satellite dish. Expected a better fit for the price, and because of the poor fit the sound degrades.

title: Stick with the regular Bose SoundSport Version
text: Tried these, tired AirPods, still using my previous generation Bose SoundSport; returned these and the AirPods. I currently have the Bose SoundSport headphones but I'm on my second pair and they're starting to see some wear. I use them 5 or 6 days a week while I run or work out. I also use them for phone calls at work and for personal use. In my opinion, they are some of the best Bluetooth headphones you can buy. [[ASIN:B01L7PSJFO Bose SoundSport Wireless Headphones, Black]] I took a chance on AirPods. Terrible. Returned the second day. When running on the treadmill, the one side kept falling out of my ear. Fun fact - human ears aren't exactly the same. Even between your left and right ears. So while one side fit fairly snug, the other kept falling out. Yeah, you can buy silicone attachments to help keep them securely in your ear, but then you have to remove and store them to use the AirPod charging case. On to the Bose SoundSport Free. These fit more snugly. Same design as the regular SoundSport. But the three things I didn't like: 1. Phone calls only work in the right ear. 2. Left side randomly looses sync. Right side is master and transmits to left side. This cuts out randomly and the sound fades out. 3. The charging case charges the earphones no matter what level. It's my assumption this will lead to decreased battery life. Which is almost always the thing to go in Bluetooth headsets. I also tried Phaiser. For the money, these are a great pair. They don't have the sound quality like the Bose, but they fit snug and have decent sound. [[ASIN:B075CTSYHH Phaiser BHS-760 Bluetooth Headphones, Magnetic Wireless Sport Headset for Running, Sweatproof Cordless Earphones with Mic for Working Out, Comfortable Wireless Earbuds for Exercise, Blackout]] My advice would be to stick with the Bose SoundSport non-free version if you want good headphones for leisure and working out. AirPods might be OK if they actually fit your ears and you don't plan on moving your head too often.

title: I expected better from Bose
text: These are great ear buds but I have two issues. They stick out of your ear so it looks ridiculous. Second the buttons will wear after time. I had these for maybe more than a year. The volume button broke off. The power button is crushed. So in conclusion the design is not very stylish and the buttons do not last. For a pair of Bluetooth ear buds that cost more than galaxy buds and pixel buds this is unacceptable. Also updates to the software are few in between. I was hoping you can be connected to your phone and a music device (ipod touch or macbook). also I do lose connection when moving to quick so maybe running with these is out of the question.

title: Great sound quality!
text: Great product with long battery life as well. The sound quality is incredible and the bass sounds fantastic, very smooth and not overpowering. I bought this for my girlfriend for Christmas and she actually bought me the same thing! We’re both very happy and use these regularly. Highly recommend this product.

title: Phone Calls Only Play Out of the Right Ear Piece
text: I ordered a pair of the Bose SoundSport Free after having a pair of the SoundSport Pulse headphones which have a connecting wire between the two earphones. The Pulse headphones play both music and phones calls in stereophonic sound, meaning you hear the output in both earphones. The new SoundSport Free headphones play music out of both earpieces but phone calls come out of only the right side. Completely unacceptable in my opinion for a product costing $250. Appple's Airpod product - costing a $100 less - plays phone calls out of both earpieces. Fingers crossed that Bose addresses this issue with some form of firmware update.

title: Pass on these...
text: ....$200....Bose...what a disappointment! This is the best that Bose could do?! You can buy much better earbuds for a quarter of the price. Pass on these.

title: Warranty was not valid
text: The items were as described, however the charging case for the ear-buds had problems almost immediately. It would not hold charge and would not charge the earbuds. Bose would not honor the factory warranty because they were not an official Bose third-party retailer, despite that being prominently displayed on the item on Amazon.

title: I do not recommend at all. Get the Powerbeats instead.
text: I really wanted to like these, I grew up loving Bose and these look really cool but no, they have been nothing but pain for me. The left one constantly disconnects while I’m running. It’s very hard to deal with it. Sometimes they both just disconnect and it’s really hard to get them back while you are running. Also they keep falling off my ear. Just while running.... They come with three sizes of ear pieces, they came with the middle size on them and those were too big for my ears. They hurt my ears so I put on the small ones. Small ones were fine until I started running with them on. As soon as you start sweating they get loose and fall off. At least one of them. Also one of those days, I was on an escalator with my dog and she freaked out and made me fall. Both of these earbuds fell out of my ears. I almost lost them and this time there was no sweat involved either. Most importantly the sound wasn’t amazing. It was just weak; barely ok. As I said they are beautiful (I got the orange ones) and I love Bose and their charging box is very cool but these earphones infuriated me. I have returned those today. I don’t recommend. This is an update. After I returned these, I got Powerbeats Pro. And they are in every way better than this pair. They pair better and they sound better. They are also much more comfortable. As I said, I was a Bose girl, I did not even like the whole. Beats craze but Powerbeats Pro is the way to go here.

title: Typical bose quality
text: Sound great, don’t bother eats after hours! Thought noise cancel would be better... but if u turn up volume, it works !!

title: Five Stars
text: Absolutely love it! COMBO SET with apple watch best of the best for your sport.

title: Sound Quality and fit simply the BEST!
text: I love all electronics and can't wait to try them out when new headphones launch. I bought the Jabra Elite 65t. At first I thought wow these are pretty great. After wearing them at work for 2 hours or so they started hurting my ears. A co-worker of mine said to try the Bose Soundsport Free as you can't beat them for comfort. I disliked the fact that they stick out so far. I do also have Apple Airpods which look silly lol. I bought the Bose and after one day immediately returned the Jabra. The sound is so much fuller, more bass and the comfort is amazing. They do stick out a bit further than Jabra but the sound quality is totally worth the comprise. I still use my airpods as they just work flawlessly but not as comfortable or sound as good. I would have to say right now Bose has nailed it for wireless earpods. The only thing that I don't like as much is if someone walks up to my desk and I take them off they continue to play whereas the Jabra's automatically pause. I have had no issues connecting or losing connection. I highly recommend you give them a try you will not be disappointed.

title: Bst sounding wireless buds
text: This is the best sounding wireless headphone (buds) I've tried. Love them! The storage/charging case is great. I take them off, put them in the case and they charge automatically.

title: Do not buy if one of the devices you want to use is a Windows PC/Laptop
text: Meets the high standard I have come to expect from Bose on sound quality, but fails to meet promoted performance. Works great with Cell but does not work in stereo with any windows pc. one ear bud works when connected to Windows PC. Bose sadly does not own up to single bud activity. Bose suggest it is a Microsoft driver issue, but every other wireless speaker I have connected to Windows, including apple airbuds work perfectly with stereo, Bose is the only one not working. Do not buy these if you want to use them with a Windows pc in addition to your cell. The only reason I did not rate 2, is bcse it is a 5 for cell phone, but advertised to be able to connect to 7 devices, certainly at least one of them will be a computer.

title: Great Sound but Everything Else is Wrong
text: I use these earbuds to listen to TV when my family is sleeping. For the price, I expected to use these for many purposes. It looks like this has all been noted in other comments, but here is a list of problems I encountered: Left bud drops out, difficult to pair, poor range-even without obstructions, bulky, and expensive. I kept these too long for a return, so I use them for the one purpose where they function adequately most of the time. This is not what I expected from a Bose product.

title: ... these as a gift and was shocked at how poor the sound quality is in terms of noise reducing ...
text: I got these as a gift and was shocked at how poor the sound quality is in terms of noise reducing and volume. I can still hear every single thing going on around me while I’m using these; even my $20 headphones cancel out noise better than these. Yes, I was using the smallest and correct size ear bud for my small ears. I have to turn the volume up really high on my iPhone to hear songs when I use these, unlike my other (much cheaper) headphones. I haven’t had any issues with them charging or turning off like other reviewers have had but I personally would never get these again. I can’t believe the quality is so crappy for the price.

title: Love 'em
text: I really loves these. I get frustrated with blue tooth earbuds easily. These are great. On occasion they seem to disconnect for no reason, or if I am running sometimes the connectivity gets weak. But there Bose and they are good quality.

title: Not there yet don’t waste your money
text: I was hoping this earphones work but the technology is not there yet pretty much all of these wireless free earbuds have the same cutoff sound issue. The left earbud will cut out and the right side. I dont think with all the issues these earbuds are worth more than $150 max. After several replacement I decided to go with another brand. These didn’t work out for me the constant connection issues and video audio lag these are outdated. I got the Samsung galaxy buds for less money more features, wireless charging and more.

title: Not good for phone use
text: we all know about bows quality the only drawback is if someone is trying to talk to you on the phone they are so powerful that they pick up a lot of background noise and people can understand you so I basically just take them to the gym and use them when I'm working out other than that they're pretty nice you just can't talk on the phone with them

title: Right earbud won't charge after a year
text: The right earbud stopped being able to be charged after about a year, rendering these completely useless. Called bose and since I'm a couple weeks outside my warranty, there's nothing they can do. I used to be a bose die hard fan, but I will never buy another bose product again.

title: Great for music, but not much else
text: Great sound quality usual for Bose products. Left bud drops occasionally but reconnects quickly. My main gripe is the terrible delay with any Bluetooth connection. With either my iPhone or PC, there is a good 3-4 second delay on the sound making it difficult to use for videos or games. You also cannot play music and be on a Skype/discord call at the same time. Lastly, it is not great to use as a Bluetooth phone headset. If you take a call on a phone, it switches to low quality sound and only uses the right earbud. The mic seems to work ok though.

title: Great Sound But Case Cannot Hold Power
text: This is my second Bose product and as usual the sound is fantastic. But unlike the Bose Quiet Comfort 35 which the battery last as Bose claims, this ear bud just won't hold the power. On standby, it automatically drains if I don't connect it a power source. After using for about 6 hrs. the battery died in its case. I am going to ask for a replacement to see if I have any luck.

title: Second pair

title: Awesome 2 years old and still the best.
text: I like to test a product for a long time before i leave a review i will call it real world testing. These things are awesome i have had them now for about 2 years and they are still going strong. Ocassionally i have opened the case and they had not charged but i just took them out and put them back and it is all fine. I use the for running and cycling and they never fall out even though i am still using the original inserts. If it is super hot then they do loosen a bit with a lot of sweat but never had one fall out. My only possible complaint is on long bike rides the battery dies before i am done. At best i have managed about 5 hours of battery life non stop. But most people are not riding 100+ miles just for fun. Make sure to get the app and keep them updated it solves the earlier on issue with the left side dropping out. Also if you drop one outside in the dark it has a find my bud feature LIFESAVER!!

title: The best of the best

title: Bose Sound Quality
text: Not sure about the noise cancelling or the moisture wicking, but you can’t beat Bose for sound quality. They connect easily with my iPhone and the charging case is a nice plus.

title: Good earphones, I think 3.5/5 is more accurate
text: Setting these up with new devices is a breeze. The sound quality is great and despite their size and protrusion, they stay in my ears despite running or working out and don't feel heavy at all. It feels like I have nothing in my ears. I'm pleasantly surprised and impressed with the sound quality and even though it's not noise canceling, I can't hear things around me well at all, which is an added bonus. In addition, I do not experience any lag with videos. The performance is usually very consistent but I have noticed that with some movements or positions, it loses connection with the left bud but I can usually tell when this will happen and bring it back so I'm sure it's not a real problem with the buds, just a minor inconvenience. A bigger inconvenience is that the case battery seems to leak and not hold charge so if you don't use them for a few days, make sure you check the battery before using as the case may have run out. I have reached the gym several times after not using the buds for a while to realize that they are now dead. When charged, the case works great and the buds longer than I need them to. I do wish that phone calls would be through both buds instead of the right bud and that the charging case was USB-C. Overall, I really enjoy these buds and they give me an immersive experience with what I'm listening to. The sound quality is great and no problem with videos. They connect easily and last long. There are a few inconveniences with them but I would still recommend these.

title: Generally Awesome. Almost 5 stars.
text: These don't seem like they will ever fall out of your ears. Awesome. These sound WAY better than Apple's AirPods. I firmly believe these are a better buy than Apple AirPods. Again Awesome. These sound better than PowerBeats and they don't have that silly cord between each ear. Again Awesome. The price point is on par with other bluetooth headphones in this class. Mostly Awesome. So what's not to like? I've had these for about 5 days now and they do this funny thing. The sound occasionally cuts out from left to right. It's not often enough to be worried about it, but it happens. I just did a firmware update on mine so hopefully this will fix the problem and I'll be able to come back and call this a 5 star product.

title: Awesome Sound Quality

title: Great except flawed bluetooth connection that keeps dropping (DO NOT BUY)
text: I got this as a gift several months ago. They are nice and have great sound and fit. The big BUT here is the bluetooth connection is absolute crap. They have gotten worse with updates actually. They drop connection with phone at gym 2-3 times daily. Then there is intermediate connection issue where the left earbud looses connection also. They are so annoyingly disruptive that I would not recommend them to anyone. I suggest samsung earbuds if on android or beats pro for apple (just from research). I cannot return mine or RMA as they were gift and I have had them for a while but I had hoped bose would fix them. At this point I am going to trash them soon sadly. I suspect it is physical issue with the bluetooth chip used in them as none of the software updated have helped resolve the issue. Bose is really going backwards in quality control which is sad as they used to charge a premium for reliability and quality.

title: Great product

title: Easy to use

title: please don't buy!
text: I originally thought these were great, and then the left one stopped working after the second use. many emails and attempts to resolve the issue only left me sending them back. I received a replacement, which worked for 3 workouts, and now the same issue. I have wasted HOURS trying to get these to work. I am now sitting waiting for a huge update to apply. title: For a Female voice this headset is the BEST!
text: I have tried sooooo many headsets. ALL of the major Brands including the brands that work with my phones specifically. I am always disappointed. UNTIL NOW!! I am a Realtor in Yuma, AZ. I am on the phone ALL DAY! This is the only device to date that doesn't make me have to talk LOUD in order to have people hear me. I am so happy and my husband is more happy. No more getting annoyed because he only understands every 3rd word that I say. Sound Quality for my voice and the voice of the person on the other end of the line is WONDERFUL!! When I do listen to music and podcasts the sound quality is also excellent. They are comfortable and I wear them most of the day. When I am sweating they have had no problems. (It gets VERY hot here in the summer and I work even in 110 degree weather.) That brings me to the tiniest negative that I have. When I am sweaty they tend to slide out a little. So I will take them off and sometimes I forget where I took them off (My problem not the headsets) SO I have found the location system to be too basic. It can only locate them if you are close to them and if they are on or in sleep mode. If they have been disconnected it's time for an easter egg hunt. Otherwise I LOVE LOVE LOVE them!!! Thank You Bose for "hearing me."

title: Pretty good

title: No sound from the left?!! What is this Bluetooth technology from the past decade?
text: 2 star on initial evaluation but 4 star if music sound quality is your number 1 priority. Fits well and the sound quality is decent for music but a wireless Bluetooth headphone is only half done with just getting the sound right. I can't stand having a phone conversation with this set, it is so irritating not hearing out of the left ear because you have to raise the volume and it' very uncomfortable on the right ear!! I have a set of the Bose QC 20s, they are wired but, I have had excellent experience with them for the past 4 years which makes this headset all the more disappointing. Okay here is the update: I ended up buying a set of the original Soundsport which is the predecessor to this model, you are welcome to see the review for that model, but here is a quick comparison. Compared the Soundsport free 1. Sound quality for music: Win goes to Soundsport free. (It is noticeably better, however this offers decent sound quality for the price) 2. Range: Win for Soundsport free. (It is slightly better) 3. Phone call use: Win goes to this set. (Works much better as you can hear from both ears) 4. Battery life: Win for this set. (Has slightly better battery life) 5. Ergonomics: Tie (Buttons work better on this headset but the lack of wire makes it easier to workout with the Soundsport free, having said that having the wire on this headset makes it possible for you take one or both out of you ear and let the set hang around your neck without worrying about where to put the set. So it's up to you, if it's high quality sound for music you are after pick this model, if phone conversation is really why you are buying this set for then go with the older Bose Soundsport.

title: Not a Sport model in any way!!
text: Lost 2 stars 1 for size...they really hurt my ears after wearing them for an hour or so. 2nd one because they seriously suck at staying in. I mostly wear them while I clean house because the sound quality is way better than my hearing aids. Lol but it seems like I'm constantly having to adjust them because they are falling out. Drives me nuts! If the sound quality wasn't as good as it it I would have probably sent them back. But they definitely sound nice. Although I can't listen to music when I go to sleep because there's no laying on these puppies! HaHa! So if you want solid sound quality and don't mind constantly putting them back in they're a good buy. But if you want something you can put in and forget or to sleep with these are definitely not the ones. They are more a sit and chill kinda buds not sports. But check em out they sound amazing.

text: I was skeptical getting these, as I had a similar off brand that really were terrible. Bose has hit the nail on the head with these. Sound is almost as good as my big Bose headphones. Once you figure out your size, get them in place, and learn how to use them they are fabulous. Good job Bose!

title: Not worth the price
text: The buds don't stay in my ears, which annoys me. I spend 99 percent of the time catchin them as I walk I've used the smallest tips and still keep falling out. There is very little bass in them and the battery life is also not so great. Two hours tops. I suppose it may depend on the usage. I just use it for music when I'm around people because I tune the world out or try to. This brings me to the noise cancellation. You'll have to turn the volume of whatever you are listening to all the way to max because it's just not going to happen. If you listen to youtube, CNN or something with a video then you definitely are out of luck. you may as well hook up a blue tooth speaker. why are these not 5.0? for the price, even buying on Prime Day like I did is still a dissappointment. There is static, echo or some kind of interference with the left ear. They also do not connect automatically when taken out of case. I wanted to try Jabra, but all the raving about how good Bose sounds piqued my curiousity. Bose will need to make serious changes if I am to spend my money on these overpriced bulk ear clogs. As for anything positive about them, the color, the ability to skip, pause, play, power on/off due to buttons on the buds. the sound is louder than any wireless earbuds I have owned. I wish the non brand 5.0 I bought with Jam and bose would team up and create the ultimate true wireless earbuds. That would be amazing.

title: Great for music but if you want to watch a movie, forget about it
text: I own a number of Bose products and I love them all, so I could not wait to get my hands on a pair of these. I opened the box and I was impressed with the quality. They felt very “Bose like”. So far, so good. I popped them in my ears and I realized I looked a little like Frankenstein with the way they poked out to the side, but I can give them a pass on that. Then I brought up some music and WOW, they sounded great. I tried to lower the volume and realized the volume rocker switch has no haptic feedback, so I had no idea if I was pushing it or not, I pressed harder than the volume dropped. Hmm, not good by maybe I can get used to that. However, I bought these to watch videos on a plane, so I brought up a movie on Netflix and that’s when the real problem started. The voice was so out of sync to the actor’s lips it was unbearable. I tried a little Hulu, same thing. I had read this could be an issue, but I thought surely a quick firmware update would fix the problem since I was certain that Bose would not release a product this faulty. It took 45 minutes for the update to install and I brought up the same movie. Was the problem better, yes it was. Was it fixed, no it was not. The lag still made you feel like you were watching something over a bad dial up connection. I had to admit defeat and print out the return label. Bose, what were you thinking releasing a $250 pair of buds that you can ONLY listen to music with? These things should be recalled.

title: Love these headphones!
text: After I broke 2 sets of Beats, I splurged on these and do not regret it for 1 day. I love them! I do HIIT workouts, run and spin and they never fall out. Good sound quality, battery life is awesome and the storage containers charge them in between workouts.

title: Too expensive for the limited functionality; just get AirPods
text: For a $200 product, these are a major letdown. The fact that all calls, GoToMeeting-style apps etc only channel audio through the right ear is a major limitation and not excusable. It’s not that it’s “terrible” like others complain about; it’s just annoying enough to say “WTF were their engineers thinking when they accepted this major functionality compromise”. Sound quality is definitely worthy of the Bose name, but they aren’t loud/isolating enough to actually drown out noises like airplanes, the train (Chicago CTA drowns our their max volume output easily), street noises etc. I bought these instead of the Jabra Sport Elite (upgraded battery) and the AirPods, and within 30 minutes of use I regretted my purchase. If you want a dedicated sport bud, get the Jabras. If you want an all around bud, get the AirPods. The SoundSport Frees are squarely in the middle of doing nothing particularly well, and their limited functionality is NOT made up for by their sound quality. HARD PASS.

My only "complaint" would be that I wish the battery life lasted longer for those days you are on the phone a lot. You can still get in a long conversation and then put them back in the case to recharge. Great purchase. Love this limited edition color!

title: Great Sound and Features!
text: I was hesitant in buying these because of some of the reviews about how they sync with video but decided to take a chance when I found a GREAT deal and am not disappointed! There was a software update available through the Bose Connect app but these have great range, great sound, and no problems with video sync on my iPad Pro 12.9” or my iPhone 6S Plus. I am a professional Musican and college professor and the sound on these is pretty darn good. You still get some ambient noise but not as much as you would think. It doesn’t take long to charge the ear buds and if you have them in the case and the case needs to be charged, you can plug the case into the wall and the ear buds will charge first and then the case which is a nice feature since the case can continue to charge even after the ear buds come out. This is a pretty solid option. I use them on my stationary bike to watch movies or while working around the house. It is true that the phone calls come through the right ear only but I can live with that. I have a set of Bose QC35 headphones I was using before this and the sound quality of these is better as is the range. I haven’t had any issues with the left ear bud fading out like some have mentioned but much of that has been dealt with by updating the software and firmware through the Bose Connect app.

My friend who calls me once a week sounds like a radio DJ, in fact he used to be one but the headphones make him sound that way just naturally. It is really cute. So if you are finished with the headset you just press the middle button and it tells you the headset is off. So that saves on battery power and makes it easy to know when the power is on or off.
