text: These are amazing Earbuds!! Honestly, these are my new favorite Earbuds!! Great sound quality. They fit perfectly in your ears. Making it easy to be active. Also makes the best gift for anyone. Definitely will purchase again.

title: Excellent sound quality
text: Battery life could be a little bit better but really not a complaint as it is pretty good. As far as a whole, these are amazing! Would definitely recommend to others.

title: Despite the excellent sound quality there are serious drawbacks.
text: The positives: Fit very well and comfortable. They will not pop out. Music quality is excellent with deep bass. Noise cancellation works very well. The negatives: After a full charge, the Initial setup was a little tricky. Pairing did not work and I have to reset. Battery lasted only 4 hours on the first day. I will charge over night to see it it changes the result. If you walk more than 10 feet from the blue tooth source, it cuts out. When you come back into range the pairing is inconsistent. Sometimes the left is connected and sometimes the right is connect. Each time you walk away and return you get a different result. There are serious gaps in the music. After noticing the number of gaps I documented 7 events in 83 minutes. Six gaps and one time it just switched the song. Volume: Initially I had difficultly raising the volume. I was able to get it to very low but I could not get it very high. Also it is hard to hear the women's voice when you switch between ANC and transparency. I am assuming that I have a bad unit and will try out a new one. ***update day 2*** After a full charge over night (4 bars), the unit started saying battery low after an hour. It repeats this message every ~50 seconds. After an hour the first event started where the ear piece disconnects and reconnects within 1-2 seconds. This should have never made it out of QC. ***update New unit*** After charging overnight. i used it for 2 hours and it started to say "battery low". When placed in the charger it indicated that the batteries are 3/4 charged. Very annoying. initial pairing was a little difficult but got it on the third try. This product does not match the reviews. I am returning it.

title: Perfect fit
text: Finally a set of NC earbuds that fit my child sized ears. Thank you!

title: Wonderful
text: These are great earphones that are wireless and they are reasonably priced as well. I highly recommend trying them out of you are on the fence. Great sound quality as well!

title: Poor sound quality
text: They do not stay on and turn off at any movement.

title: Strong Value for the Price
text: I have used many earphones over the years. The wireless ANC market is very active and very competitive. My review and ratings are based on the performance and value for the price of these earphones. For $60 or less, these are one of the least expensive wireless ANC earphones that I know of. You can spend a lot more, and will get more, but for $60 these are very good. The sound is a little on the bright side, but not too bad. Bass is decent but not overwhelming. The ANC seems to work fairly well, and it is easy to switch between ANC and transparency mode. Controls are OK but you will have to get used to the required taps and timing them to get registered accurately. I've included a picture to give you a sense of the size. Good selection of ear tips included. I've had several Tozo products in the past and had good experience with them. I expect to with this one as well.

title: Just what I was looking for!
text: I am thoroughly pleased with these earbuds. These are the upgraded version and have a larger battery and a wireless charging case. Yes a wireless charging case. This was a very difficult question to get answered when I was doing my research. I am very pleased with my purchase and highly recommend. My only disappointment was they did not include the warranty Q code for the eighteen month warranty. In fact no warranty info at all.

title: Good fit! Clear sound!
text: Easy to connect. No issues at all with product or connectivity. Clear instructions. Easy to answer, hang up, turn up volume, turn on ANC noise canceling. I’ve used it to watch Netflix on my phone and for phone calls. All worked as described and sound was very clear. I own a previous version of tozo wireless earbuds and these have a new design to fit in the ear better. Happy with my purchase!

title: Good stuff
text: Not perfect but sound quality is amazing. The NC is weird… almost like it pops in your ear when there’s a loud thud. It’s suppose to cancel but instead causes sudden weird sound. If noise cancellation worked little better would have been an easy 5 Star especially for the price during Black Friday.

title: Short term everything so far is great
text: So far so good I've only used them a handful of times but when I'm mowing my yard my and hit the cancelation button I can barely hear my lawn mower at all

title: These headphones are transcendently annoying.
text: Sound is good enough for my audiobooks. Battery is meh. Range is adequate. The biggest problem is feature creep. They've put dozens of possible commands based on different states of the phone. Listening to music enables a different command set than not listening to music, for example. In the media playing layer, they've added toggle noise cancelation, toggle transparent mode, volume up, volume down, next track, previous track, power off left bud, and power off right bud into two "buttons". These same "buttons" are non responsive touch sensitive electric contact surfaces. There is no clicky membrane to provide feedback of how many times you pressed the button or whether you're holding down the button. Add to that there is a delay in response of around half a second, so you're never quite sure if you put the right command unless you wait. The "buttons" are activated sometimes when you try to adjust the position of the buds in the ears. There is also a bug that cranks up the volume to the maximum or minimum if you happen to accidentally activate that command. You can't bump the volume up a little. Your options are max volume or mute. But worst of all: the electrically sensitive touch areas are activated by the current in your hair. Your hair. Picture in your mind that you are walking with your headphones on. Your well conditioned hair brushes against the contact surface and triggers the volume up command. The volume on your audio book gets set to maximum and you have to rip the headphones out of your ear to prevent a ruptured eardrum. While fumbling with the headphones in one hand and manually lowering the volume of your your phone in the other, your palm turns off both headphones because there was five seconds of continuous contact with your skin. The transparent mode is nifty, but only works if both buds are on. The buds are not symmetrical and the left bud does not fit in your right ear. I truly hate these things. I believe they are possessed by the spirit of a housefly that I murdered last year.

title: Stop working after 3 months
text: I was happy about the ear buds and left 5-star review. Now it's been 3 month, passed the return period. It's not working properly. Only one bud can connect, the other one is in paring mode, won't connect. It's not charging issue and it's not my cell phone issue. It's the ear buds. I cannot tell which bid had this issue, it's both. I got random connection if I reset wireless and remove/add the wireless buds, some times it's left bud sometimes it's right bud. Very disturbing. I'm going to stop using it now.

title: LOVE these!!!!!
text: I have been researching for a year for a good pair of NC earbuds that won’t break the bank. After looking and asking questions of people who have them I purchased the TOzO NC9. I have had them a couple weeks and I LOVE them. My boyfriend likes them so much he purchased a pair for himself.

title: These are probably OK if you haven't had better
text: I preferred my previous ear buds that didn't have noise canceling to these. Terrible compare to Pixel Pros, although I do realize there is a dramatic price difference. Dog ate my Pixel Pros. I thought I could maybe get a cheaper pair of noise canceling ones to replace them. They are terrible compared to the Pixel Pros. The highs are just not there. Fairly muddled tone overall. My previous pair that is years old are better than these, although obviously no active noise cancellation. Sent back for refund.

title: awesome earphones
text: these headphones are great and convenient. they are high quality and truly noise canceling. i like how small and compact the charging case is as well. they also stay in your ears pretty nicely

title: Awesome products
text: Great company ....great products. I am a returning customer and will buy again.

title: Awesome, and only had them a day.
text: I own T10, T6 and now NC9 earbuds. The first two fit perfectly and I am pleased to find the the NC9 is as impressive as the previous models. It is likely a mix of the technical quality in sound and ANC, but the fit is superb. So while the Galaxy Buds Pro I bought are a quality product, there was no tip that fit well in my ear, so the ANC was never what I needed. The NC9, on the other hand, shifted me into a world all my own; noise cancelled. I cannot speak to the lack of 5.2 Bluetooth, or battery life, I can say that neither could possibly take much away for this stellar product.

title: great headphones lousy mic
text: Everything is great but the mic sounds like garbage to callers

title: Originally got a defective Pair, but TOZO replaced them
text: These ear buds will NOT stay connected to BT for more than the time it takes to listen to a single song. Complete waste of my time. I returned these to look for a pair that work. As a good point, the Active Noise Cancellation seemed to work very well. UPDATE - Changed to 4 stars. The Company reached out to me and provided a replacement pair, believing the original pair ordered were defective. These really work well for the price. You can get better sound quality, for much more $$$, but I really like how well the ANC works when mowing the lawn for example. I REALLY appreciate how awesome KEVIN @ TOZO customer service was.

title: Changed mind!
text: Tozo saw my previous review complaining about battery life. They contacted me proactively and offered to replace the original set with their current iteration, which includes a slightly larger, wireless charging case. Since everything about these was good, except my perception of the battery life, the improved set should be great! Can't wait to try them!

title: Started Acting up
text: I got these after using the T6 for a while, I was surprised that the noise cancellation feature actually works and dims out surrounding noise. Update: my right earphone has started to sound muffled, my left one works perfectly fine. I’m not sure what’s going on with it

title: Wonderful ear buds at a fraction of the price
text: While I am not an electronics expert, I’ve used a different version of these ese buds and thought they were very good. As a Christmas present I decided to get a pair for my wife and I. The good, they stay in place and the sound quality is very good. The noise cancellation isn’t the best (I don’t have a lot of experience with other types), but these do a good job minimizing incoming noises. I have a set of Bose SoundSport earbuds and though it’s apparent the audio isn’t nearly as good, but for the price these do what they need to. I would certainly recommend these to anyone interested in something cheaper than Bose, Apple, or Beats.

title: Fairly happy with these
text: I’m not an audiophile, so I’m not the best for describing a sound, but I say it sounds decent for the price for podcasts, audiobooks, and indie rock. The noise canceling works good, not as good as my nice ones that I lost (hence buying a $30 pair), but it’s good enough to help a little. The thing I dislike about these, almost send back worthy, is they don’t disconnect from my phone every time I put them away. And later, if they were disconnected but I move the case from my purse to it’s place, the small jostling of that movement will wake them up and connect to my phone again. It’s kind of a small thing, but it’s really annoying. I think the buttons are responsive and the system of taps make sense. I bought the white to help with not losing this case in the future. I also like that they have a bigger case for this reason. My last ones had a lipstick sized case. These have…. Hm. A smaller and thicker but close to altoid tin size.

title: Truly wireless and comfortable - unable to use for Teams?
text: So far, so good! I purchased these to use with my PC for my new remote job. These sound great, cancel outside noise, and are really easy to set up and use. I will update my review after I’ve had the chance to use them more. EDIT 3/5/2021: When I join a teams call on my PC using these earbuds, one earbud disconnects immediately and the sound starts going in and out as though it's losing connection. I have been unable to fix this during a call for more than a few seconds. This only seems to be an issue in Teams, and I have been able to use these to listen to music on my PC without issue. My Bluetooth drivers are up-to-date. TOZO has agreed to send a replacement set, and I will update my review.

title: So glad I finally bought something
text: The only problem with these is my coworkers thought I was ignoring them. The noise canceling worked well. I haven’t been surprised by a coworker coming up behind me but I definitely wouldn’t know if someone in a normal voice called my name.

title: Syncing
text: The only thing I wished they could do that they can't is sync two devices at one time.

title: As expected at this price point
text: Was looking forward to getting these given positive reviews for NC9 and other Tozo wireless earbuds. Pros: 1. Earbuds weigh very little 2. They pair easily with iPhone 3. Touch controls are intuitive 4. Charging case is portable & uses USB-C 5. Six sizes of silicone plugs are included 6. 18 month warranty is great Cons: 1. Max volume is too low 2. Not enough emphasis on bass 3. Vocals are too sibilant 4. Smallest silicone plug is still too big for me 5. ANC does nothing to reduce noise 6. Transparent mode makes no difference Overall there is room for improvement but at the $50 price point probably not much more can be done. Will go for >$100 options like the Jabra Elite or Galaxy Buds next time. I understand ANC is probably unlikely to be any good under <$200. And obviously over the ears will always produce better sound than earbuds but sacrifice portability.

title: Fantastic product.
text: The sound quality is unbelievable. It supersedes all my previous headphones and earbuds, immersive experience even better than over-the-ear headphones. Battery life is crazy. They say 10 hours, but after 5 hours of listening, I still have 75% of the battery level. Some people complain it's not comfortable, but that is a particularity of those people's anatomy. 90% of us find it very comfortable. The volume, >, transparency, noise cancelation, everything is managed with a touch. I couldn't be more enthusiastic with these great earbuds, and no, I don't work for TOZO. I'm just overwhelmed by how great long hours of high-quality music I'm enjoying. It's a long run.

title: Looses audio
text: Difficult to settle these into one’s ears without activating invisible controls on the sides and then they fall out too easily. Useless on phone calls. Randomly disconnects from whatever program is being played on iPhone. But they do sync quickly with phone.

title: Love these
text: Great Product for a Great Price! I have 3 of these. 1 for my wife, 1 for my daughter, and one for me

title: Great quality!
text: Love these earbuds! They work great. They stay in my ears, sound quality is awesome and the price, even better. Can’t ask for anything more.

title: Solid pair of earbuds, excellent fit and sound
text: I've used several earbuds in the mid-price-range in the past, including a different set from Tozo, their T6, which I found to be very good quality. This NC9 set is definitely a superior product. The fit of the T6 was good, but this fits even better, not just the 6 different rubber tip sizes but the overall shape of the earbud. Like the other Tozo product pairing is simple and easy to switch between using these on different devices, and the touch controls are easy to use and not overly sensitive. I have tested switching between the Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and Transparency modes and do hear the difference as these earbuds suppress or draw in external noises. It does seem to work as advertised although I've noticed that in my house when it's mostly quiet the Transparency mode seems to introduce a slight white noise, like someone running a faucet on the other side of the house. Doesn't really interfere with listening (it's more noticeable when there is no audio playing). Anyway I use the earbuds in ANC mode most of the time and using it thus the audio is excellent - better than any other wireless earbud I've owned (Tozo or otherwise). I mostly listen to audiobooks, podcasts, and conference calls and the sound is crystal clear without having to crank up the volume. Highly recommended.

title: Love these
text: Much less expensive then Apple ones, and the quality of sound is decided I use them every day while working out and have not had any issues

title: Great headphones and noise cancellation! Thank you Tozo !
text: These are comfortable. Have good or better sound, good noise cancellation, a variety of ear tip options for comfort and great battery life. It is hard to believe these pack all the features and qualities they do at this price. Tozo does a great job at designing great products at excellent value and that work well. These are great for work or play and even better as a gift. The gift recipient will think you spent far more money! Thank you Tozo.

title: Good product for everyday use at a reasonable price.
text: Comofortable, well designed and good quality for a very reasonable price.

title: Love these earbuds
text: Nice earbuds. Last about 7 hrs of continuous use. Noise canceling and good quality sound. I wear to bed to block husband's snoring.

title: Good quality, low volume and a few annoyances
text: The device fits perfect for me. easy to pair and instructions are clear and simple. Mic was prefect for conference calls. Good work here. The part that was not as well was volume. there is an over reliance on ANC to reduce outside noise to account for the low volume and the low volume with ANC to keep battery going. The overall effect still has lower than avg battery life. I was contacted by the manufacturer and was offered to change my review by providing compensation or remove the review so to maintaining high star rating. The other reviews may not be accurate so see other review sites before purchasing.

title: Too big for my ear
text: I bought this because of the ergonomic design and ANC, but the earbuds are too big for my ears. After wearing them for 3 hours, my ears hurt. The talk time of TOZO NC9 is about 3 hours. The talk time is about 3.5 hours for my Airpods Pro. I use them to teach on Zoom and recorded the time. However, ANC with music playing is about as good as my AirPods Pro. Both TOZO NC9 and Airpods Pro have about the same clarity in picking up voice. The sound quality for playing music is better than Airpods Pro because TOZO NC9 earbuds have a stronger bass than Airpods Pro.

title: Good for the on sale price!
text: So I've had these for a few months now and they're still working just fine. They really are quite a nice product. They fit well and stay in the ear pretty good. Their noise canceling is "ok" and I only say that because the older model I also owned seemed to do it better. Battery life while In anc mode is about 6-8 hours. My only real problem is a minor one with the case, as with this model the case has no way of showing you its charge without plugging it in. Overall fine product!

title: Sound is great + noice canceling works!
text: I use them for everything from walks to work (I work from home making calls) and they work wonderfully. Highly recommend!

title: Overall was very happy with them, now I’m disappointed.
text: Overall all was pretty happy with these. Noise canceling was nice for traveling and ambient noise. Sound was better quality then the sound core ear buds I have. I did find the buttons a little to touchy but that was fine at this price point. Now the left ear bud will not pair up or work. I’ll try and resolve this some more. If I find a fix I’ll update other wise I’m a little disappointed. Update: done several searches to resolve issue and done multiple resets with no real success. I guess I’ll chalk it up as more Amazon crap.

title: Great Earbuds for the Price
text: Excellent earbuds at this price point. Also, excellent customer service by TOZO.

title: Affordable Active Noise Cancelling earbuds. Great for Construction Guys.
text: The sound quality is great and perfectly balanced. I work in the construction dept. When I use a chainsaw or a wood chipper, it gets really loud. So, I use the ANC function to protect my ears. It works better than my 3M Peltor headsets. ANC and transparent mode can be switched by tapping left earbud. It's touch controlled, way better than buttons. Here are the reasons I chose this Tozo ANC 1. When I play songs, the sound quality is great: not too bassy, just perfect. 2. Call quality is great. Use the transparent mode while on a call to hear surroundings. Which is great when you want a little awareness of what's going on in the background. 3. Use the ANC mode to protect my ears from loud power tools. Perfect while using gas lawnmower. 4. After done using power tools / lawnmower use the "transparent" mode to hear surrounding or talk to someone without taking earbuds off. I'm still wondering how they put all this technology into this tiny earbuds 🤔🤔.

title: Noise Cancelling intermittent/ annoying
text: Bought these and Tozo T12's for side by side comparison. These are twice the price, but have noise cancelling capabilities. Sound is great, but noise cancelling keeps kicking in and out, along with volume of music (that's just walking around inside my house). It is VERY annoying! Returning

title: Not as expected
text: When not anc mode, I hear some squeaky sound on left pod. Returned and got another one but same issue.

title: High hopes...Ultimately disappointed.
text: Grabbed these to replace my 3 year old pair of random off brand earbuds I bought off Amazon. I did my research and read countless reviews on the Tozo earbud line. My focus was using them for running and gym workouts so I decided on the NC9s. I've had then for about 4 months now and they are not as good as my 3 year old pair. The sound quality is mediocre and the noise cancelation is below average. Sounds ranges from really quiet to hurting my eardrums... My two biggest issues are they always fallout out of my ear will minimal movement and any microscopic touch pauses the music... When I itch my head or put my hands behind my head for sit ups I'll accidentally brush a portion of my hand against one and boom...paused music.. Really annoying when your in the zone at the gym or running. I don't recommend these earbuds at all.

title: Great sounding earbuds and good customer service so far
text: For the price, these earbuds have exceptional quality. One if not the best wireless bluetooth earbuds I have ever used--and I've used a lot! I have to say, I have very annoying loud neighbors who blast their loud music every weekend night and the noise cancelling would just all block it all out. I wore them in the house almost all the time even and in bed, switching from noise cancelling to transparency whenever I needed to talk to someone. Clear crisp sound, amazing bass, and comfortable. As with their customer service, they're great so far. I immediately contacted TOZO customer service after one of my earbuds had stopped responding. They responded in a timely manner and offered to replace the earbuds with new ones. They really do make sure that their customers are 100% satisfied. So, so far it has been a worry-free experience.

title: Works well, good value
text: Have enjoyed using at work, and while mowing/trimming in the yard

title: Good inexpensive Buds that stopped working but here is another Update
text: I find these produce a good quality sound both for music and for Podcasts. While the noise cancellation does work, it is limited in what it does. I was giving these a good review but suddenly the left ear bud will no longer take a charge. I have contacted the company and we will see what happens. I contacted the company and they were very prompt in saying they would send me a new bud for the left ear which had stopped taking a charge. So I increased my rating back to 4 and hopefully there will be no needed updates.

title: Awesome
text: Been buying cheap crappy earbuds, thought I'd try these before I went out and spent a couple of bills on name brand. So far very pleased

title: Sounds like popcorn to others on phone calls.
text: First off I love the feel and overall sound of these buds as the wearer. The sound canceling feature is good and makes a big difference. The problem we have with these buds is when I'm on phone with others in my semitruck, I've been told it sounds like popcorn is in the background and is annoying to whomever i'm talking with. I may have a pop or rattle in my truck but nothing that overpowers my voice with other devices. Maybe these are picking up the sounds too good.

title: Right earbud won’t stay charged after only 64 days.
text: This is the 2nd Tozo product I’ve had crap out just after a few weeks. Like everything else it’s just typical garbage. We all know who and why.

title: Excellent product for the price! Room for minor improvements.
text: These are excellent for the price. Nice clear crisp sound and pretty good bass. They fit snug in the ear, but I do find after an hour or so my ears are a little sore from having them in. The transparency mode is useful, takes away from sound quality a little, but it does serve its purpose. I use budget ($50) over the ear Cowin E7 Headphones while on my computer and would still much rather wear them over the TOZO's for in home use. But on the go, working out, hiking, mowing the lawn, these little things are excellent. I have no experience with the Apple AirPods so I cannot compare. One thing that can be improved is either adding the ability to connect the buds to more than one device without having to delete them from the bluetooth connections or try to reset the earbuds. It took forever and multiple tries to get the earbuds to reset so I could connect with my phone after having it connected to my FireTV. A bit annoying and for that reason, they will never be connected to anything else other than my phone due to the hassle. I also wish the case could be recharged wirelessly. That's not something that would detract from the overall rating for me, but I believe TOZO's cheaper earbud cases have this ability.

title: # GET THEM #
text: I do like my sound and sound quality. This is my own personal experience with these, I compared these to the Apple wired headphones that came with my iphone 12, Beats PRO Studio, Skull Candy wireless bluetooth. I wanted something cheap that sounded decent, I work in aviation and needed some noise cancelling. I found these to be better than iphone12 standard wire headphones, Not even close to the Beats, but Identical to sound and performance to the Skull Candy which I would consider it's direct competition and are priced very close to it. After a full charge, these things lasted a full 10 hour shift, with obvious turn off for breaks and such. So realistically around 8 hours or more of play time. I was surprised by the range. I had my phone in my room, and walked outside, and after 2 interior walls and house wall it was close to about 30 feet away before signal dropped off. Very comfortable, easy to use, and sound very good. At the time of review these were $40, not a bad price. But other name brands of much higher quality have brought their prices down the years, namely JBL.

title: Great Earbud Sound
text: The sound is great. I’m no audiophile, but theses sound really good. They fit well and the touch buttons work well.

title: Great value option
text: There may be better options for ear buds but for the money, these are great. The wind cancellation settings are amazing with the app and the frequency adjustment capability in the app make custom audio settings a breeze. These stay in my ears comfortably for hours. Pay more If you want to but it won’t be worth it.

title: Great product/Great price!
text: I have avoided ear buds in the past because of various issues, but these are my second pair of Tozo ear buds, and I love the quality, ease of use and value. Highly recommend.

title: Hubby LOVES these
text: We had already purchased something similar at Sams club but the battery life was short...so hubby decided he wanted another pair, so I did some research and decided on these. Hubs is very happy with these..in fact, he likes them better than the ones purchased at Sams club and THESE WERE LESS EXPENSIVE. He says the sound quality and the noise cancellation are excellent.

title: Great buy!
text: On unveiling it’s a winner! Sound is phenomenal for the price, looking forward to my workout with these babies.

title: Noise Cancelling Doesn't Work
text: Update, reducing to one star, the only mode that works is transparent so any external noise interferes with buds. Completely unusable. Original: Worked fine for about a month, now when noise cancelling is turned on, right ear is static and severely impacts sound quality, so that feature can't really be used anymore. Too late to return.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE
text: Customer Service has been very helpful so far. Right ear bud quite working and they decided to send us a new one no charge and no need to return the broken one.

title: Fell out of my ear with in the first minute
text: I really wanted to like them for their noise cancellation. I have seizures and was looking for away to turn out noises to help. Price and reviews seemed great. Got here in time as well. Fitted them inside my house walked around all. Had a doctors appointment put them in my ear in the car. Walked up the boardwalk to office one fell out less then a min after I put them in. I felt it gone right away. I searched the ground (clean boardwalk) for over 30 min. Even went back later no sign of it. I also have a pair of AirPods to use with my phone never had lost those before. Glad I had decided to wear an less expensive piece for the very day noise stuff. Now the one left over is useless because the noise cancellation only works when both are in the ear. So zero stars for fitting.

title: Noise cancellation is a bust
text: I buy headphones and earphones with the option of noise cancellation because i travel a lot. I need that option to muff background irritating noises especially airplane engine noise. This failed in that department. Sound quality is nice, fit is good. Battery life is ok.

title: works for me
text: I had my kids compare the quality of sound vs their Apple products and they said it sounded different but was pretty good. I like how they have the waterproof feature. I sweat during workouts and these don't seem to have an issue with that. Overall good quality sound, nice fit, and great price.

title: Revised.
text: Revised: They must have done an update because that are working. I bought this in April and it was working great! Recently it gave me all the problems, only one working, static and wouldn't pair. I did the troubleshooting and they even give you videos to assist but nothing worked. If you go through the support it won't connect. They were a 5 that went to 1.

title: Alot of boom for the buck!
text: I purchased these when my new phone didn't have headphone jack. I charge them and their case on Sundays and they are good to go all week at work with 5 to 6 hours of use a day. The noise canceling isn't as good as some over the ear models I had before but was still good enough to jam out while doing my lawn mowing. They work as well as my GF apple product at 20% of the price. Comfortable to wear too!

title: Allergic reaction
text: Man, these gave me the worst rash / allergic reaction in my ear. It cause discharge and crazy ear irritation for over a week. Going to try and swap out the foam buds but man buyer beware.

title: Slim look, good bass, active noise cancelling, buy it now!
text: Absolutely love these earbuds! I am amazed of the sound quality, you won’t be disappointed. Case is pretty slim, seems well built and has “L” and “R” stamped on the side of the earbuds to help. Noise cancelling is effective if you put on the right sized earbud tip and if you wear these ear buds properly. When I first put them in, I sort of just pushed them in and weren’t in all the way. Sound was low and noise cancelling barely made a difference. It was then I twisted them while wearing them that the earbuds made a good seal in my ear and sound was drastically better and active noise cancelling was improved. I was impressed at the sound quality and bass these earbuds put out. For 1/4 of the cost of the popular options nowadays its definitely worth it! Battery life is great and plenty of ear tip options for different sized ears. Thanks again Tozo!

title: Wouldn’t buy again
text: Wouldn’t buy again. Poor sound quality and earbuds constantly fall out of ears.. Started having after using them for two months.

title: Noise cancellation
text: Easy to sync easy to place in ears . Noise cancellation doesn't exist as far as I could tell .

title: TOZO NC9 wireless earbuds
text: These were my first pair of "real" wireless earmuffs. (Side note: how can you sell 1 wireless earbud when we have 2 ears?) I digress... these earbuds are pretty nice. I'm glad I invested the extra money. Pairing was super easy. After reading the instruction manual they were easy to use. I just had to remember what side controlled what but after a while you get used to it. The sound quality is good and it does have a good amount of bass. The noise cancelling function worked well enough for me. Since these were my first ANC wireless earbuds I don't really have anything to compare it to. It worked nicely drowning out the noise in an airport. As for battery life the charging case lasts pretty long. The earliest lasted a good amount of time before needing to be recharged. The only adjustments that would be nice are an on/off functionality for the earbuds and case, as well as a way to be able to attach the case to a key ring or lanyard. Other than that I'm very satisfied.

title: Terrible fit and finicky.
text: I have the TOZO NC6 and it has been some of the best wireless headphones I have ever had! I have owned them for almost 2 years now and they still work fantastic! I was excited about trying the NC9 and looking forward to the noise cancelation. But I have been very disappointed. The fit makes my ears sweat ( I have never had this problem before!) and they are constantly falling out. I cannot decide if they are too big or too small. There are almost too many functions and hard to get the pressure and timing right to control them. They don't automatically connect to any of my devices (phone, laptop) which was never a problem with the NC6. The only place I can use them is if I am wearing both (you cannot just wear one of them at a time) and sitting still at a desk. The noise cancelation works well and the sound is fine. Battery life is amazing. They are just very uncomfortable. Can not chew or move around too much or they will fall out.

title: Better than expected
text: For the price, these aren’t bad at all. In fact, after reading some reviews, these exceeded my expectations. They are clearly a Chinese brand as even the voice to do things is a Chinese girl/accent, which does not bother me. The battery life seems to be good so far! The noise canceling is also better than expected at the gym

title: Updated Review & 3 more stars.
text: These were going to be a backup for my Air Pods Pro. In the screenshot, you'll see the EQ settings it took to make these buds usable. Bass is non-existant, and highs are shrill and unpleasant. The buds are enormous, and there's Blue Tooth latency; even the touch commands have a silly delay. Finally, the English instructions mangle the language. Yuck! You get what you pay for. In Tozo's defense, the marketing and packaging is attractive. 6 months after this review, Tozo reached out and offered me their updated NC2 Buds on a complimentary basis, with no strings attached. That surprised me! I ran a half-dozen of my favorite songs through them and liked the sound out of the box. The interface is intuitive, while the noise canceling is pretty subtle. We'll see how they hold up, but on this first day, I'm impressed. But again: we're talking about the NC2 now.

title: Case does not charge wirelessly
text: I have the Tozo 6 and love them except for the way they hung out of my ear (I have small ears) and the case was able to be charged wirelessly. The fit of these NC9's are much better and the sound quality is great. My gripe is with the case - it cannot be charged wirelessly. Just like cell phones - one of the weak points of these devices is the cable port for charging. I will be keeping these, but really wish they had the wireless recharge feature.

title: noise cancelation worthless on plane.
text: noise cancelation was worthless on a plane. went back to wired earbuds. sound quality otherwise pretty good. mainly wanted use to be wire free when flying :(

title: Noise cancelation is not so good. I would buy a full headphone if that is importand.
text: Noise cancelation is not so good. I am not sure if it can be better than this on this size though. Battery life is super good. For me sound quality is more than enough. I wouldn’t buy this if I had known before hand I bought it for flights I thought it’s compact and noise canceling. I don’t need to carry the big ones. I made a mistake. Overall solid headphones just wasn’t so good for my need.

title: Volume and sound distortion
text: It's very difficult to adjust volume which is still low and muddy. Some distortion . I have another Tozo set which is superior to this set whose batteries weren't holding a charge very long from so much use. So I am very disappointed in this set and would recommend you look into another set.

title: Love Love Love these earbuds
text: Love love love the sound, I bought Jabra 75t sent them back because no joke these sound better. Feel good in the ear look great. You won’t beet these earbuds for the price and there much more experience one out there won’t come close

title: Great Bass, Good Fit
text: These things are great! Looking for more bass and higher volume, this headphone set fits the bill. Just came from the T12 version, which are good, the NC9 takes their good and improves on it. They fit very well in my ears also, which isn’t easy to do. The case is a little better too, missing the neat digital battery info but I’m willing to let that go for the the quality sound, and pretty reasonable price.

title: One stopped charging after a few months. Can't create a nice seal in my ear.
text: Bought them back in January but didn't really use them until April. Sometime in April the right bud didn't charge, so I used a paper towel and cleaned out the contacts for getting powered and it worked. About 2 months later, same issue, but now the cleaning won't work. They are technically waterproof, but I try not to get them wet if I can help it since another pair(not this model, but same manufacturer) quickly degraded from the chlorine when swimming. The contacts don't even look bad to be honest. But now I have just a left earbud for something that is suppose to cancel noise. Also, the buds weren't really big enough to fill my ears, and if I put on bigger tips, they wouldn't fit in the case. Kind of meh about that since that's a big part about cancelling noise out too. Update 8/12/2022. The right bud ended up working again, but now it decides to short out the USB system on my computer when charging. Used a wall USB charger for a few days and now it just won't charge. Finally dead. Hopefully better luck with the T6.

title: Keep disconnecting like everyone else's, in the beginning
text: Garbage. Worked great first month. Insert them deep and the sound is great and all external noise goes away. Battery life is decent, not great. I use them in the gym and sweat doesn't seem to bother them. BUT After two months of use, I now have one or both randomly cutting in and out, and just tonight, they are now randomly disconnecting and then reconnecting. At no point have I ever used them more than 25 feet away from my phone (my gym is the biggest room I've ever used them in, and its at work, and not huge), and during tonight's shenanigans, I had my phone next to me on the kitchen counter as I made food, literally feet away. Cannot recommend. -- Udpate This weekend was the worst. Now only one will play audio, and its random which one it will be. Turning my head from side to side makes them pair and unpair. Complete and total garbage after less than six months of ownership. Terrible, terrible, garbage product. Update. Contacted the company for support via amazon, their tech support process, and an email address on their main website. No reply. Junk. UPDATE May 2021 Company contacted me after seeing this review and sent me a new set. So far so good. I will update the review after a few months of use. Upgraded from one star to four stars due to good customer service and the new buds working so far.... Update August 1 I think. No issues. When the gym gets super busy they get choppy with interference, but all my wireless buds do, and I assume it's because all buds share a common frequency bandwidth space. More ear buds in the room means less bandwidth to work with. Can recommend. But be prepared to send them back if necessary.

title: They work well, till they dont...
text: I bought this buds almost a month ago and since week #2 the left side bud started doing a weird, annoying buzz sound when in Noise Cancelling mode. Then pairing problems... im returning them and probably paying some extra for a brand that actually works....

title: Extremely satisfied! (Musician)
text: Sound quality = very good (solid bass and range) Comfort = I forget they are in at times. Features = everything I want (volume, next/prev song, pause, mode changes, transparent mode is awesome - don’t need to remove them to hear people talking to you) Only possible down side might be for people with small ears - possibly not fitting well.

title: T10 to T12 to These...
text: I was offered a deal I couldn't refuse. I enjoyed both the T10 and T12 so when these came available I jumped. I experienced very good sound characteristics, and little "case-shock"- because it didn't provide wireless-charging like the T12 or T10. However the case is smaller, but well equipped. The sound modes are Noise Cancelling and Transparency. I recommend these for ultralight Noise Cancelling headphones in lieu of the traditional balky headphones.

title: DO NOT PURCHASE!
text: DO NOT PURCHASE! I have purchased a lot of things online and this is the first one that I felt I needed to write a review. I only used them 8 times, the right earpiece only lasts about 5 minutes now and disconnects. The left one lasts about 10 more minutes but then turns off. Don't waste your money!

title: First pair died in a week.
text: I wanted to love these, I still do. New pair on the way. These replaced my 10's that I ran over with my car. They never fit right and would fall out while moving. These fit and stay in 10x better for me, YMMV. Taking a risk reordering these guys and will hope I was unlucky. Worked great first week, then just a few minutes the left one stopped pairing. For the price they were a great value at $36 after sale + coupon. Good bass, decent treble and almost decent mids, the bass is very loose sounding though. Either way price to quality of sound A rating. They were a tad slower to pair than the 10's, but reasonably quick. The transparent mode is dumb and shouldn't exist. The ANC works pretty well, again very impressive at this price. If they didn't immediately break these would get a five star review. Hopefully the next set either lasts a long time or dies within the return window.

title: Great customer support
text: TOZO support reached out to me after I posted my initial review in which I had experienced an issue with these, and they were incredibly nice to me, and are sending me a new pair, free of charge - I have to give them a lot of credit for that, most companies don't take care of their customers like that. Kudos to them! *Update* I've just received the new pair, and am quite happy now.

title: Great product
text: Recommended by a fellow physician for use with teleworking, highly recommended. They are comfortable and keep the surrounding office noise muted for patient calls. Just wish the battery life was longer

title: Good quality for the price
text: Pros Easy set up, good sound and fairly comfortable. Compact and easy carrying case. Cons They dont last as long as others I have had in the past though they charge quickly. I get about 4-6 hours continuous of use before I have to charge them. And you get about and hr for every 10 min of charge using type C.

title: Cool stuff
text: Super easy to use and sounds great. Can listen at lower volumes compared to others I’ve had and very comfortable

title: NC9 beasts
text: Beautiful design and packing. Come out of the box charged, so that's a plus. Noise cancelling feature is good, but shines at high volume only.

title: Great NC earbuds
text: I like everything about these earbuds. They block out most noise, good touch controls, earbuds and case hold charge for a long time, comfortable to wear for a long time.

title: Decent Ear Pods
text: Doesn’t seem to have much mid range in the ear pods.

title: Quality Earbuds
text: I love these earbuds, they do exactly what I need them today do. The sound is great, battery life is excellent, really good range and they do cancel out the noise. The only drawback is that they are a little bulky in my ear.

title: Comfortable and good quality
text: The noise cancelation feature on these can be turned off and on, and works very well for earbuds you can hear the difference immediately when you turn it on with the touch controls Sound quality is great, good bass, Bluetooth functions perfectly, connects to my phone immediately after pairing Better than most of the more expensive options, definitely worth the money Also comfort is good if you choose the right size rubber thing, it comes with quite a few and I forget they are in my ears sometimes Submerged under water by accident as well and still works

title: One of the buds fails to pair
text: The noise cancelling is ok- not great, but does work ok. Of issue is that the left bud stopped pairing after one use. I’ve tried resetting it with no success. Will most likely return.

title: Good product, until it stops working. Then tozo store support was good, so can’t complain.
text: These worked great and the power lasted all of my workday. 6-8months in the right one stopped functioning correctly, even after resetting. The problem is deeper than that, i would be content to only have the left audio and the right for only noise canceling, but the right one repeatedly turns itself on and connects without actually playing audio so all I hear in my right ear is power on, power on, connected, power on...ad nauseum, very annoying because I can’t use it for active noise canceling with it off. I expected them to last longer than this, I don’t abuse them in any way but it just won’t fix. Now i’m giving setting them aside as a backup, but ordering another brand, not even a year later.

title: Good at first, then horrible - Then Really good
text: Wireless charging stopped working first, noise canceling was ok at best and now it barely holds a charge. I commute and was hoping noise canceling would be better, doesn’t work with a subway coming... Now I’d like to use them at the gym, but the charge barely lasts an hour. Wish I could return. Update: After reading this review, Tozo customer service contacted me and offered me a Amazon credit or a new set of earbuds. I really liked the earbud so I took a chance and had them send new ones. They came quickly and the box says "updated", they are just a bit different, I think the case is slicker. Anyway they work MUCH better than the old ones that failed after a few months. The Noise cancelling is very good, much better than the more expensive Jabra's that they sent me to demo. I will buy another pair for my wife for the gym. Thank you Tozo Customer service!!

title: Great for price point!
text: I've had these for about 2 weeks now and here are the major points (a few of which are compared to the TOZO T6): PROS: -ANC is decent (I use the bus and it works wonderfully) -surprisingly rich sound; bass is strong, without muffling the rest -better touch controls (no voiced 'forward' or 'reverse' just a quick beep -> compared to the T6) -slimmer profile/fits in the ear better CONS: -reduced battery life (probably because of the ANC); this includes the number of charges on the case as well -not waterproof/water resistant -though clearer in sound, sometimes it gets very thin and brittle with the highs -ANC may not be as good as it can be These buds are great! Be wary - as far as I know, they immediately default to ANC mode when taken out of the case and there is no in-between from ANC and transparent mode. The mic also has some trouble coming out clear, but it may depend on the platform being used. When recording my own voice in a memo however, it sounded very small and far away. Overall though, they are an excellent choice and deliver quite well given the price!

title: Good quality for the price point
text: Good looking and sounding ear buds, I am so far very happy.

title: About as good as it gets for sound quality!
text: About as good as it gets for sound quality! These are awesome buds. Great overall sound with excellent bass, clarity, and highs. I’ve compared to multiple others and these are my favs. Sound is very close to Fiil T1X’s with the additional benefit of noise canceling, which works fairly well. Only negative is ambient mode allows some sound pass through, but not much. Good fit with the included assortment of tips. Great battery life, with recharging via USB C. Very compact case that seems to be good quality. Look no further if sound is your main criteria.

title: Ear buds
text: Noise reduction is good. Sound quality is good. Fit is ok.

title: Good sound quality and support
text: These earbuds have good sound quality and they're very comfortable. The Bluetooth functionality works well with my Samsung phone. I purchased these to replace a pair of Samsung Galaxy Buds that I lost. The NC9s have a much better water protection rating which was always a concern I had with the higher priced Samsungs. I had to contact support for an issue and they were super quick to respond and take care of it. Great customer service.

title: Great for using on commercial mowing crew
text: Lost one of my expensive noise canceling Sony ear buds so wanted to find cheap alternative. Order these based on reviews and I am blow away. Sound canceling (May be due to fit) is better then Sony’s , connectivity is easier and faster, bass is outstanding. I just can’t believe it basically negates all engine sounds when using my commercial mowing equipment. Maybe 10% comes through but it literally sounds like wind up toys as opposed to deafening loudness. Have not gotten wet yet besides mild sweating from Florida’s heat but overall super impressed.

title: Great Service
text: These are great for the money. Very easy to use and great sound and cancellation for earbuds. TOZO also has great customer service.

title: Works well, most of the time
text: I got these to replace my older wireless headset, the kind that hangs on your neck with the retractable earbuds. Battery life has so far been great, I will use these for about an hour and put them back in the case. Used at least five times before having to charge the case. Pairing works ok, sometimes the right one doesn't pair and you have to disconnect and try over and over. One time I had to pair each earbud separately, that was fun. Sometimes the audio isn't synched up between both earbuds either, that is a little trippy. This happened both when one and both were paired directly to my phone. My other issue is the rubber earbuds themselves. They are too small for me. Luckily, as with most people, you probably have old ones or extras laying around. This set does NOT come with additional sizes, although it does have extras. Obviously the extras are useless for me as they are too small. I found larger ones in my pile of extra crap and they work great, until I put the set back in its case. At that point, the larger rubber pieces are too large for the case. The case may either pop open or the rubber gets stuck when you pull out the earbud. Sound quality and noise cancellation are pretty good. It could just be my phone, but I have the sound all the way down and it is still a little louder than I would like. Could be the phone, could be preference. You decide.

title: Real Bang for your Buck !
text: GREAT product for your money! Highly recommend for anyone who like a good quality noise canceling earbuds and doesn’t want to spend the entire Government Stimulus Check on it .

title: GREAT BUDS for the price, unbeatable in fact
text: (All my reviews are unpaid, straight, no conflicts of interest.) The sound quality for these ~~$60 earbuds is fantastic. The fingertip touch controls are well thought-out and work nicely. I wore these for about 8 straight hours first time after charging, with ANC activated, and they were comfortable. With about 20 min left before the first bud died, and my Galaxy S21 saying the buds had 10% battery left, received the first low battery warning. 2 hrs of the total time was streaming video while on aerobic exercise machines. THE REVIEWS THAT SAY THERE IS A SPEECH DELAY ARE NOT CORRECT, AT LEAST FOR THE "NC9 UPGRADED" version -- audio and video match perfectly. (There are some shows on Youtube and other streams where things, if you look closely, are mismatched to begin with - NOT a function of these buds.) For battery life, ANC was on the vast majority of the time I used the buds, and this was the first cycle with the batteries (which may improve after a few cycles). Our gym is noise-central, so I really wanted great Active Noise Cancellation. There is definitely a discernable difference between ANC and Transparent mode, but I didn't think the ANC was all that great. So I ordered a pair of Samsung Galaxy Bud Pro's, and guess what, this Tozo has better thought-out and easier-to-use touch controls, AND THE ANC IS EQUALLY AS GOOD when tested using microwave noise and beeps, TV volume, and hair dryer to test, after I couldn't tell any difference between the ANC at the gym. So, I'm updating my review and upgrading this to 4+, probably best deal on the planet, not as many bells and whistles as Samsung, no Android App that I've discovered yet, but Samsung's are on their way back, and I'm keeping these little beauties.

title: Comfortable and easy to use
text: These earbuds have good sound quality and are very comfortable. Definitely a good value.

title: Music good, phone calls bad
text: The sound quality was pretty good, however while using the phone to talk to someone with these, they were hearing every bit of background noise to the point they were unable to stay on the phone with me.

title: Great Noise cancelling Earbuds. Good value for the money.
text: I bought these for my wife to use while driving in her Mustang with the top down. They weren't that good a fit for that because the engine noise isn't constant enough. It worked great while on the highway but around town every time she accelerated you could here the engine break into the conversation. However, I now use them as my go-to earbuds whenever I'm working around the yard with power tools. The noise-canceling works great to cut out the noise of mowing, power washing, snow blowing, essentially any power tools. The sound from these is consistent and the NC9 earbuds work great for cutting out the noise allowing music or audiobooks to come through without issue and it protects the ears from all the white noise. I also like that you can take them off noise-canceling mode, which allows my wife to communicate with me when I'm wearing them normally while I'm not working with power tools. I was a little disappointed with the battery life in that it only lasts a few hours and when I'm working outside the whole day I have to stop and charge them. But they are a great deal for the money and I just use them when I'm using loud equipment and then switch to some airpods when I'm doing quieter stuff. I highly recommend them. Update: I reached out to TOZO regarding the battery issues and they were awesome. They replaced the airbuds. Awesome support. They really stand by their product

title: These are the top of my list
text: This is the 3rd set of earbuds I have tried and finally I find a pair that give me all I want. I was looking for a good fit, great battery life, and of course Noise Cancelling. The other two either ran out of battery life after 3-4 hours or they fell out of my ears, and none of the others had Noise Cancelling. The Tozo NC9 fills all 3 needs, and it pairs quickly. Easily the top of my list.

title: Very clear sound
text: I use these while doing wood work. I can hear the music clearly over my saw. The battery last for several hours. I would buy again

title: Perfect fit out of the box
text: Just opened the box and everything looks great! Fits great already out of the box and it showed up earlier that he expected. Going to charge them up and see how they do, but based on other reviews I'm sure I'll be equally pleased as everyone else!

title: Comfortable, stylist, great sound
text: Stylish, black, small and comfortable ear buds for the price it is a great deal. Great for talking on the phone, exercising, walking on the beach. They do block outside noise. Sound quality is good and super convenient. The best part is they don't pop out of the ear. They come with variety of earbud size rubber fitted covers

title: Great headphones for the price
text: Arrived quickly. Easy to use. Great value for the price

title: Quality
text: Excellent sound. Deep base. Great highs. And super noise cancelling!

title: First pair failed, second pair great
text: Update 2/11/21: Rating changed from 1 to 5 stars. I am updating this review to reflect my experience with customer service (Tozo's own customer service, not Amazon's). They proactively contacted me directly offering to replace the defective pair I initially got. This was outside of Amazon's 30-day return period but within the warranty period, so I was happy to work with them to get a second pair. More than a month after that, the second pair continues to work well. We'll see if they last longer than the three months the first pair did, but so far so good on this pair. --- Thank goodness I bought this during Amazon's extended holiday returns period! I so wish this would have worked better. It's been three months and the left earbud has just stopped working. No matter how long I connect it to charge or what I do, it will just stop working after about 1 minute. The battery meter shows it fully charged, but it will not stay connected. I've reset it multiple times, tried unpairing and repairing, but nothing. Battery life at first was amazing, fully 7+ hours on a full charge. I loved it. Theyre comfortable, pair quickly, and overall are a solid buy ... if only it would still work after 3 months.

title: I don’t liked
text: I change my review, because i tested two of nc9. The battery case don’t hold the charge.

title: Awesome ear phones
text: Sound quality is great, noise cancellation is also good and as for battery life, so far so good.

title: Needs work to improve design.
text: Great sound quality! Just ok noise cancellation.Battery life is ok if you seat headphones perfectly into case. Have to wiggle and reseat them until you get white charging lights lit before closing case. If you don’t. Batteries will die shortly after taking them out. Also they will still be paired to device, draining battery unless you carefully seat them carefully in case.

title: OBSESSED!
text: OBSESSED WITH THESE! Bought them to replace my last TOZO earbuds, which I also loved. These are even better and work and sound amazing! Very happy!

title: A Nice Pair
text: I have a T10 and have been very happy with them; the T12 were disappointing, because the sound was not as good. These NC9 Upgraded are a step up; the sound quality is as good as the T10, but not as good as the higher quality earbuds like the Soundcore Liberty 2 Pro, but their design is much more stylized and fit very well in the ear canal, closing a greater area, comfortably, to provide the very adequate noise cancellation; of course, even when compared to the Soundcore; however, this can't be expected to be as good as over-the-ear headphones. Another advantage over the T10 is that the bluetooth shows up in the controlling device as a single contact and you don't have to be changing the connection when one of the earplugs runs out of juice; therefore, the discharge tends to shift depending on which one looses charge. Another advantage, over the Soundcore mentioned, is the water resistance, and the single pairing connection to both buds.

title: Worth the $!!!! Great product.
text: So I waited a couple of weeks to write the review so I could give the product a true run thru before speaking. I’m glad I did. First and foremost. These come with a lot of different size ear gromets. It is important to figure out the size that’s best for you to allow the noise canceling to work. It’s worth the time spent. While mowing the lawn or weed whacking or splitting wood the noise cancelling works great. So great that your music is clear without having to be too loud. The only take back is that they are not wireless chargeable.

title: Unbelievable sound, especially excellent bass 🔊

title: Clear sound. Less bass than NC2.

title: Awesome product at a fraction of the price.

title: Good headphones for music, but talking on the phone is not very good.

title: My perfect tinnitus solution.
text: I've been using these for a couple of months now, just one of them, which lasts 8 hours. I use one of them because I have tinnitus in one ear. I play a playlist on my iphone that is a combination of crickets, and then brown noise, and then rain. I sleep like a baby all night now. My recommendations are that you test different types of noise, (pink, white, brown) and see which of them, when you listen in an earbud, cancels out the tinnitus you have. Then figure out a way to make that into an 8-hour playlist.

title: Great Wireless Earbuds

My only complaint that is that the charging case is so small that my wieless charging pad doesn't recognize it. I love my T10s because they can wirelessly charge and the earbuds and charging case are waterproof. I can't say I have a favorite because they both have their ups and downs.

title: Buds
text: The sound quality is very nice! This was a gift at a great price.

title: Fantastic earbuds!
text: I have been using these earbuds for a few months now. I LOVE them. The sound quality is excellent. (They are bass-heavy so if you don’t prefer that, be aware before you buy.) The noise-canceling feature works very well. And I love how easy it is to turn this on and off. These earbuds pair EASILY and QUICKLY every single time I take them out of the case. Battery life is very good. I use these for listening to music and tuning out noise when I am at work. So I don’t know how they would perform for working out or other active settings. title: Terrible battery life

title: Good quality

title: Great little earbuds!

title: Good Purchase
text: Bought as i felt the price was right for ear bud design. Did not buy for the noise cancelling,

title: Nice intro to TWS
text: They're nice for the noise canceling, but they pause every few minutes and disconnect randomly. The sound is good enough, but doesn't compare to wired on ear headphones.

title: Everything is amazing except battery life
text: My son was getting ear infections at his work because his old earbuds didn't give a good seal and the dust from work kept getting into his ears. These earbuds cancelled the noise, provided a good seal and he hasn't had an ear infection in 4 months, so for that, AMAZING. The only downside is that they won't make it through a full 8 hour shift, luckily my son is a minor so he only works 4-6 hour shifts max after school, so he complains that he can only use them at work, not before/after work. title: Good product - Great Cust Service
text: Update- Tozo customer support reached out so that I could try the most recent updated earbuds they have. They sent me the Crystal Buds to try and asked me to review them. The digital display and overall feel, is really nice. The display allows you to see exactly how much battery life they have. The case is easier to open so that’s a nice update. I am a loyal disappointed that the updated version doesn’t have the ‘active noise canceling’ for music, like the older version had. It provides a ‘smart AI noise reduction’ for clarity when making a phone call which is really nice. However it doesn’t have the option to turn on ANC so background noise can be heard when listening to music. This can help keep you safe depending on how you plan to use these. For the price, the music sounds really good and the phone call quality is also good. I wish the bass was a bit deeper and more immersive but it’s still very enjoyable. The battery life is long so I don’t need to charge them often which is great. Comes with extra ear cushions so you can pick the size that fits you best. Fits snuggly and is very comfortable for all day wear. These would be good for jogging or cycling. The customer service is fantastic. The product is good and I’ll definitely get some use out of them. title: Small size case, good ANC, appreciated bass-y sound quality!
text: I appreciated the packaging of the product when I received it. I was also pleasantly surprised that the ear tips have a mesh to prevent ear wax from going into the ear buds. I wasn't expecting the mesh guard, but definitely appreciate them. Here were some initial things I appreciated about it + small charging case. Small enough to fit in a pocket, which is always a huge benefit. + battery life seems to be good so far + Active Noise Cancellation or ANC seems to work pretty well. I have AirPod Pros and the ANC is similar to the ones in the AirPod Pros + sound quality sounds surprisingly good! I appreciated the heavier bass; but not everyone will. + fits well. This will be dependent on every person, but for me, the fit was really comfortable and stayed in well. Some negatives that I found: - Transparency mode isn't that great. Just make sure you're not expecting amazing transparency mode or you'll probably be disappointed. - The touch controls can sometimes be TOO sensitive, easy to trigger. Possible that it's something I just need to get used to . Despite the negatives, I'd probably give this product a 4.5 out of 5. Also, keep in mind that this product is usually available for $50-$60. Given the price point, I think this more than does the job with great ANC and sound quality.

title: Great set of headphones from a company who stands by their products
text: This is my third pair of headphones from Tozo. I have T6, NC9, and T10's. All of them have their advantages but the NC9's are my favorite for a few reasons. For starters they are the most comfortable for my ears, they seem to fit very snug and seem like they stay in my ear the best out of all the others. They have great sound quality, but honestly the sound quality is good with all the Tozo headphones I have. The charging case also seems to have the best battery of the 3. My favorite thing about them though is they seem to have the least amount of trouble connecting to my PC via bluetooth compared to so many other bluetooth headphones I've used. When you grab these out of the charging dock, they basically connect within a couple of seconds. I've had headphones that I had to basically pair each time I used them, and for a while I thought it was my computer, my USB port, or the bluetooth adapter I was using, but these proved that all I needed was a good pair of headphones. They also seem to have a better range when it comes to moving away from the device you are connected with. I can walk a good 20-30 feet away to the bathroom, close the door and they still work nearly flawlessly. Most headphones this size instantly lose connection when I close the door or even get more than 10 feet away. Beyond all that, I had to contact customer service regarding an issue I was having with a different pair, and they went above and beyond to fix my issue at no cost to me. They definitely stand by their products, and I do recommend these over any other Tozo bluetooth headphones.

title: Great, inexpensive ANC buds

They looked like a great product at a great price. Due to COVID, they've never seen the inside of an airplane, but I have used them on my bike. They sounded great for the dozen or so times that I was able to use them; the noise-cancellation was fairly effective, and the microphone was clear. Unfortunately, after just a handful of uses, the right earbud ceased to function -- totally dead. It's "charging" light remains on constantly, but it doesn't function. I suppose you get what you pay for...

title: Best bang for your buck
text: For a long time I helf off buying wireless earbuds. I had some over-ear headphones that worked fine, even if they were a bit clunky to wear on jogs. But then I had the opportunity to try out my friend's pair of wireless earbuds, a high-end Samsung model, and was hooked! But I couldn't afford the same Samsungs, so I went shopping for a more affordable option. I eventually settled on the TOZO T6 wireless earbuds, which I was highly impressed with. Excellent sound reproduction at a highly affordable price. The only occasional trouble I had with them is that they didn't fit snugly, and I lost one of the buds on a bike ride. Entirely my fault as I should have paid better attention to the fit. Naturally I returned to TOZO and saw that a newer model had been introduced: the NC9. It was an upgrade in almost every way from the T6, with active noise cancellation as an added bonus. And the price was not much higher than what I paid for the T6. It was a no-brainer purchase. As impressed as I was with the T6s, I was blown-away by the NC9s! Sound quality is indistinguishable from my friend's high-end Samsung earbuds. Vocals are super clear, mids are crisp, and bass is deep. First time putting them on, I didn't take them off for over an hour, such was the hearing pleasure and comfort. TOZO has taken lessons from the fit of the T6 and improved NC9's markedly. Once properly placed in the ear, it's almost as if they're glued into place. I took a long bike ride with them, and by the end, they were as snug in my ear as they were at the start. These earbuds are my first experience with noise-cancelling technology in years. I live in a city where construction background noise is annoyingly pervasive, if inconsistent, around my condo. The NC9's ANC does a superb job of blocking out those unwanted sounds. Even my loud AC was turned into a soft hum. At first, I thought the AC had been turned off! To sum up, the TOZO NC9s are an exceptional wireless earbud product whose performance at least matches, if not exceeds, far more expensive brands. It's hard to believe the NC9's features can be had at its price.

title: Exceeded Expectations - No Regrets!
text: The first thing I noticed was the quality packaging - on par with Apple. The user’s manual was written in broken English, which was a little disconcerting, but after my first use, I could not be more satisfied. The sound is excellent, and they stay in my ears. The controls (volume, next track, back up, ANC on/off, etc.) are all adjusted, while still in ear, with a fingertip on either the right or left bud. Learning the controls was confusing at first, but just takes a little practice. A fraction of the cost of Apple EarPods. Update 4/27/2021: Still very happy with this purchase. I’m not an audiophile, but I’m more fussy than average regarding sound quality. In my humble opinion, these sound great! Here’s how good they are: I fell asleep two nights ago with these still in my ear. I woke up to the frightening sounds of someone arguing loudly and then beating on my bedroom door. I realized I still had the ear buds in, I took them out to be better able to confront my “assailants”…the sounds were coming from the earbuds. I had YouTube on auto-play. 😅 Update 6/23/2021: Still happy 😃 Update 11/29/21: Still very happy with my earbuds. Use them every day on my 3-mile hike.

title: Average sound, case doesn't hold charge
text: Sound: So these earbuds work for what I like: audiobooks. However, for the sake of the review, I have spend some time listening to music. The sound quality is good enough. The bass isn't as strong as I like it, but I can deal with it. If you're looking for a punchier bass, this isn't the product for you. Noise Cancelling: The "Active Noise Cancelling" is mostly apparent when listening to music. You have to make sure the volume is relatively high as well. "Transparency Mode" however works wonderfully. Everything is crystal clear without taking off the earbuds. The one complaint I do have however is there's no way to disable the modes so the microphones aren't active. This is awful when I'm riding my bike and I hear the wind blowing into my ears. Fit: This is actually the best thing about the buds. They fit snuggly and comfortably. It's noticable they're in my ears, but not uncomfortable. Battery Life: The case doesn't hold a charge. While they allow the buds to charge while connected to the charging cable, the case itself didn't charge the buds. For a $50 dollar product, you would expect something like this to be built in, especially since $20 devices are capable of doing so. As such, I can only get around 8 hours of use before having to charge them again. Over all: I don't recommend this product for the price point. It under delivers for what is suppose to be a luxury product.

The first pair had a high pitched noise in the left ear, and the second pair occasionally has the same issue along with white noise at random times. Also the touch controls are finnicky and annoying to use, to the point that I usually just go over to my phone when I need to do something. The voice narrations are inconsistent and pretty bad all around, which adds a cheap feel to an otherwise amazing aesthetic. Couldn't you go on Fiver and get some decent sound clips for that? No regrets on my purchase, but there's some missed potential here.

text: Bluetooth headphones have been a staple in my life for the last 10 years or so, this is my first wireless pair (left and right headphones separate from wire) and it is a game changer! There are so many features that I didn't realize would occur. 1) the charging case, charge on the go 2) I can hand my wife one, and I can have her hear something funny/interesting, while keeping mine in and not having to be 8" from her 3) if one is getting low battery, I can charge it independently while keeping the other in and still listening to podcast/sermon/etc, then charge the other side 4) the fact that putting them in the charging case immediately turns them off, and disconnects from my phone... and the inverse, taking them out immediately turns them on and they pair up is BRILLIANT! If I'm outside, it just amplifies even a mild wind. It's more of a "white noise" feature than anything else. Just turning off the noise-canceling mode is good enough to hear outside sounds. The other gripe is that I wish these had physical buttons to press. They are really sensitive to touch and I've found that I change modes, pause playback, etc. when I'm just adjusting them in my ear or taking them on/off. Overall, I'm quite happy with these. text: The sound quality is great, but in my opinion not what justifies the price. The feature that does justify the price is the level of sound cancellation they provide. You can also use provided modes, or custom design them through the app. The app allows you to create a mode that has minimal or no noise reduction. title: Simply the best
text: My family has tested out numerous noise canceling earbuds in the last six months, looking for the best ones to fit each member of our household. This set of earbuds was the universal favorite among every member of our family. For one, the noise cancellation feature is absolutely the most effective noise cancellation we have found on earbuds. Even having it on silent, I was unable to discern individual words from my mom reading loudly to my two noisy children in the other room. With an audiobook playing, I really didn't notice anybody else being in the house, though I could hear them if I thought about it. With music, it was like they weren't there, someone can stand right next to me and talk to me and I can be blissfully unaware. If you get overloaded from auditory stimulation easily and just need the world to stop making so much noise every so often, these are the earbuds to get. The sound quality is extraordinarily good on audiobooks, rap music, metal music, and more peaceful and soothing ballads and classical. The base was not overwhelming, nor did the treble get screechy. It fit my very small ears well, and fit my husband's ears well also, he has a much bigger ear canal size. The one thing that we have both noticed is that these are also heavier than most of our other earbuds, however even with my ears feeling rather sensitive, it really didn't bother me because they are weighted nicely and fit so well. Overall, while these could be improved by being slightly smaller and less heavy, these still beat out five other well-known brands in our household for both the noise cancellation and in audio quality.
