title: A lot of money for something that only lasts 4 months
text: I had high expectations... they were exceeded. The pass through is wonderful. I can carry on a face to face conversation and hear movement around me as I walk my route. As soon as I am alone in a safe location. Tap tap and the world quickly fades away. Walking in bright sun, I do not get solar kickout which interrupted previous BT earbud connections. These are extremely comfortable to wear, they are secure, and do not interfere with the mole I have at the end of my ear canal. (personal but significant) The only understandable short coming is the battery life.... but I really don't see 24/7 battery life being available anytime soon. Two wishes: Memory foam tips in flourescent orange. it would be even better and when dropped on the ground, easier to find through the snow and lraves.

title: Sound Quality
text: The sound quality is great and I really like the noise cancellation. Just used on a long car trip and the cancellation feature worked exceedingly well, could not hear any outside road noise. Battery life could be a bit longer but you get more battery life from the charging case, just have to recharge after about 3 hours.

title: Nothing bad to say at all!
text: I’m in love with these earbuds. They have a tremendous battery life and charge fast. They never fall out and have good range. I run outside everyday and these guys cancel almost everything out, except on windy days. Worth every penny!!!!

title: Great Sound; Great Fit
text: These earbuds are wonderful. There are 3 choices of tips so that you can find a nice comfortable fit. I've found that the sound is great whether watching movies or listening to classical music. The battery life is also very very good.

title: Love these
text: Best noise cancelling earbuds. The noise cancelling is adjustable, so I can put it on max when I want to lose myself in my music and don’t want to be bothered or turn it down when I am walking or exercising for safety. The clarity and sound quality is nothing less than what I expect from Bose. The battery life is amazing too. As most earbuds, they charge when you put them in their case, so they are always ready to go.

title: Great, but its not
text: I own like four of these in my household. It appears to be a theme where all of a sudden one or both earbuds will not charge. you can clean them and maybe it will charge again, but it is very short lived. Would I buy another one of these or recommend them, no not this at all. I have a lot of Bose products, they are great, except this one. and it is such a shame, because I do use them as much as I can when I travel, walking, at home working, etc. but now I need to move on to something that I can rely on and it is no longer this thing. such a shame.

title: BOSE QE
text: Second time I tried to use them wouldn't pair Red and white flashing lights. Bose charged me for help but didn't solve the problem.

title: Expect the best and you get the best!
text: You have to pay for quality and then you get quality!!!! Thanks BOSE

title: Nice product but expected better from Bose
text: I own several noise cancelling products from Bose and for the most part these are what you would expect from Bose but the level of volume does not go very loud. The charging of the ear buds is not like other type of ear buds with battery cases. These will not charge with the case closed. You have to leave the case open to charge. If this is a feature that can be change I don't know why you would want that. For the price air pods pro are a much better product! Pretty disappointed in Bose!

title: Absolutely love!
text: I’ve always struggled finding earbuds that fit my ears and were comfortable for long periods of time. These are very comfortable (I have pretty small ears) and don’t hurt after wearing them for a long time. The sound is great, of course Bose is always amazing for that. The charge lasts a long time as well. I would definitely recommend these!

title: Just seems like a scam
text: On the 31st day, they quite working entirely. Won't charge. Won't connect. Can't even be seen by Blue Tooth devices. (That's right; the morning after the end of the 30 day return period, they ceased working.) And to get an exchange I've (so far) had to spend over two hours on the phone where they insist that I repeat the trouble shooting process listed on their website that I had already tried twice. Now, I've got to print off a shipping label and schlep it to a UPS drop site, and they PROMISE that if they receive it, they will provide a replacement--not a duplicate; they can't guarantee that I will get the same product I purchased, but they promise that it will be just as good. (The irony is not appreciated.) After a very cumbersome process, manufacturer sent a different pair. (Would not replace the white ones I had ordered; insisted that they could not specify the color of replacement, and I might "get lucky" and get white. I received the basic black pair.) Replacement pair does not work either. Rather than go through another replacement ordeal, these are heading for the thrift store. I know... donating $200+ earbuds to thrift after less than 2 months is kind of ridiculous, and I feel a little bad for the soul who will spend $4 on these in the thrift store only to see what duds they are.

title: Let down
text: A let down for Bose. For the price, there is no volume control on the buds. Instead you have to use the app or the device volume. You also can't go back a track for music. Simple features that are so basic, $10 buds have them. There are cheaper buds with more features that are on the market. You really just paying for the name and not much else.

title: Sound great
text: Ok they sound fantastic and I love them but I can't get them to stay in my ears. Tried different sizes, even different sizes in each ear. Not great when every time I start to move with the music they want to fall out. I think I should go for over the ear next time I've wasted a lot of money

title: False Product Description
text: The product description said "Country of Origin: USA". The box says "Made in China". Don't appreciate being lied to.

title: Not for you if you favor your left ear.
text: I didn't realize when purchasing these that the right earbud was the primary. So you can't pause/answer calls if only the left is in. So far I haven't found a way to make the left the primary. The right earbud stopped working entirely after only 1 month. After looking on reddit I discovered that this is a very common problem. With the right being primary, the left won't connect at all. Thankfully they are sending me the Quiet Comfort II at no charge. The earbuds have left me disappointed but Bose has made it right.

title: Love these!
text: I had AirPods and had trouble keeping them in my ears. I love the way these fits I can run in them and not worry about losing one. I really didn’t expect the noise canceling to work I mean they’re just earbuds how can they block out sound. I thought it would take headphones to do that it’s amazing how well these work for noise canceling. They are fantastic on airplanes. And the sound is so much better than my AirPods were.

title: Love them!!
text: Absolutely incredible! Brilliant noise cancelling and sound quality! I love these earphones! Love!

title: Not a fan
text: VERY difficult to pair with my iPad and iPhone. It wouldn’t take. It would stay paired to one device but as soon as I switched to the other one it would drop it and there was no memory so you had to pair them again. That meant you had to have the case with you. If you were out walking and didn’t have the case and lost your connection ….that was that until you return home…no music. Further, I could not keep them in my ears. I changed the tips several times but each time they fell out (9 x in less then 5 minutes of walking). Also, they were very awkward to try to get in your ears in the first place. Had to do it in front of mirror. In addition, the sound quality was so so and not very loud. The only positive about the whole experience was the Bose technical support. They were absolutely fantastic. However, they still couldn’t solve the fact that they kept falling out so I returned them.

title: They deliver on their promise
text: I bit the bullet and invested (a lot) the money to buy these after my Air pods started acting glitchy. These are super comfortable and have never dislodged. If I need to wear them at night to silence a nearby snorer, the quiet mode blocks sound out around 90% for me and are fairly comfortable to sleep in; even on your side. Music is crystal clear with an app to use the equalizer to your taste. I LOVE them at the gym and wear them with no worries about falling out during a workout. These were my Christmas present to me and it was nice to not pay the retail price of $279. I never imagined I would ever spend more money on ear buds after paying big bucks for my Air pods but I have absolutely no regrets. Bonus: when Air pods get icky with ear wax (sorry, but it’s true) they were nearly impossible to maintain. The Bose protective in-ear covers will never be an issue because you can take them off the actual pods. Battery life is acceptable but I would love to have a longer charge because I use them all day at work. They make Zoom calls from my PC a breeze to connect to and block out all ambient noise.

title: Great sound , not so great functions
text: These are the very best sounding and have the best noise canceling of all the headphones and earbuds I’ve ever used. I have several of the Bose quiet comfort headphones they are awesome too. The main problem I have with these are sometimes it’s hard for them to connect to my phone and when you take them out and put them in the case they will stay connected. When I put them up I want them to disconnect from my phone. Anytime you want to turn the sound on or turn it off you have to tap on the outside of the earbud. This makes a thumping noise. It is very annoying. They should’ve put some small buttons at the top instead of you having to thump on them with your fingers. You barely have to touch them but you hear the thump. As far as the awareness mode, it’s pretty terrible . When you have it on awareness mode the noise sounds hollow and amplified but as soon as you start talking or someone talks to you it starts canceling the sound down and makes it just terrible. So I normally will yank one of the earbuds out. Then when somebody says something it seems like it always kicks back on and then I’ve got music back in one ear and I have to take both ear buds out to talk to somebody. Some of those problems could be probably fixed with updates . I wish that if you took one earbud out it would automatically turn off the music. There is an option to use one earbud and listen to music, but I don’t use that. I just hate that when I’m using them in the gym and someone comes to talk to me I have to yank them out or say hey wait a minute. As far as function goes Apple earbuds are the best. But the music quality is nowhere close to the Bose. Also if you wear them six hours, like I do at work, the Bose will start hurting the inside of your ear. It kinda seems like Bose might’ve gotten a hurry when they put these out.

title: Amazing 1st in class noise cancellation
text: Best noise cancellation I have come across when it comes to earbuds. Sound quality is great as can be expected from Bose products. Out of the box, I personally didn't have to change the size of the earbuds but having a variety of sizes to choose from in the box is helpful. The battery life is in line with other products in the category but I wish it was longer. The only downside I have come across so far is the new bose music app doesn't put together all my bose products, it seems to be only for their newer lines of products. For instance, my QC 35 over-ear headphones are still in the old Bose connect app so I tried to add them to the new bose music app to consolidate all my devices to one application. But, the only options for headphones begins with their new 700 lines of headphones. Seems kind of goofy to me to have two separate applications for this but it really isn't all that big of a deal to me- but it might be for someone else. Hopefully, in the future, they will be able to merge the apps or something. Overall, definitely recommend these earbuds. I haven't had any weird desync issues or interruptions that some have had with their older models of wireless earbuds.

title: Great ear buds
text: Sound quality is very good. Sound cancellation is better. Battery life is just okay.

title: The leader in sound and noise cancellation!
text: Best noise canceling headphones.Great Bose App.They are like the mini version of the full size ones. P.S.: To avoid the hissing sound caused by noise cancellation technology the headphones need to be used only in full noise cancellation mode-maybe future software tweak will fix that.

title: So close!
text: I loved these headphones but they kept slipping in my ears and causing a hiss. Is tried all the different tips and felt a lot like Goldilocks! No dice though. They hurt my ears after about an hour.

title: Wonderful!
text: These are wonderful for noise cancellation. My office decided to remodel and become "open concept." I couldn't get anything done with all the noise until I got these bad boys! Literally a lifesaver. The battery life is amazing too and I love the sleek carrying case.

title: good
text: Good I like the other brand better, but for the money those are perfect

title: Amazing!!
text: Use Case: Work out at a gym where they blast techno hip-hop music and it's incredibly irritating. Plus there always seems to be an employee vacuuming around me the time day I go. So began to look for noise cancelling options. These earbuds worked amazing. The earhooks that come with them secure these things in the ear very well so that the seal doesn't break and the noise cancelling doesn't go in and out as you move around. I train hard with all types of excercises and these things stay securely in my ear. And the noise cancelling is amazing...blocks everything out...just activating noise cancelling and putting them in your ear cuts out more noise than wearing ear plugs. Then turn on some music (doesn't have to be loud), all exterior sounds go away. These were as good as over the ear noise cancelling headphones that i tried. The only feature that would be nice to have that I saw on a different pair of earbuds I tried before I found these, was an app setting that recognizes you are talking and auto-stops playing music and noise cancelling so you can talk. I originally tried Sony's over the ear version. The noise cancelling was fantastic, but they were too bulky for working out in. Would slide off if I laid down on a bench, etc...plus they were really hot around the ears and ears would sweat. So I then tried Sony's earbud version of the same thing. They were decent, but they didn't have earhooks so they wouldn't stay securely in the ear during work outs, and I kept having to re-adjust them in. Plus since they weren't real securely strapped in, the noise cancelling was a step down. But then I discovered the Bose Quiet Comfort's and tried them next. I wouldn't have guess those little hooks you see in the picture would have secured them to the ear, but reviews stated they did, so I tried them. 3rd time was a winner. Highly recommend the Quite Comfort's if you need noise cancelling when doing any sort of physical activity like working out or other physical training. They will stay in your ear securely.

title: Great Sound - Could Have Better Controls
text: I'd give these 5 stars except for two things. The first is that you cannot have them connected to two devices and toggle back and forth. I had a pair of Bose QuietControl earbuds. You could have them connected to two devices at the same time. As long as there was only one device playing at a time, you were fine. With these, you have to go into bluetooth settings and disconnect all but one device. The other issue is the limited controls. There is no way to configure the controls to have fast forward and rewind.

title: Underwhelmed
text: For the price at the time, I had high hopes. The wing shape does a good job of keeping the buds secure, but they are pretty big and stick out and never feel 100 percent stable. The sound quality is decent but nothing that blows me away. Maximum volume is not high enough. Bass is not deep enough. Bought a pair of Anker buds for around $130 and they sound as good or better. The noise cancelling is top notch. Almost too good. Really seals out much of the outdoor world. Horrible for phone calls. Callers complain of not being able to hear me and of wind noise when there is no wind. Also, noise cancellation does nothing for wind noise. Given the price I cannot look for something new until these die, but am a bit dissapointed.

title: AWESOME
text: Does exactly as it describe. Still trying to get use to turning it up and down...when you take one out of the ear, the other one stops playing in the ear. (when talking on the phone: you can hear in both earbuds: as in my last pair of Bose you can only hear in the right one.) Sometimes I think I'm talking to loud when on the phone because your ears feel plugged from the noise cancelation.

title: Unreal
text: These are utterly fantastic. If they are on sale, do not hesitate to buy them. The noise canceling is surreal.

title: Broke after not even 2 years
text: These earbuds sound great but their software is so glitchy. I babied these earbuds (because they’re $250) and now they blink red and white and wont do anything else. customers support online and via call center are of no help. Warranty expired already. I dont think bose had confidence to warranty this product for even 2 years. Also the microphone is choppy during phone calls. I really loved the sound quality of these ear buds with music but they broke from just regular use. These earbuds should not have broken so easily, theyre not worth $250 maybe not even $100 for breaking so easily

title: Not what I was expecting
text: Not good if you have eczema. I can only wear these for a short amount of time or my ears break out bad.

title: EXCELLENT NOISE CANCELLING AND SOUND QUALITY .
text: THE NOISE CANCELLING IS THE BEST YET. IT ENHANCES THE SOUND QUALITY WHICH IS EXCEPTIONAL.

title: Best headphones in the world!!
text: These cancel sound completely I am so impressed with the sound quality! I had the Bose sound sport headphones which were also great but I needed to upgrade due to the short battery life. I tried to replace them with skull candy wireless headphones but I’m glad I didn’t settle for that garbage. This a better replacement than I could’ve asked for!

title: The noise canceling is incredible!
text: These are by far the best wireless ear buds I've ever owned. The noise canceling is better than most headphones. Deep base for buds. But most importantly, I no longer have to listen to the people I work with.

title: Blah, not good. Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro 2 are cheaper and far better
text: I tried these one and they fit fine. They are comfy with no issue of staying in during workouts or walking, running, etc. Connectivity is fine. There is no rich bass or bass sound. The bass is mid range and the not deep. The high ends are not crisp and mono sounding. It lacks the punch in sound that it should have for that price point. In order to use the app features, you need to enable GPS. That is not deal breaker because it drains your battery on the phone faster. Also, the noise canceling is good but not as great as the galaxy buds pro 2. I would not purchase any of these ear buds.

title: Too Bulky for Daily Use
text: OK, I've used these intermittently for a couple weeks, and I just cannot see wearing them on a regular basis. Maybe if I went on a lengthy plane trip, but for my normal puttering around the house, no. They are too bulky and tend to get knocked out of my ears. I have had trouble maintaining a conversation when paired with my iPhone 7 Plus, lots of drop outs. The charging case is huge. I can't seem to pair them with my MacBook Pro. On the positive side, noise cancelling is quite good. Materials are first rate. They are reasonably comfortable. Sound is good. For most use cases, I'll just go back to my AirPods.

title: Not an easy fit
text: I have owned a wired in-ear pair of Bose headphones since 2012. I used them across the world in running competitions, cycling and put them on during extended travel in rough conditions. Perfect fit (never fell off!) and good sound. I was aware that the noise cancelling ones are not intended for sports but was hoping they can be used for some light walking or minimal gardening activities. Unfortunately, I could not fit them properly and they kept falling off even when sitting. My thinking is that the shape and larger, heavier size of the headphone is not matched by the current earpiece. Also, when the weather got a little bit colder, the ear pieces contracted and started popping out/falling. I guess the material is not the same as the one used in other models The sound is good, noise cancelling is not perfect (probably also due to lack of good fit), Bluetooth works well and Siri can help with all commands (volume, skip or repeat song, etc.). I hope Bose will take a look at the earpiece design and material and come up with a better solution for more stable fit. I was very saddened to have to return them.

title: The best I have owned
text: Love these The word BOSE says it all. Great sound, many options and awesome noise cancellation. More comfortable than I expected.

title: No Stereo Sound
text: One thing I forgot before I bought the Earbuds that Blue Tooth doesn't come in Stereo, but the main reason I bought them is for the Noise Canceling System, comes in handy especially when you're Flying for a long period of time.

title: Great Headphones
text: You get that classic deep rich Bose sound. The noise cancelation is fantastic. You will be snapping your fingers and playing music trying to figure out how it works. Absolutely fantastic for plans flights or focusing on something with kids or co-workers around.

title: Left earbud did not charge, does not power (2nd time in a row with replacement)
text: This was a replacement set, the first having been returned the day after it was delivered. Once again, the left earbud had no power, would not charge. I spoke to a Bose Corp. person, arranged for a replacement, will ship the defective pair back today. Wish they would work. A QC issue with the earbud battery? Twice on two occasions has to be more than coincidental. Ironically this replaces a set that I lost which worked fine. It seems to me that the problem is quality control at Bose, not Amazon. Update Sept 2 2022: The returned earbuds were recieved at the Bose return site on Aug 30th. The email said it could take up to 5 days to review the device and issue a replacement (in contrast to the 3-5 business days I was told about on Aug 23rd). So I called Bose, was told there had been no movement on the replacement, but she was able to issue a replacement, which I hope to receive next week. Update Sept 06, 2022. I did indeed receive the Bose QC earbuds from Bose itself. They worked fine, iop[paired with bluetooth. The instructions were not particularly clear re: using the touch controls on the earbuds...that has to be accessed through the Bose App. So far so good. And the left earbud shows fully charged! Update, Sept 8, 2022: So far so good. Lo and behold! Bose announces the sale of the QC earbuds 2! Had I known they were orderable, and being an early technology adopter, I probably would have held off on the first generation. But no heads up from Bose, other than 'it's here'!

title: Fantastic earbuds, way better than both Sony and Apple offerings.
text: These are fantastic earbuds, but… I also have a pair of the Sony WF-1000XM3 and the Apple AirPod Pros, and these are better than both in just about every way. The sound on the Bose's is fantastic, the noise cancellation is better than both Sony and Apple. You don't have to shove them all the way down your ear canal, so they're much more comfortable to wear and don't fall out. (The Sony's fall out of my ears every 10 minutes or so when I'm exercising, so I'm constantly fiddling with them. The AirPods are worse.) People complain about the size, but they're a bit smaller than the Sony's. (Size is the only area where Apple has the advantage.) I do wish the battery in the case was larger so that it would work on really long flights, but I can live with plugging it into a power supply if I have to. So, given all that, why three stars? The buds work perfectly with my phone and iPad, but when I try to use them on my MacBook Air, sound when playing a movie lags the video by almost a second. I'm keeping the buds because my use case is the iPad, but if I wanted to use these with my laptop, I'd be seriously disappointed. I'm hoping that this problem is one of the many bugs in MacOS Big Sur and will eventually be corrected, but Apple being Apple, they may never address it.

title: Stopped working after only worn 6-7 times
text: A little pricey, but well made and are very comfortable. Update: was purchased As a gift for my husband. After using 6-7 times, the left earbud stopped working reached out to Amazon to help because the manufacturer said we had to send back and it could take 30 days to send out replacements. No luck with customer service here. :(

title: Super uncomfortable to wear.
text: These earbuds are extremely painful to have in my ears. Obviously, everyone has different ears but there will be others like mine.

title: These Were Supposed to be New?
text: These seem to work wonderfully well. BUT - nowhere does it mention they might be refurbished or used. The product attempted to connect with an I-phone (I don't have one) and has a name assigned as "Brent's Bose Earbuds." Not sure if Amazon or Bose is at fault here, but these were not new. There were also some of the extra tips in the box where the plastic bag was opened with scissors.

title: Finally good noise reduction
text: Unlike previous noise cancellation tech which was only decent at best, this finally truly cuts down on a lot of external sounds like construction work, which is happening in my newly developed neighborhood. It doesn't cut out sharp noises like hammering or beeping noises, which honestly isn't surprising. Yet, it is perfect for crowds, airplanes and work environments. Sound quality is great and bass is solid. I bought 1 pair which had an issue with the Left earbud being defective but I exchanged for a new one and has worked perfectly since. SO, it was just that one which was deflective, which isn't a major fault of Bose. it happens. Also, these are comfortable as I've worn them for an entire work day with no annoying ear pain, but you have to understand, different ears fit differently, so this is as universal as it can get, but not 100% for all people. Remember, there is currently no such thing as "Noise cancellation", but rather Noise Reduction. Hopefully one day that type of tech is made, but until then, this is very impressive.
Battery life and sound quality for music are A+, but noise cancellation is weak -D! The older version I used was so much better.

title: Bose Nailed it Again
text: These headphones are amazing! Once you get the fit right, they are super comfortable. I had them in my ear all day while driving uber. You can barely tell they are there. The sound quality is amazing as usual and the noise cancellation is superb. I tested them by turning it on full power while sitting around a ton of clubs blasting music. It drowned out all the noise and I could hear my music no problem. These are more than worth the premium price. I have smaller ear canals so I'm glad they fit. Of course I wish the battery life was longer, but when you think about how well they work it's no wonder it eats up battery life. The touch controls are convenient. Level 0, I believe on the noise cancellation is transparency mode. That is the only part I don't like. I wish that level 0 was a normal headphone type of sound and that transparency was a separate button or touch on the earphones. On transparency mode you can really hear so much more than you would expect. These are quality headphones. No issues connecting and no drops either with connection.

title: No Lost Earbud Locator??
text: Great noise cancellation. Great sound quality. Battery life for this style is fine since I personally can’t wear earbuds like this for more than an hour. Comfort is better than AirPods Pro but not as good as my LG HBS-SL5 around the neck headphones. The most mind blowing (and disappointing) thing with these is they have no way of locating a lost earbud?!? No way that’s true at this price point! After 9 months I think the baby relocated it off the coffee table and I can’t find my left earbud. No way to play a tone to find it. This is a must have feature for this style of headphones

title: Case specific to headphones - broke in less than a year
text: The little clip that opens and closes the case wore out and broke off int the case that you use to hold you headphones and charge them. I contacted support and of course that isn't covered under their warranty. And of course, the case is specific to the headphones so you can't buy a replacement. So your only chose is to buy a new set. And the world wonders why there is so much stuff in the landfills. Sad. Thought Bose would be better than this. Now i have $200 plus headphones that are less than a year old that are useless.

title: Hate noise cancelling.
text: I hate noise cancelling. I had no idea it would hurt so much. While it worked so well, the echo would start to hurt my ears within a few minutes. The weight also had an effect. Way too heavy. I had to return them and get the sport ones. They are lighter and actually do a great job of noise cancelling.

title: Noise cancelling is inferior to competition, can't use phone app while connected to anything else
text: This is a review of the Bose Quietcomfort Airbuds II (for some reason it shows I'm reviewing the older version. I've purchased a number of ANC earbuds, my most recent being the Sony WF-1000XM4 set. When I read all of the reviews saying these are the best ANC earbuds on the market, I purchased them, I am disappointed. When I test them comparing them with the Sonys, the Sonys are clearly superior. I have a room with a floor fan that is always my first test. The Sony's completely block the sound of the fan. With the Bose set (trying all 3 eartips plus the other two I purchased from Bose) I can still hear a small but distinct whir of the fan. When I walked into a Walmart, just for general sound, once again the Sony's outperform the Bose set in a very clear fashion. I've tried all the eartips that come with the Bose (as well as some Comply tips they recommended) and it simply does not provide the ANC the Sony does. I'll be sticking with the Sonys

title: Cannot handle wind and terrible echo
text: Cannot handle wind noise , terrible non-synched echo between left and right, and case is too big. Bought Jabra 85t after seeing YouTube ad. It was a good surprise and loved it for 2 days so far. Bose really ought to catch up and make it right.

title: Great fit and sound
text: I bought these from a recommendation of a co-worker. I absolutely love them. They are the only ones that don’t fall out my ear. The sound quality is awesome. The noise cancellation feature works great. Super easy to connect to a device, and really easy to use. You charge the case, then the case charges the earbuds. I use the earbuds about 5 hours per day. Totally around 20-30 hours per week. I’ve only charged the case once since I’ve got them more than a month ago. So battery life is amazing.

title: Best bang for the money
text: I have tried many products including Apples own products and this model beats all 3 to 1.

title: AWESOME!
text: Best personal purchase I have made in a long time. Awesome product! Love BOSE for quality and performance.

title: On the fence.
text: I have tried all the tips for at least an hour at a time. The 1s are too small, the 2s and 3s hurt my ears. I may be turning them too much, but I have never worn in-ears, that have a wings; the part that hurts after I take them off is the ridge where the wings go. The ANC and sound quality is great, as it should be. These were meant to complement the QC over-ears in hot weather. UPDATE: Returned on 08/13/2021. Great sound is not enough to make up for an uncomfortable design.

title: App requires your location and wants your call history
text: Sending these back. First, you have to use a Bose app which requires you do allow location. It also asks permission for your call history and other information. You can't use the earbuds without the app. There is a volume control but it works by swiping and only works about one in five times and is difficult to control. The sound was okay. I wanted to be blown away, but the left earbud was painful and the features were distracting. I did not keep them long enough to find out how good the sound was in the end.

title: Much more comfortable than AirPods Pro (small ear canals)

title: Probably the best I've used. Good sound, good noise cancellation, good battery life...but...
text: The Bose Quiet Comfort earbuds live up to their name. They isolate you from most external sounds, but there's an option to let sound through so you can hear your surroundings while still listening to audio. Unlike most other earphones, these are pretty large, covering the ear canal, and preventing most sound through. They're also pretty large - and the case is also a pretty large lump to carry in a pocket. The case holds enough charge for 12 hours of play time (I haven't tested this yet). I waited a long time to test these earbuds - but after many months, once I began testing, the earbuds were fully charged and the case had 70% of full charge. The touch controls take time to get used to. A soft touch works best. It didn't take long to get used to the simple controls. The Bose Music app was also helpful to set up and use these earbuds. Right now, although I have other earbuds that I like (Jabra 85t is a good option for me), I'm using these Quiet Comfort earbuds. They have the fullest sound, great Bass, and just seem to sound better. I've had a problem, though, and I'll try to repeat it. At one location, I used the earbuds, but there was NO sound coming from them, even though my source was putting out maximum volume (according to the phone), and I used the 'swipe' on the headphone to get maximum volume. I'll try this again and update this review if the problem comes back or I was just experiencing user error. For now, these are my favorite earbuds, and I plan to be using them a lot in the future.

title: Best ANC on an earbud or headphone
text: ****12/8/2020 UPDATE**** Unfortunately had to return due to charging case unable to hold a charge! Very disappointed as this is a brand-new product. Will probably buy again...but used, not worth paying full $350 retail. **** ORIGINAL REVIEW**** I bought these at Target and following are my impressions -- Music - of all the ANC earbuds, Sennheiser still sounds best for music (or Bowers & Wilkins PX7 for over-the-ear). Bose QC Earbuds sound quite good with ANC off, but noticeably veiled with narrower soundstage with ANC turned on (the same for the QC35 and 700, the latter sounds the worst for music among all the earbuds and over-the-hear I've heard.) ANC - better than QC35 and on par with 700, in filtering out high-frequency noise of a/c and exhaust fan. Given the size of the thing, it's almost inconceivable the QC Earbuds' ANC performance rivals, even bests, ALL of the over-the-ear cans (including the Sony WF-XM3, WH-XM3/XM4, all of which have trouble completely filtering out high-frequency noise) Cons - No mulitpoint Bluetooth, primitive smartphone app, only play/pause touch control (right earbud) and ANC on/off toggle (left earbud) Overall - this is Bose's best earbud/headphone for music and ANC. But if you don't care for ANC, get the Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless with foam tips for great sound and passive-noise isolation.

With that being said, on to my actual review: These have been by far my favorite pair of headphones for almost a year now. title: Very disappointed for the price! Sent them back!
text: I had extremely high hopes for these at this price point. But however my disappointments outweigh everything good about these. Let me start off to say that I really tried and wanted to like these. But however my $100 earbuds by Anker are better. But after using them for approximately 3 hours in total. I'm returning them for a refund. Pros: 1. These are extremely comfortable in my ear. 2. I love the charging case as it can be wirelessly charged or by USBC. 3. The ANC is amazing. Cons. 1. The volume is absolutely laughable. I find myself always trying to turn my phone volume louder. My $100 headphones are way louder. 2. The app is absolutely horrible. From a company that is notorious for extreme equalization you would think the app for these would include some sort of equalization presets. In fact the only thing the app really does is allow you to control the volume, the ANC, and a couple other settings like what happens when you pull one bud out of your ear. Honestly you'd be better off not even installing the app. The app for my $100 headphones includes a 5 channel equalizer, equalizer presets by some of the top producers of music, and a bass boost function. Which I don't even have turned on for them. 3. Which now brings me to the bass. That is absolutely laughable too. I've seen so many people in reviews praise the bass and how amazing it is. Honestly I'm not hearing it. I've listened to multiple bass boosted songs, some of my favorite pop/rap music, 70s & 80s, and some dubstep. My $100 headphones has easily 10 times as much bass with bass boost turned off. 4. And now the nail in the coffin. The music playback has now started to stutter and skip. They act like they can't keep up with the playback on my phone so it kinda sounds like it's skipping and then it sounds like they are fast forwarding a little to catch up to what is playing. This happens when my phone is in my sweater pockets or in my blue jeans. It even happens when I cary my phone at my side. It definitely has to be these buds as my other $100 headphones do not do this. And it's definitely not my phone as it is only 3 month old.

(2) They are so big that the only possible sleeping position while wearing them is on one's back, which is uncomfortable for me. I still haven't decided if I am going to keep these or return them and hope Bose comes out with a new model with a longer-lasting battery (and, ideally, smaller) before I go on vacation again.

title: It finally happened. I turned my back on Bose.

Compared to the Apple Airpods Pro, these are clunky (buds *and* case), not very user friendly, ok on noise cancelation, and expensive. title: Great Earbuds
text: These are the first ANC earbuds I've owned (or ANC headphones in general). The effect is pretty nice - I work remotely doing IT in what is basically a closet, so I have the constant hum of my computer & often a fan as well. These headphones eliminate the vast majority of the noise even when nothing is playing - and when any sound at all is playing, it's impossible to notice the ambient sounds whatsoever. The transparency mode is cool - I've had this though an app on a bluetooth DAC/AMP before, but it was crap. The transparency on these earbuds however works very well & you can perceive ambient sound in 3D. I'd like to call out the sound quality on these earbuds - I've had a number of wireless earbuds before, but in terms of sound quality these are the best so far. I'm not real big in to 'overly bassy' headphones, and I think these have a good balance between enough bass and too much bass. Finally (one thing I was looking forward to most), the call quality/microphone quality on these is very good. I have often found myself using wireless earbuds at work to listen to music (because my bluetooth headset hurts after a while & the sound quality isn't so good) - but other earbuds' quality on meetings was awful. People would say "You sound like you're underwater". These headphones however are crystal clear & probably sound better than my work headset. Great product and very affordable.

Again, I'm adjusting from my previous pair so I'm not sure how I feel about the fit in my ear, it almost seems to rub a little and irritate my ear but maybe with time I'll adjust. I also think I need to try a size down on the ear piece, that might fix the problem. I am impressed with how far the range is on these! My last pair would cut out sometimes if my phone was in my back pocket... With these I can walk all around the office and they haven't cut out yet! I am usually only ever wearing one earbud at a time and I liked how I was able to use just one earbud and it was interchangeable with both ears since only the right earbud would work without the other and not vice versa. This pair is not interchangeable and must be worn in the designated ear, which had me a little worried at first, until I realized I could still use a single earbud at a time and it works with BOTH earbuds, which was a huge plus for me. They also seem to hold a charge for a good amount of time and the charging case is nice and compact. Overall I think they look nice, work well, and are reasonably priced. I'm still on the fence about how comfortable they are but I think it's just a matter of getting used to something different from what I've been using for the last year or so. The previous Tozo ones I bought years ago does not hold the charge as these new ones. I use these everyday for about an hour and the charge box is still on 75% charged. title: Excellent headphones with amazing value on the dollar
text: [[VIDEOID:93a6b76d3b3e1ee1b6f74a99cb5d2394]] These headphones are great and one of the cheapest high quality active noise cancelling sets in this price range. The build quality is excellent, the case feels pleasant to the touch and has an addictive snapping action. The headphone nubs are very comfortable, and a wide range of sizes are offered which was helpful for me as I have big ears. The headphones stay in no problem, and the no button touch sensor is a definite upgrade compared to the otherwise loud button clicking. The sound quality is likewise good with a large range and bass that you might find in some full on-ear headsets. The battery life is great too, I've yet to find myself out of juice. Overall, I think TOZO really knocked it out of the park with these headphones, the value is so extreme that I'm surprised they're able to turn a profit at this price point lol

These are my work buds...They are not for play. 8-10 hour days of music and calls. 5 days a week for 6 months. Trust the audiophiles. My count is 4 wireless buds and 6 true wireless buds. title: Nice sounding buds but maybe not NC
text: These are well built headphones that sound great. The bass is very deep there are some decent highs but mid range is lacking. If you listen to deep bass music then these Headphones are for you but others may think the sound is too deep and somewhat muffled. In comparison with other simular headphones these have better overall sound. Far as battery life you will only get a few hours of listening time befor they need to be recharge. The charging case is conveniently small however putting ear buds in case can be a little challenging. Far as the Noise Cancelling feature... I think this advertising is a bit misleading. The headphones really don't cancel out sound any better than other ear buds. What the Headphone can do is allow outside sound in by use of a external mic. Activating the noise cancelation feature simply shuts off the external mic. This is a nice feature compared to other headphones but I don't think it truly blocks out noise any better than other ear buds. More expensive noise canceling headphones will modify exterior noise waves and I don't think these are really canceling noise waves. Anyway for the price I still highly recommend these buds. I found other worless buds for less money that still sound just as good for little less but these buds have some nice features worth spending alittle extra for.

title: Love them
text: I got these for the price point and because other reviewers were raving abt it. Couldn’t afford airpod pros and the regular ones without the buds fall out of my ears easily. Only worn them for a day so can’t say on the battery life yet. Otherwise I’m loving them. I’ve only ever tried one other kind of active noise cancellation earbuds before, the 250ish Bose ones. It also bugged me that AirPods have limited touch controls (maybe the newer ones have more functions, don’t know), which still necessitated me reaching into my pocket to use my phone for volume control and so on. I didn’t realize these had *all* the functions I wanted built in, an added bonus. They also auto pause whatever’s playing when you take one out from your ear, same as AirPods. I work in a noisy environment and had my first day of peace and quiet with these things on. Went to the grocery store last night and the silence was wonderful. You don’t realize how much noise affects you until you experience its absence. Highly recommend these, would buy them again in a heartbeat. ***Update** have had these for several months now, they are one of my life changing purchases. They’re like a comfort blanket for my ears, I never leave home without them. Have dropped case with earbuds off of a 3rd story floor and neither case nor buds were damaged. Battery life easily lasts all day long with nearly constant use. If they broke or stopped working I would buy them again in a heartbeat. They cancel noise as well as the expensive Bose ones. Transparency mode is great, and you can hear outside sounds clearly even with audio playing. With noise cancellation active, you hear the audio as it was meant to be heard. Can’t recommend these enough.

title: Great AirPod Pro alternative
text: The Tozo NC2 earbuds are amazing. Pros: They paired easily with my iPhone and MacBook Pro. The sound quality is excellent, especially in noise cancellation mode. The bass is deep and rich. The highs are crisp. I changed the EQ setting on my Spotify app, flattening the bass a bit from my other earbuds because these are better out of the box. The case has wireless charging (see picture). I appreciate this feature as I keep this charger on my counter and it is easy to just drop the case on for a recharge. The batteries last a long time -- and the case can recharge them rather quickly. It ships with medium sized tips. I went up a size to better isolate ambient sounds. However, there is still a larger pair available, plus two smaller sizes. The earbuds have a touch sensitive section that controls with short, long, and double presses. This feature is better than AirPod Pros, where you have to use the iPhone to control volume. The range is unbelievable. I often leave my phone on my desk and walk away, forgetting I'm using earbuds. After 25 feet, my other earbuds drop out, even with direct line of sight. These do not! I can walk away from my phone and not drop the signal through the walls in my house -- around 45 feet. Cons: They go in the case easily, but withdrawing them is not as easy as AirPod Pros, which slide out of the case with just a flick of the finger. It wouldn't be an issue at all if I wasn't used to the easy removal of AirPods. The noise cancellation is almost as good as AirPod Pros, about 9 out of 10. The transparency mode lowers the volume and removes most of the bass from the earbuds. This is the weakest link in these earbuds -- not an issue for how I use them. Verdict: The range, battery life, quality of sound, and touch functionality put these earbuds in a class way above their price point. Highly recommended!

title: NC2 vs. NC9
text: I first bought the NC9 earbuds - which fits entirely within the ear. At first they seemed to be comfortable enough, but the longer I wore it, the greater the discomfort which grew to a point when I just couldn't wear them anymore. In my case, the units were just too big and heavy. Pros included fantastic noise cancellation which I tested on a cross-country flight. Sound quality was also very good. I especially liked that touching the left earbud cycled through the various noise cancellation modes - with each mode verbally acknowledged. But in the end, I couldn't get over the discomfort of wearing them. I then tried the NC2, which is a bit different in shape and less ear-invasive. I found that I could tolerate them better and that the sound quality wasn't much different. Unfortunately, it was harder to tell which earbud was "left" or "right" and when I did manage to lightly tap the left one, there was no verbal acknowledgment of noise cancellation mode - only a vague "beep." If you are in a noise-laden environment, you will notice the decrease in background sound, but I don't know why TOZO couldn't just simplify our lives by having the verbal acknowledgment as found in the NC9s. As with many other earbuds, finding the right sequence and timing of taps to, e.g., increase volume or move to the next track, is elusive - I would always go back to the source to make changes. The NC2s were also a little looser in the ear, meaning that it was easier to have them fall out... In the end, I liked the NC9 earbuds better for verbal acknowledgements and relative ease of knowing which was left or right, but felt that the NC2 pair were more tolerable in my ears - and thus I kept them and returned the NC9s.

title: Great value for a multitude of functions
text: I wanted a set of noise cancelling earbuds for outdoors and for the plane ride that I was planning to take soon. Noise on an airplane can drown out the sound from what I’m listening to. I shopped around for various models but I didn’t want to spend to much. Over the ear headphones are too bulky so I chose these ear buds. The set came with several ear pieces to customize the fit. I found small to be the right size. It was a little challenging to put the new silicone inserts in but I got it done. The case and ear buds were already fully charged. The case uses a USB C charging cable which came with the set. The case has indicator lights which is helpful for the user to know when to charge. The EarPods turn on when the case is opened. You can also turn them on with the touch pad on the EarPods. The left piece lets you rewind or go back and the right piece let’s you advance the song. One touch pauses. Three touches activates your phone’s digital assistant. The fit was perfect and they’re lightweight. It has a stem which makes adjusting the location in the ear easier. The shape tends to stay more stable than earbuds without a stem. The stem also contains the microphone for speaking. What sets this set apart from other music/communication earbuds is that it also enhances sound around me. I can hear ambient noise easier. It almost acts like a hearing aid as I can hear noises around me easier despite it drowning out loud noise. Sound quality was surprisingly great. High, mid and low frequency were all very clear. I like the bass function which is also very good. For the price I was very pleased. Overall I was pleasantly surprised by the features of sound canceling with loud noises, enhanced ambient hearing when the EarPods are not playing and sound quality. This is competitive against similar products two to three times the price point. Definitely worth the price!

title: Great Sound Quality, Lightweight, Easy to Operate
text: I've been using these headphones for a week and I can't get over the superior sound quality. They feature terrific high end frequency replication and offer a bass you can feel. I experimented briefly with the Bose music app, but I have enough apps on my phone already and this connects fine as a regular Bluetooth device. In the end, the comfort and sound quality are the most important and not the other features. Both are great on this product. These headphones have a really nice, sleek design. The ear cups swivel and can be easily adjusted to fit your head. The ear cups have what seems to be a soft leather or imitation leather padding that is comfortable and helps create a seal that blocks out external noise. You can adjust the amount of noise cancellation, so these are ideal headphones for both travel and zoning out. The headphones charge with a USB-C charging port. At this time most of my other devices require a USB Micro-B, but I'm seeing more of he C ports and cables. A charging cable is included along with an AUX cable. You also get a very nice plastic hard case that zips closed. The headphones have a minimal design with only three buttons. The only button that's labeled is the Bluetooth button. One really cool feature is that the front half of the right ear cup can recognize taps and gestures. Instead of feeling around for a tiny button, you can just double tap the ear cup to play your music or answer a call. You can adjust volume by swiping down or swiping up. The 20 hour battery life means these are always ready to play. I'm sure this set of headphones has more features than I'll ever use. The most important thing is that they are very comfortable, easily adjustable, and sound terrific. If you love music on the go, these headphones are a perfect choice.

title: Untimely I returned
text: So I returned them because the "11" levels (since they count off a level in the description), aren't a heck of a lot better than the old QuietComfort 25's. Now for sound, oh man, the base and quality of sound in these 700's are far superior than the QC25's, but $250 more superior? Not to me. I didn't really care about Bluetooth a whole lot, but did think it would be fantastic to have while walking to school. However a cord doesn't bother me very much. So the bass is phenomenal in the 700's especially compared to the QC25. The QC 35 are ok, but like other reviews have said for Bluetooth to even pair with your device you have to have a Bose app. I find the Quiet Comfort series to be slightly more comfortable than the 700's, the 700's have a little too much force holding them against my ears. So I have returned them because they are OK but nothing seems to be too new with the noise cancelling for advertising 11 levels of noise control to block out the world around you. The 1 level the QC25 has is almost as good as level 10. I've got a toddler who runs around, a fish tank (when a little low on water), and a dog who are the real reason why I have the headphones that I still hear very similarly in all 3 headphones.

title: Less is More
text: Ah, peace and quiet. For this old guy to listen to Led Zeppelin. Or Beethoven’s 6th, the Morris version. It is difficult to realize just how much ambient noise can distract from even the best sound systems and recordings, and nobody does a better job of subtracting this clutter than Bose. The quality of construction is top notch as always, the sound is pleasant and “warm,” and the battery lasts forever. All in all a solid product.

title: Actually Work
text: I have gone through about 6 headphones with my finnicky work laptop that hates external devices. The sound on these is not only incredible for me, but also people can hear me really well on calls. Some things to note: 1. Make sure you install the app on your phone and get the update for your headphones before using them or the sound quality is really bad. 2. We compared these to my husband's Apple Airpod Max headphones and they are basically identical in sound quality, fit, but these are a bit lighter and not metal 3. There are two settings when using with windows - headset (for calling) and headphones (for music) make sure you play with the sound settings to get things right 4. Battery life is about 7-8 hours. Nothing super impressive but not bad. I feel like apple items have batteries that just don't quit, but the price point for these is better

title: Great find!!
text: Bought these for my friend who edits commercials for work. 20years in the business and she’s Loving these!! I could always hear her music as we work from home, and now I can’t hear anything!! She loves that they are wireless, easy to charge and cancel out noise. She just talks louder now! Haha

title: Not bad, but incredibly annoying crackling, voice prompts, button placement
text: Whenever something changes, skip forward in a movie, some other situations, it crackles. And it crackles REALLY loud. It really annoys me. That never happened to me with other Bluetooth headphones I've been using. Need to use the cable to avoid this. The voice prompts are also very annoying, I don't want to have them ALL the time when connecting to my laptop, just get going with the sound, when I turn the headphones on for a meeting, I want them to work right away, not tell me for 10 or 15 seconds to which laptops or other devices it's connected to. The last annoyance is button placement. There HAS to be a better way to do this than to place them exactly where pretty much everyone I had try placed their hands. It's just stupid. Now, for the good points: They are comfortable. More comfortable than even a lot of lighter non-Bluetooth headphones, the ear cups are very nice and don't press on too hard, adjustment is easy and mostly stays the way it should be. Sound is decent enough, nothing to complain about, the carrying case is well designed and it comes with the necessary cables to charge and use it wired. Overall: I wish I had bought different headphones due to the crackling and the annoyance with buttons and voice prompts. The downsides FOR ME outweigh the benefits significantly. Unfortunately I can't return them since I broke (and then discarded) the packaging when unpacking them. Therefore I'll keep them for the time being and might sell them at some point when I have found something that doesn't have these stupid annoyances.

title: I am very disappointed
text: I purchased this pair after my Bose QuietComfort 35 II mic started acting up after years of use. I decided to upgrade to this pair as a replacement. Big mistake. I just should’ve reordered the first pair. I have a couple of huge issues with the new pair; First, connection - it drop connections for no reason and you will have to go to your settings to reconnect. Secondly, th battery life is not the 20 hours it claims. I pretty much have to change it up every other day from only a few hours of usage… The sound quality is difficult to judge since I have always had Bose, even in my car - so it’s okay. But I believe that the Bose QuietComfort 35 II is a much better buy.

title: Great for noise cancellation but lacking on bass
text: Just got it and my husband is still getting used to it. But so far the only thing that’s missing from his and my experience is the lack of bass. Would love if it has more bass or option to put it up or down.

title: BEST HEADPHONES EVER!!!
text: INCREDIBLE QUALITY! INCREDIBLE SOUND! And it blocks out all the “outside” noise! LOVED THEM!!!

title: Great product!!
text: Bought these for my son he really likes them. He does a lot of flying and likes them a lot.

title: Used/refurbished
text: Lol. Should have known better. These came USED. There's hair in the case, obvious fingerprints on the outer shell of both the case and the headphone cups, a missing cable, it's just a mess. Surprisingly disappointing since nowhere did it list that I was buying a used item. Absolutely returning these, this is so disgusting. Beware.

title: Drops the sound constantly when using with my iPad.
text: These work fine with my iPhone, but continuously drop the sound when using them with my iPad. Yes, it’s updated. Yes, I’ve deleted and reinstalled apps. I’ve stopped using them with the iPad. It’s rather unfortunate, considering the price paid for these. I expected to get much better and more use out of them.

title: superb
text: These headphones are superb. not cheap, but well worth it. I love them. they are comfortable, hqve a very long time before i need o charge them again, and of course the main thing is the sound experience. which is awesome. crisp, clear sound, deep bass and lovely high notes, and the noise cancellation is awesome., i have just a land-line phone, and i had to invest in a flashing light when the phone rings because i do not hear anything thn the headphones, even though the phone is two feet away on my desk. I am blind, have a number of health issues, and live in an assisted living home. my sound is extremely important to me. These are by far the best headphones I have ever owned.

title: Good luck charging these headphones
text: [[VIDEOID:a52e4e5d304000fc34cdd5f6439fb20b]] These headphones are expensive, and they can't even include a charger you can plug into the wall, just a USB cord, that if plugged into anything wont charge them. The headphones never charged fully. This Is a huge issue that BOSE is not addressing, as I found a ton of posts about it on their own site. The light never goes fully white, it just keeps blinking, which means the headphones aren't fully charged. Someone on their help board says to buy a smartphone quick charge cord, its the only way to charge it. Why in the hell would you have to buy an off brand charger for an expensive set of headphones? They should be included, its ridiculous. The instruction manual is horrifically bad as well. I would say don't buy these, since they cannot be charged to full, EVER..

title: Terrible app renders wonderful sound quality useless
text: The app issues render this item useless and unreliable. The sound is amazing when it works. For 350$ I expect reliability. Going to have to struggle to return these after trying six months to struggle through issues. I would not recommend these. UPDATE: returned the original pair and within a couple months the same issues repeat on the new pair. Leads me to believe this is an engineering issue.. I can't use these and they don't do returns so I have a 400$ paperweight. Do not buy.

title: Beware! Does not support music/audio sharing.
text: Deceiving marketing. In the product comparison in the Amazon page Bose compares this headphones vs the QC35, they never mentioned that they aren’t capable for music sharing as most Bose wireless headsets does. I’m very disappointed Bose has done this. I have QC15, 35II. The later an improvement over the QC15 being wireless and capable to share music and audio. You would think the next product will just be better, but don’t. Besides the sleek exterior design NC700, are a step back. Wish I have check all reviews in detail to discover they can’t share music. I just saw them at the store and ordered them. I have lost my faith in Bose.

title: The sound quality is significantly worse on these than the older model.
text: These are good headphones just not great ones. The noise cancelation is very good but at the cost of the sound quality. I tried on 4 different devices all 4 sounded worse with these than the Bose from 6 years ago. Plus the audio is so quiet with zero way to increase. A week into using these I traded them to a coworker for the used older model which sound 3 times better. Will not buy any new Bose products untill they fix their sound quality especially if your paying $350 for headphones.

title: B+
text: Bose has always been top shelf everything was there except the bass

title: Nice headphones
text: So apparently my first review never got approved by the approval nazis. This review is much better than the first since these headphones actually work. I keep these things on max noise canceling and love them. The sound is also very good. Very crisp and clear with a good bass not too much. It brings my music 🎼 to a whole new experience.

title: Great Sound and Noise Cancelling
text: I love my Bose headphones. My only complaint is that I can’t get them to answer a call.

title: BOSE NOISE CANCELLING HEADPHONE
text: GREAT GREAT GREAT EVERYTHING GREAT I gave it to my cousin and he loved it he listen to different kind of things the battery is absolutely amazing with all these features he never drop it off heas neck he use it all day and it works with him 👍.

title: What noise canceling?
text: I bought these for the much-touted Bose noise canceling, but they did not cancel much noise. You can hear water running, people talking, etc. Very, very unimpressive for $350 headphones.

title: BOSE
text: Very nice BOSE. Unfortunately, I had to return because they are too heavy and I get headaches when wearing them. Otherwise, I loved the noise canceling on my daily commute.

title: Great headphones
text: Most comfortable headphones I’ve ever owned! I’m typically a JBL person. I think these Bose are better overall. Way more comfortable on the head and ears. Sound is outstanding! Crisp and clear!

title: Horrible user experience
text: The good - the noise cancelling Is great but not as good as the Sony mx1000 The microphone and phone calls- outside noise does not interfere w phone calls , you can take a call in a lousy room and thre is no interference - The BAD- the user experience is awwful ! The pairing gives out intermittent and it keeps trying to reconnect and announces it annoyingly into the headphones . The person that designed the OS has a different standard of what constitutes subtlety .

title: Great features!
text: I love the noise cancellation! I also love that they connect to two devices at the same time! No more toggling Bluetooth between my phone and tablet. Just start using the device of choice and they WORK! This was the most I spent on a set of headphones, but I would do it again.

title: The Best
text: What else is there to say about Bose product except they have the BEST sound and noise canceling technology. So my only beef with Bose headsets is one has to use their App for initial Bluetooth connection. I wish I did not have to do that

title: Bose 700 a work in progress, not quite there!
text: I purchased and returned these. The Noise cancellation works well, you can adjust 1-10. The application has numerous bugs even after several firmware upgrades. The battery discharges rapidly and conflicts with charge level of app. The headphones says full charge but the app says18 hours. Adjusting the fit is a challenge because of the on/off switch location. The sound quality is pretty much like the QC 35’s. But not worth a hundred dollars more. I liked the overall look and function including the touch control on the right ear phone. You keep wanting more sound, loudness at max level. Cost, bugs with app, battery life, sound bass quality are all factors which led me to buying Beats studio! Bose should apologize and refund people’s money!

title: Fantastic headphone
text: I had a QC35 II before so I expect a lot from this new 700 product. Boy, it does not disappoint! I especially like the touch control on the side.

title: Don't use them for a conference call
text: I was always surprised whenever I took part in a conference call when my perception changed. This is now my second pair of headphones. The bad sound transfer causes my voice to be muffled or heavily distorted on the remote side. Unfortunately, you cannot hear it by yourself and must rely on remote feedback. Noise cancelling headphones are ok, but not suitable for conference calls.

title: Garbage for instruction. Fails to connect over and over! Junk!
text: The instructions are garbage. I have been trying for hours for the app to recognize my head phones then I can't get the help to work. I can not connect to my TV. I am about to send it back. Update; after several hours it connected to my tv. I had to go to u tube for help.

title: Pure quality and excellent sound
text: I love these. I have always been a fan favorite if Bose and these are perfect and comfortable.

title: Amazing when paired with Apple Music BUY!!!
text: My 4th revision of this review. So the first pair I got had a bluetooth defect was returned. Then I tried the Sony XM4, terrible sound total hype - write that off. The replacement 700s took ~5 hours to break in. Paired with Apple Music these are blowing my mind. Sound quality is the best I've ever heard outside of the 660s. Noise cancelling is TOO good. I cant hear anything on the street almost got hit by a car. ——- Ok its been 7 months let me tell you the good and bad. Firmware and app updates fixed nearly all the bugs. Sound quality is fantastic, noise cancellation is flawless and the batteries never ever die. The only flaw really is the feature where you connect to 2 devices at once, or 3. The idea is the headphones seamlessly shift incoming sound from all your connected devices. It looks like there is some type of bug they can’t resolve in firmware. If one of the devices is a MBP you'll get moments of silence randomly. Tested on multiple 700s and multiple MBPs. So this is a one connection at a time set of cans. But still worth buying. Also, don’t let them get wet ever. The rain messes with the speakers bigtime. They recover but takes days. Overall I’m well satisfied and with Apple Music and Siri I’m in heaven. Still can’t get over how sharp they sound. Great great great job Bose!

title: Stopped working after nine months, and poor bluetooth connectivity
text: After an hour of updating device software and trying different fixes, it was eventually possible to get the mandatory app working and the device activated. Works fine when connected to a phone. However, it will usually not play audio from my desktop, as it is not being detected as a valid audio output. Occasionally it gets past that, but the poor connection means the audio frequently skips, making the bluetooth unusable. Eventually got it working with the audio cable after another couple hours, apparently there is a different volume setting for the cable vs. bluetooth, and the cable audio defaults to zero, so it will appear to not be working until you change the volume control specifically for that. Edit: After nine months, the left side has stopped working, do not buy this.

title: A great product as I expected from Bose

title: Comfort and sleekness

title: Great but uncomfortable

Have only had a few days and pairing with my msi laptop finds them but can not use them. Does not work but never have a problem with the iPhone. Bose was the name for a long time but it looks like people have caught up. title: Bose. . . . enough said
text: I wanted Bose speakers, but because I enjoy my music at a higher volume, the speakers would not be neighbor friendly. So I got the headphones. AWESOME! I can enjoy my music at any volume. Crystal clear sound. Amazing noise cancellation. I would recommend them to anyone who has a love of music.

title: Great Headphones

My primary use for these are for Microsoft Teams (Windows 10) calls during my work day. Everyone says the mic audio is clear and helps minimize background noise (dog and babies). Haven't had any issues with Bluetooth connections to my computer or phone.

title: Instructions missing from shipment
